string.value: Haven't met #r#p2100##k yet? She should be on a hill down on east side...it's pretty close from here so it will be easy to spot her...

You must be the new traveler. Still foreign to this, huh? I'll be giving you important informations here and there so please listen carefully and follow along. First if you want to talk to us, #bclick#k us with the mouse.
#bLeft, right arrow#k will allow you to move. Press #bAlt#k to jump. Jump diagonally by combining it with the directional cursors. Try it later.
Man... the sun is literally burning my beautiful skin! It's a scorching day today. Can I ask you for a favor? Can you get me a #bmirror#k from #r#p2100##k, please?
Thank you... #r#p2100##k will be on the hill down on the east side hanging up the laundry. The mirror looks like this #i4031003#.
Don't want to? Hmmm... come back when you change your mind.
Agent #b#h0##k! Come in, over. \r\n#L0##bSay what? Agent G? You're Gaga, the caretaker of maple tree.#l

That was in the past. From today, I am #bSecret Agent Gaga#k. Currently, there are agents all over Maple World trying to find one of Maple's Most Wanted, #e#r'Master M'#k#n. I've voluteered! And now that I'm an agent, I know that this is what I was meant to be. Do you want to join as well?\r\n#L0#Who is #e#rMaster M#k?#n#l

#e#rMaster M#k#n is not only dangerous but mysterious. We don't even know whether it's a man or a woman, where it lives or how old it is. One thing for sure is that it can appear and vanish in an instant which makes it #ra threat to Maple World#k. There have already been several cases that are linked to it. #b#h0##k! Maple World needs you! Do you want to join forces with us?

Congratulations! You are now an agent as well. I have given you equipping items for new agents. #bIf you continue to grow as an agent and become qualified, you can keep those items forever.#k 
#i1072366# #t1072366#

If you want to take on a mission as an agent, come see me. Just in case of wiretaps, we'll end it here for now. Agent Gaga, out!
You're not agent material yet. Come see me again when you're ready.
I knew you would accept my request.

Now wear the #b#t1072366##k I gave you. Once you do, you will have become an agent. From now on, you will be helping our special agents complete their missions. Once you earn the respect and trust of all the agents, and receive #bAgent N's Receiver, Agent C's Titanium Receiver, Ultimate Agent Suit, Agent O's Leather Gloves and the Agent Cape#k, I will give you the #bUltimate Agent Shoes#k as a gift.

Special Agent O has sent a request for help. Would you like to go? Amongst the other agents, Special Agent O is one of the most talented and skilled. One day, he will appear at Nihal Desert, the next day at Orbis, and the day after that, he will be at Perion. If you want, I can assign you to this mission. #bSpecial Agent O and I are close friends.

You can meet Special Agent O at the entrance of the mini dungeon. Which mini dungeon? I'm not sure. If I were to tell you where, by the time you get there, he might be somewhere else. You can never know where he is exactly at any given moment. Why don't you first try going to the closest mini dungeon? Just tell him #bAgent G sent you.
Wait. Think about this. An opportunity to meet someone like him is rare. The fact that you've met a close friend of his is an opportunity you shouldn't let slip away!
Special Agent O's location? I can't say... As I told you earlier, it's impossible to know where he is at any given moment. But for now, why don't you try going to the closest mini dungeon from here?

The Agent Box has a special security system on it where you will have to wait 30 minutes after you connect for it to appear. So wait 30 minutes inside the mini dungeon and when the Agent Box appears, retrieve the Special Agent Badge inside it.
...#b(He is staring into space as if he doesn't see me.)\r\n#L0#Hello. Are you Special Agent O? Um... Gaga... I mean Agent G sent me to see you. #l
Agent G? Who's that? I've never heard of that agent.\r\n#b#L0#What? Uh, he sort of has a long face with a butterfly neck tie...um...and...#l

Oh... He must be the new agent who just joined recently. I've never met him personally, but I did hear that he was put in charge of recruiting new agents. So, why are you here to see me? I'm currently on a mission and am quite busy.#b\r\n#L0#I was told to help you with your mission.#l

You're an agent as well? Mm... I didn't know they would send such a rookie... Oh well, it should be fine. First, do you agree to participate in this mission? It could be very dangerous. Think about it carefully before you answer.
I'm assuming you've already heard about 'Master M'? It is very powerful... which makes it very dangerous. Finding Master M is the most important thing. However, it is a very difficult task.

So all the special agents are spread out throughout Maple World, collecting information, downloading them onto badges and sending it to me. These Special Agent Badges that contain information are being collected in Agent Boxes in mini dungeons. Your job is to go in the mini dungeon and retrieving the Special Agent Badges.

But it's not as easy as it sounds. The Agent Box has a special security system on it where it appears 30 minutes after you connect. Wait 30 minutes inside the mini dungeon, and when the Agent Box appears, retrieve the Special Agent Badge and bring it back to me.
Each time you collect 10 Special Agent Badges, I will give you a pair of #bNylon Gloves#k. Then, if you collect 100 Special Agent Badges, I will give you a pair of my favorite #bLeather Gloves#k.
...If you're afraid, then becoming an agent isn't for you. And If you can't overcome those fears, those fears will always own you.
Oh! Be careful. Any sudden movements can trigger the bomb. Here...put it down here very carefully.
Good job. It wasn't an easy mission but you did it successfully. I will give you a pink flower pattern tube that is distributed from the headquarters.

#rMaster M#k is said to have planted bombs in Chumji's watermelons. We need to retrieve those watermelons immediately. I need your help! I will send you to Chumji's watermelon field, collect #b5 #t4031701##k and take it to #rAgent W#k.

I believe you already heard everything from the Maple Admin. Go inside Chumji's watermelon field with the help of the Maple Admin, and bring me back #b5 #t4031701##k that #rMaster M#k has planted bombs on.

Hey! #b#h0##k. Have you heard? There's a rumor that #e#rMaster M's Bomb#k#n is hidden inside Chumji's watermelon field. How is that possible? Chumji practically watches over that watermelon field 24/7. Agent W seems to be investigating the watermelons in that watermelon field and is in need of some help. Would you like to help him, #b#h0##k?
I will send you to Chumji's watermelon field. Avoid the Hoguls that guards the watermelons and carefully pick #b5 Watermelons#k and take it to #rAgent W#k. Tell me when you are ready to go.
That's unfortunate to hear.
I have been waiting for you. Your mission is to investigate the monsters that appear in the party quest and bring back 5 Intelligence documents. Everything is in your hands.
Go see Agent C in the party quest.
An order was sent to you from headquarters. Do you want to check it now?

The order says #r'Party Quest. Agent C. 5 Intelligence documents'#k. You have no idea what it means? The order basically says collect #b5 Intelligence documents#k inside the party quest and take it to #rAgent C#k at the party quest reward area.

Agent C is usually in charge of all the data but he is currently dispatched to the party quest site for his current mission. There is intelligence that the monsters inside the party quest are #e#rMaster M's#k#n subordinates. Collect 5 Intelligence documents from these monsters and take it to Agent C.

Where is Agent C? If you successfully get through the party quest, you will be able to meet him. Each time you take 5 Intelligence documents, you will receive #bAgent C's Old Receiver#k, and every time you collect 100 documents, you will receive #bAgent C's Titanium Reciver#k.
Then, please check later.
How am I going to hang all these up? Sigh... what? My mirror? Please don't tell me #p2101# asked you for this ...
Aye...she should have come and get it herself. Seriously, she is SOOO lazy. Here's the mirror you're looking for.
Oh wow! You brought #p2100#'s mirror! Thank you so so much. Let's see... no skin damage whatsoever...
If you go right, you will see the shiny spot. We call that as a "Portal". If you press #bUp Arrow#k, you will get to the next place. So long!
Did you lose the mirror? As her for it once more.
How am I going to hang all these up? Sigh... what? My mirror? Please don't tell me #p2101# asked you for this ...
Aye...she should have come and get it herself. Seriously, she is SOOO lazy. Here's the mirror you're looking for.
You must be Special Agent #b#h0##k? You've come to the right place. An urgent order has arrived for you. Do you want to know what it is?
I'm sure you already knew that Maple World is in danger of a serious threat.

That's right. The way things are going, we might all be destroyed. There have been reports of mysterious circles appearing throughout town, and some have even said they've witnessed a UFO kidnapping Master M.
We must find #t4031999# and protect Maple World. Bring back #b20#k #b#t4031999##k that monsters near by are secretly looking at.
You don't deserve to be a special agent.
Bring back #b20#k #b#t4031999##k. That is your mission.

I'm sure you already knew that Maple World is in danger of a serious threat.

You don't deserve to be a special agent.
Bring back #b20#k #b#t4032000##k. That is your mission.

You don't deserve to be a special agent.
Bring back #b20#k #b#t4032001##k. That is your mission.
Good job. You have completed today's mission. Your mission performance file is scheduled to be reported to the headquarters. Have a great day.
You want to receive today's mission again?

In order to retrieve the #bSpecial Agent Badge#k, you need to go into the mini dungeon. If you have already helped #bAgent O#k once before, go see #bAgent O#k, and if you haven't helped him before, first go see #bAgent Gaga#k. Please continue to do your best in solving the mystery of #e#rMaster M's#k#n identity.
If you want to receive it again, just let me know.
수고하셨습니다. 오늘의 미션을 완료하셨습니다. 미션 수행 자료는 본부로 보고될 예정입니다. 오늘도 좋은 하루 되세요.
오늘의 미션을 다시 받으시겠어요?
믿을 수 있는 정보원의 첩보에 따르면 #b요원W#k의 #bMS-07 작전#k의 임무수행을 도와주면 우수요원 뱃지를 받을 수 있습니다. \n때가 되면 #b요원W#k가 당신을 찾아올겁니다. 그럼 오늘 하루도 #b마스터 M#k의 정체를 추적하는데 최선을 다해 주시기 바랍니다.
다시 받고싶다면 말씀해 주세요.
수고하셨습니다. 오늘의 미션을 완료하셨습니다. 미션 수행 자료는 본부로 보고될 예정입니다. 오늘도 좋은 하루 되세요.
오늘의 미션을 다시 받으시겠어요?
다시 받고 싶다면 말씀해주세요.
Good job. You have completed today's mission. Your mission performance file is scheduled to be reported to headquarters.
You want to receive today's mission again?

If you go see #bAgent Cassandra#k, you can take the speed quiz on items and monsters of Maple World. You get 1 point per question, and you can take the quiz every 30 minutes. You must earn a #btotal of 50 points#k for today. Please continue to do your best in solving the mystery of #e#rMaster M's#k#n identity.
If you want to receive it again, just let me know.
Good job. You have completed today's mission. Your mission performance file is scheduled to be reported to headquarters.
You want to receive today's mission again?

Today's mission is retrieving Chumji's watermelons. There has been intelligence that #rMaster M#k has planted bombs in Chumji's watermelon field. Therefore, the watermelon field is currently being managed by the #bMaple Admin#k, so get to the watermelon field through the Maple Admin and bring back the watermelons to #bAgent W#k at the agent headquarters. Please continue to do your best in solving the mystery of #e#rMaster M's#k#n identity.
If you want to receive it again, just let me know.
Good job. You have completed today's mission. Your mission performance file is scheduled to be reported to headquarters.
You want to receive today's mission again?

I frequently give special orders to agents in order to collect information on #bMaster M#k. If you want to receive one of these special orders, come see me. I am located at every town that needs me. Please continue to do your best in solving the mystery of #e#rMaster M's#k#n identity.
If you want to receive it again, just let me know.
Hey! Agent #b#h0# !#k Judging by your clothes, you must have successfully completed your special agent task. But don't you think there is something lacking?
If you don't think so, that's fine...
The magic on your shoes is running out. I have specially given you #b#t01072368##k. The moment you put them on, you will transform into a true special agent.
These are my last pair so make sure you don't lose them.

I knew you would come back to see me. I'm just that popular... Haha!\r\n#b#L0#You're right. Gaga, you're not only handsome but you can also sing and dance so well. You're definitely the best agent in Maple World. (Geez; what do I have to do to get these shoes...)#l#k
#b#h0##k, I can't disagree with that! But, I feel like you're here because you need the Parachute Agent Shoes... Am I right?
I should have them somewhere... Why don't you talk to me in a little bit while I go look for them?
I could give you the Parachute Agent Shoes again that you really need...
Oh, a traveller!! Nice, right on time... I have a favour to ask, will you do it for me? Go a little more to the right and you'll find a boy.
That's my little brother, #r#p2001##k. Will you please ask him what he wants for dinner?
Haven't met #p2001# yet? Please, open you eyes!
이거 굉장한걸~ 그새 다 모아오다니. 역시 내 눈은 틀림없다니까. 자네는 앞으로 좋은 모험가가 될 수 있을 거야. 난 그렇게 믿네.
돈은 잘 받았나? 비록 얼마 되지는 않지만 지금 막 모험을 시작하는 자네에게는 유용하게 쓰일 수 있을 거야. 머지않아 강해진 자네를 다시 만날 수 있으면 좋겠군.
음... 아직 다 모으지 못한 모양이군? 내가 자넬 너무 과대평가 한 건가? 서둘러 #b#t4000016# 100개#k와 #b#t4000004# 50개#k를 모아오게나. 자네라면 충분히 할 수 있을 거야.
이봐 자네! 모험을 떠나려고 하고 있나? 하지만, 조금 약해 보이는데. 나도 젊었을 땐 새로운 세계를 찾아 여기저기 여행을 했었지. 그때가 그립군. 멋진 모험을 하는 것만큼 신나는 일은 없거든.
처음에는 경험도 없고 준비도 부족했기 때문에 너무 힘들었었지. 자네를 보니까 내가 젊은 시절 모험을 할 때 고생했던 기억이 자꾸 떠오르는군.
자네가 왠지 맘에 들어서 하는 말인데. 모험가로서의 자네의 자질을 내게 증명한다면 내가 자네의 모험을 지원해 주겠네. 어떤가. 해보겠나?
좋아. 그렇다면 #b#t4000016# 100개#k와 #b#t4000004# 50개#k를 모아서 나에게 다시 오게나. 이것들을 다 모아오면 자네의 자질을 인정해주겠네.
그래? 도와주려고 했는데... 마음이 변하면 다시 찾아와봐.
이거 굉장한걸~ 그새 다 모아오다니... 역시 몰라보게 강해졌군.
돈은 잘 받았나? 이곳 저곳을 여행을 다니는데 매우 유용하게 쓸 수 있을 거야. 그럼 부디 몸조심 하게나.
음... 아직 다 모으지 못한 모양이군? 내가 자넬 너무 과대평가 한 건가? 서둘러 #b#t04000024# 80개#k와 #b#t04000020# 100개#k를 모아오게나. 자네라면 충분히 할 수 있을 거야.
#b#h0#!#k 오랜만이네. 어때 그 동안 모험은 즐거웠나? 자네가 몰라보게 성장한 모습을 보니 매우 뿌듯하군. 자네가 얼마나 강해졌나 한번 시험해 보고 싶은데 해보겠나?
좋아. 그렇다면 #b#t04000024# 80개#k와 #b#t04000020# 100개#k를 모아오게나. 그렇다면 자네가 진정 강해졌다고 인정해 주겠네.
아직 자신이 없는 게로군. 나에게 강인함을 증명하고 싶다면 다시 나를 찾아와 주게나.

안녕하세요, #h0#님! 더도말고 덜도말고 한가위만 같아라~ 라는 말 아시죠? 벌써 추석이에요! 민족의 명절을 맞아 메이플 월드에서도 많은 이벤트가 진행중이랍니다.

What do you press to pick up an item on the ground?

#L0##b X#l
#L1# S#l
#L2# I#l
#L3# Z#k#l

That's correct. #bZ#k is used to pick up items on the ground dropped by the monsters. The other key you can use to pick up items would be #b0 on the number pad#k. As for the seldom-used X, you can use that to sit on a chair. Once you head over to Victoria Island, you'll find some chairs you can sit on. You should try it, since you can recover much faster by sitting as opposed to just standing still!

Once you see a chair or a bench you can sit on, you can do just that. Unfortunately, you won't find any chairs in Maple Island that you can sit on. Head over to Victoria Island to sit on some chairs, and when you find one, make sure to press X. You'll be able to tell that you're recovering much faster by sitting as opposed to just standing still.
You can raise your ability stats using the AP's that you earn after every level-up. To check out the AP's, simply press S.
I is used to check out your item inventory. It is one of the most useful functions in the game, one that'll enable you to check out the items you've collected.

You're inching closer and closer towards making the job advancement. I'm anxious to see which job you're going to take. Now, talk to me when you're ready for the 5th question.

In order to make the job advancement as either a Warrior, a Bowman, a Thief, or a Pirate, you'll have to be at least level 10 to do so. What level do you have to be in order to make the job adv. as a Magician? 

#L0##bLevel 10#l#l
#L1#Level 8#k#l

That is correct!! You'll need to be at least level 10 in order to make the job advancement as either a Warrior, a Bowman, a Thief, or a Pirate. To become a magician, however, you only need to be at level 8. Head over to Victoria Island, go to a Magician town called Ellinia, and look for Grendel the Really Old, the chief magician that'll lead you towards becoming a Magician yourself.

The effectiveness of the skills differ greatly, based on the level. For example, the Three Snail Skill will require a regular Snail shell on Level 1, but on Level 2, you'll need Blue Snail shells. You'll have to really think and calculate which skills will maximize your hunting abilities.

You're wrong. A stranger indeed.
#b#t4031151##k is here. Will you get this to my mom?
She asked you this for her work, right? I hope her studies get done soon.
You don't need it? I thought you were sent here to get #b#t4031151##k from me. If you don't need it, then oh well ...

Hey, you're back. I forgot to tell you this, but Anne is very careful and difficult to be with around strangers. She just thinks twice before being nice to strangers. I should have given you a letter of approval.

Wow, incredible! Anne must have trusted you to give you this! She's my daughter and all, but she can be quite a handful at times ... how did you do that?? You are indeed someone I can count on. Now I can definitely get on with the animal fossil studies. Please drop by around the time I get done with this. I'll let you know of the outcome.
Are you here empty-handed? Where's the #b#t4031151# that I asked you to get? Please hurry.
You lost that????? Sigh ... please don't lose it again.
Been a while. Thanks to you, I have successfully completed the studies.

The fossils you've gotten me were critical materials. Those fossils contain clues that may lead us to discover the secrets behind the special abilities of the prehistoric life. Use them well, and it will help us regular people out tremendously.
I need to send Dr. Winston of Perion the final report on the results of the studies. Can you help me out?

I knew you'd help me out. Please get the final report to Dr. Winston. Oh, and before coming up to him, gather up #b100 Leaves#k, #b50 logs of Firewood#k, #b1 Stump's Tear#k, and #b1 pair of Weight Earrings#k. Dr. Winston will be very pleased with the report and may reward you with something nice.
Ahhh, you may have never heard of #b#t4031153##k. #b#t4031153##k is a rare crystal you can only get from the Dark Axe Stump's.
You must be very busy. I'll have to ask someone else for this.

Welcome, welcome. You're the one that helped me get my fossils back the other day. I heard that you've also helped Dr. Betty with her studies. She said she gave you the final report for me to look at. Did you bring it?
Please also give me the materials that you've gathered up. Those materials will be used to conduct the studies regarding the final report. Dr. Betty did tell you this in advance, right?
Wow ... a huge secret laden in the fossils!! The more you dig up the fossils, the more you're amazed by them. It never ceases to surprise me on many levels.
Do you like the earring? It's the result of the studies we have conducted here. It is laden with the abilities of the Stump, so use it wisely!
What's up? Aren't the fossil studies going well? I'm more than ready to take a look at the results ...
Did you lose the final report??? My oh my, you better be really careful. Good thing I made a number of copies in case something like this happens. Now, please get this to Dr. Winston SAFELY.

Haha, so you're here! #p1101002# would have never let you out when you have just become a Knight-in-Training. I'm sure he said something along the lines of you diligently training until you reach Level 13.
What is there to do except train anyway. This is all for your own good, and for the good of the Cygnus Knights. Now, let's work on the training.
The training you are about to undergo entails you getting acclimated to monsters outside Ereve, which means you are training for the real world. You'll need to do that sooner or later, anyway.

Go to the end of Training Forest, and you'll encounter a number of entrances. Your job is to enter #bthe 1st Drill Hall#k and take on a number of #r#o9300271#s#k that are specialized for this training. I want you to defeat #r30#k of them.
Hmmm? What is it? If you don't like the way #p1101002# talks, then don't mind him. He's always like that anyway, so you might as well get used to him.
Ohhh, you managed to defeat 30 #o9300271#s. That's fast. If you keep up this pace, this training might be a breeze.
Talk to me when you're ready to take on the next step.
I don't think you have defeated #r30 #o9300271#s#k yet. Go to the end of Training Forest and take the entrance to #bthe 1st Drill Hall#k. Your job is to defeat 30 #o9300271#s, okay?

Okay, are you ready to take on the next training session? I'm sure #p1101002# told you this already, but if you talk to #p1101001#, you'll be divinely blessed, which will help you go through the training that much easier. If you forgot to do so, then go get it right now. Are you ready?
This time, the targets are #r#o9300272#s#k, which are monsters you'll run into quite often in Victoria Island. Honestly, I've never been there, so I don't know if that statement is legit.
Like I said last time, enter #bthe 1st Drill Hall#k and you'll see a group of #o9300272#s ready to battle. I need you to defeat #r30#k of them.

If you forgot something, then I suggest you take care of that first before going off to battle. There's nothing worse than looking for an item in the heat of the battle, only to realize you left it at home.
Oh, did you manage to defeat 30 #o9300272#s? I have to say, you're doing quite well right now. Let's do one final session. Talk to me when you are ready.

I don't think you have defeated #r30 #o9300272#s#k yet. Don't tell me you've gone all the way to Victoria Island in search of #o9300272#s, right? Find the entrance to #bthe 1st Drill Hall#k at the end of the Training Forest, and you'll see a number of #o9300272#s ready to battle.

Are you ready to start the next training session? You did receive the blessing from #p1101001#, right? Then let's get this started. This is the final chapter of the Acclimation Training, which means after you pass this, you will be pressed into real duties!

The targets for this session are #o9300273#s. They are very much aggressive creatures, and they definitely look the part as well. You'll find a number of those creatures inside #bthe 1st Drill Hall#k, so go ahead and defeat #r30#k of them.
Your real Knight duties are coming up soon. Aren't you excited? Get this training session over with so you can take on the real duties!
I see that you have eliminated all the #o9300273#s. Great work there! Do you feel like you can do well out of this island and in the Victoria Island?

This marks the end of the Acclimation Training sessions. You'll do well and not only survive, but thrive in Victoria Island. You will be thrown into fire, but I believe in you enough that you will find no trouble persevering through all that!

Your true duties begin now. Once you reach Level 13, talk to #p1101002# and he will give you a list of duties you'll have to take on. Please serve and honor the Empress well, and do not engage in activities that may jeopardize your standings in the Cygnus Knights.

I don't think you have defeated #r30 #o9300273#s#k yet...? There are lots of #o9300273#s set up at #bthe 1st Drill Hall#k, so all you need to do is just go there and battle. They are no different than #o1210100#s in #m104010001#, so you don't need to go too far to do that.

I see that you have reached Level 13. Okay, from here on out, as an official member of Cygnus Knights, you will receive official assignments that will be given to you from headquarters. Do you want to know what your duties are? Let me explain them.

Your duties, your assignments are detailed tasks given to you to fulfill as a member of the Cygnus Knights. That's because if one person takes on all of the duties, such as strengthening one's self, while at the same time investigating Black Mage and preventing his warriors from invading, that person will burn out in no time.

We have delegated the duties for a more effective way of facing the Black Mage and his warriors. Everyone presents different but appropriate sets of skills depending on the circumstances, and this is a way of doing that.

The duty that most suits you at this point is... #bworking in #m100000000##k. Since you'll be sent there for your duties, you will be away from Ereve for the forseeable future. If you have some unfinished business to take care of, then you should take care of it right now. If you are ready to take on the tasks immediately, then press Accept.

Head over to #m100000000#, where you'll run into #bAgent #p1103001##k, who's there to gather up information on the Black Mage. Secrecy is of utmost importance as an Agent, so you won't be able to find him easily. Your first task is to contact him.
Your duties after the meeting will be instructed by him. Please make sure to receive the blessing from #p1101001# before leaving Ereve. May your efforts bring glory to the Empress.

string.name: 2 = Your destination is Ellinia, which isn't too far from Henesys. But your level may not be high enough to just breeze through the journey, so you may want to travel in a taxi. If you ride the taxi in the village way down in Ellinia, you'll be able to get 1
string.value: Your destination is Ellinia, which isn't too far from Henesys. But your level may not be high enough to just breeze through the journey, so you may want to travel in a taxi. If you take the taxi near the bottom of Ellinia, you'll be able to get 1 free ride using this #bTaxi Coupon#k.
Find Roca when you reach Henesys. You'll find out what your mission is once you talk to him. Oh, and don't forget to ask #p1101001# for a blessing on your way out. Best of luck to you.
If you have some unfinished business to take care of in Ereve, do so now before taking on the assignment.

Are you an agent from Ereve, by any chance? Wow, it's nice to see you! It's been such a long time since I last met anyone from the Cygnus Knights. How's Ereve? Is Oz still the same old? Ahhh... I must be really missing Ereve if I am admitting to missing #p1101002#...!
The agent in charge of #b#m100000000##k is #b#p1103001##k. He's probably hiding himself somewhere in #m100000000#. Your first duty is to find him.

Wait, we have no time for this. We've been short on workers agents anyway, so I'm glad you're on board. Lately #m100000000# has been chaotic to say the least, and there have been informations on the monsters of the Black Mage. What's the information? Well...

Have you heard of the monster called #o1210102#? You've seen them while you were in Ereve taking on the Acclimation Training, right? Apparently, some of the #o1210102#s in #m100000000# have been displaying some suspicious behavior. They've been seen with sadistic looks on their faces, and they are always found together.

Considering that #o1210102#s are famous for their black, yet bright smiles, this sounds quite a bit odd, don't you think? After further investigation, they were collectively under the spell from Black Mage, and with the Wizard's instruction, they are now ready to attack town anytime soon. Please make sure #o1210102#'s plans do not go as planned!

Regular #o1210102#s have no clue. All you need to do is hunt down the suspicious-looking #r#o9300274#s#k around #m100000000#. I suspect their home is #bsomewhere east of town#k... I need you to defeat #r50#k of them. Thanks and good luck!
Oh, and if you find any suspicious items while hunting #o9300274#, then please bring it back to me. I have a feeling there's something more to it than just those monsters.

Hmm... since our conversation has to be discreet, do you want to meet up somewhere less overt? Where's a private place to meet up in #m100000000#? I don't think there is one though... let's just talk here.

Wow, you were able to defeat all 50 #o9300274#s! That was quite incredible, I say. Knights are definitely more dependable than others. Thanks to your help, we were able to prevent #o1210102#s from taking over #m100000000#!

I'll stay here and look for Black Mage's whereabouts. I'll contact you the moment I spot something abnormal, so in the meantime, I'd like for you to keep training to make yourself into a mighty Knight. A good site for training can be #bHenesys Hunting Ground 1#k. Come see me when you reach #bLevel 14#k!
Were you not able to defeat #r50 #o9300274#s#k? They should be near #m100000000#. I hear that somewhere around #b#m100010000##k. there's a secret path that leads to their home...
Were you not able to defeat #r50 #o9300274#s#k? They should be near #m100000000#. I hear that somewhere around #b#m100010000##k. there's a secret path that leads to their home...

I have just received a big news! I can't disclose the name, but a girl in #m100010000# allegedly found a group of suspicious shadows moving in #b#m100020000##k. Doesn't that sound questionable? I think it's something we should look into!
I want you to go into #m100020000# and search the grassy areas, especially the ones in between the weeds and thickets. If you can find anything, ANYTHING, let me know, okay?

Just in case you are not sure how to search for things... #buse your cursor to roam around the screen until you find something you can click on. When you spot something, you can click on it immediately#k.
Eh? Doesn't it sound suspicious enough? Other than that, I haven't received much information on Black Mage...

So you spotted a black shadow in between the forest? Ahh... it would have been nice if we could have captured him. But if it is indeed one of Black Mage's men, then there's no way he would have been caught that easily.
Thank you so much for your help! I'll be here to check on them continually, so I want you to keep training until the next big mission comes up, okay?

Oh no, we're in deep trouble! #o1210100#s in #m100020100# have revolted! I have a feeling that's because we spotted the black shadows too late. Ahhh, we should have done something about it when we found a shadow at the Pig Farm. We must prevent the #o1210100#s from taking this any further!

Please go and battle #o1210100#s and #o1210101#s, while preventing #o1210100#s from creating more chaos. If you can defeat #r100 #o1210100#s#k and #r50 #o1210101#s#k, they'll know what they're running against and stop. Oh, and... while you're hunting #o1210100#, if you ever come across an item called #b#t4032130##k, please pick it up and give it to me as well! It's not 100 percent confirmed, but I think I have a general idea of what that item is...
Ahhh, we are running out of time! Once the #o1210100#s start revolting, you'll no longer be able to enjoy pork. Is that okay with you?
Wow, you were able to snuff out #o1210100#s' revolt! That was awesome! I think it's safe to say you are the #b#o1210100#s' worst nightmare#k, no? Okay... maybe not.
...Hmmm, and that is... #t4032130#? I couldn't confirm its accuracy, so I wasn't sure if you'd bring it to me, but since you did... maybe that was the correct information...
...Maybe this all came about because of this doll...

Please defeat #r100 #o1210100#s#k and #r50 #o1210101#s#k so you can prevent the #o1210100#s from revolting any further. Oh, and if you find #t4032130#, then give me that too! Ahhh, I don't even want to imagine life without pork!

Please defeat #r200 #o1210100#s#k so you can prevent the #o1210100#s from revolting any further. Oh, and if you find #t4032130#, then give me that too! Ahhh, I don't even want to imagine life without pork!

Hmmm... sorry about that. I just had to think about something. We'll need more information to have a clear picture of what's going to happen, but... since you were able to control the #o1210100#s, this assignment on #m100000000# is complete, I believe. We'll just need to report the results to #p1101002#.

Please hand this #bMission Report#k and #b#t4032131##k to #b#p1101002##k. He'll take care of the rest, so... oh, and your next assignment will also be given by #p1101002#. Maybe we'll cross paths again with another assignment down the road. Until then...

I'm not 100 percent sure on this, but since the #o1210100#s' revolt was stopped before it got out of hand, I believe they realized that #m100000000# may be a hard place for them to conquer, so they may stay low for a while, so I believe it's a good time for us to compile a report on what we have found thus far.
I suppose you have successfully completed your assignment at #m100000000#. #p1103001# probably gave you an item that you should give to me. Ah, is that it?

Okay, so I received the report and the item related to it. I wasn't sure if it was true, but it is indeed a #rdoll#k... Hmmm... anyway, I'll contact you when new missions come to light. In the mean time, I would like for you to train constantly so you can be counted on when the time comes.
Now that you are quite familiar with #m100000000#, maybe you can spend some time training in places like #m100020100#. I'll see you... when you reach around ... #bLevel 16#k.
Wait, haven't you gone to #b#p1101002##k yet? He won't be very pleased if you make him wait, and he'll let you know about it. Please deliver the report and the doll to him.

Hmmm... How in the world did you work at #m100000000#? If you have completed your assignment, you should have a Mission Report with you, and yet your hands are empty. Did you lose it by chance? If you did, you better go talk to #b#p1103001##k.
...What is this, are you the Knight that's assigned to #m103000000#? You look pretty weak... what can you do? This neighborhood isn't even the best in town.
Haven't you gone to #m103000000# yet? Your laziness is quite appalling. Victoria Island itself isn't a huge island in any sense of the word.

Have you been training diligently? I have a new assignment for you. I want you to head over to #b#m103000000##k in Victoria Island. Your mission is to go there and contact #bAgent #p1103002##k in Victoria Island, who's gathering up valuable information on Black Mage and his crew.
#p1103002# will brief you on the rest of the assignment. May your efforts bring glory to the Empress.
If you're not ready to handle this, you can always return to Ereve and train from scratch. I do know that, however, will not bring some newfound courage if you never had it in you.

Man, why is it so cold here??? Um, hey ... do you know where Dr. Naora is, by any chance? Today's the day I get these bandages off, but I can't see anything. I need to see if the surgery went right. Well, if you got time, can you help me out??

Wow, thanks a lot. I need to get these bandages off and look at myself in the mirror, but there seems to be no mirror around here. I heard that #b#o2230102##k, that live in the mountains, may give out #b#t4031155##k. Please get me #b20 #t4031155#s#k, I'll greatly appreciate it. By the way, why is it so cold around here????
............ I guess that's a no. Why is it so darn cold around here?? And where is Dr. Naora??
I don't think you have gathered up #b20 #t4031155#s#k yet. Please get them for me ... it is waaaay too cold around here.
You don't really instill confidence in me, but since you're a Cygnus Knight and all... and since no one else can go on a search right now... Okay, let me explain to you what this mission is about.

According to the information we acquired recently, the subways in #m103000000# are apparently full of strange dolls. Jake told me this, so I can say this with confidence. Those dolls do seem quite suspiscious... so I want you to bring #t4032136# back to me.
Jake said any dolls found inside the subway have all been thrown out, so if you go through the trash can, then maybe you'll be able to find one. Good luck!
What? Are you declining the mission? Fine, do it like that. I'll just report it straight to #p1101002#.
Oh, you managed to bring #t4032136# with you! Not bad... I thought you'd be too queasy to go through trash. Not bad, not bad.
Hold on for a minute while I run through this doll. I'll need to make sure that this is the same one as the one found in #m100000000#.
Were you not able to find #b#t4032136##k? I told you to go through the #bsubway trashcan#k for that.

Okay, bad news. The doll you found inside the trash can is fake! I think the real dolls have already been absorbed by #o1210103#! In this case, your mission right now is to eliminate #o1210103# and bring back #t4032137# in return. You can do it, right?
I'll need you to slay about #r100 #o1210103#s#k, and bring back #b30 #t4032137#s#k from #o1210103#. That should be enough to have at least one real doll mixed in.
What? You refurse to do it? Do you want me to file a report to #p1101002# right this minute?
Okay so you managed to defeat #o1210103# and retrieve the doll. Let's see...

...Come to think of it, that's a lot of dolls you brought here. How am I ever going to find out which one of these is real? Okay... so while I go through these dolls one by one, I want you to go out and train... I mean, see me when you reach #bLevel 17#k.
Please defeat #r100 #o1210103#s#k and bring back #b30 #t4032137#s#k. The odds should be in our favor that at least one of them is real.
Please defeat #r100 #o1210103#s#k and bring back #b30 #t4032137#s#k. The odds should be in our favor that at least one of them is real.

There were so many dolls to look into that there's no way I can tell which one is which. This is why quantity over quality isn't necessarily a good thing even in gathering up evidences. Anyway, I needed major help, so I wound up contacting #b#p9000008##k and asked for help in finding the real doll. So I want you to go get it for me.
I don't know about anything else, but #p9000008# definitely has an eye for things like this, so I'm sure we have the real doll plucked out from the mass. Just get it for me, will you?
Wait, you're not going to go? Are you ready to be ridiculed by #p1101002#, then?

Good thing you managed to retrieve #t4032138#. What? #p9000008# was complaining that he didn't get paid? Hmmm! Taking care of the mission is more important in the grand scheme of things, don't you agree? As long as we found the doll, we're good, right?
Hmmm, anyway, we did wind up finding the real #t4032138#.
Please go see #b#p9000008##k and retrieve the real #b#t4032138##k. He probably already had it separated from the rest.
Are you here for that doll #p1103002# asked for, Ha? I can't give you the doll, ha! #p1103002# never paid for this, ha! If you can't pay for it, do something for me then, ha!
Inside the subway, there's a lot of #o1210103#, ha! I need you to get me some #b#t4032139#s#k from #r#o1210103##k, ha! If you can get me #b10#k of them, I'll give you the real #t4032138#, ha!
If you can't do it, then forget it, ha! I can't give you the doll for free!
You found the key, ha? Let me see... hmmm... this is good, ha! Let's trade that key for #t4032138#, ha!
Also, tell #p1103002# to pay his I.O.U.'s, ha!
Did you not find #b10 #t4032139#s#k, ha? You can easily find them through #r#o1210103##k in the subway, ha!

I kept going through the records, but I think we're pretty much done with our mission here in #m103000000#. Here's the written report, so I want you to take this and #t4032140# and hand them to #b#p1101002##k for me, okay?

I probably won't see you unless you receive another assignment here in #m103000000#. Based on the fact that you worked with me even with my rather unfriendly personality, I really think you'll become a great Knight. Don't be a stranger, okay?
#p1101002#! There's a Knight here that is really trying to coast through the assignment! Make sure to do things right before I really say these words to #p1101002#.
So it looks like you have completed the assignment in #m103000000#. There should be a report from #p1103002#... Yes, that's it.
With the report comes the doll, again. Does this mean the #rPuppeteer#k is the one in charge? Hmmm... ah, I suppose you haven't been filled in with details about this.

Based on the information we have gathered over the last few months, we managed to discover that one of Black Mage's men has the ability to control monsters through dolls. We don't know the exact name, and the Knights refer to him as just a Puppeteer.

I do believe that these events that have taken place recently are closely linked to that of the Puppeteer. We do not have a concrete evidence for that as of yet, so we need to dig for more information. Well, even if you do, you won't be able to face off against the Puppeteer with the level you're at right now, so I will most likely withhold from giving you the assignment anyway. I'll see you when you reach #bLevel 18#k.
Have you not gone to see #b#p1101002##k yet? What do you have to do here in #m103000000#? Just do whatever and hand in the report for me. Something just doesn't seem right.

Hmmm... What happened to your assignment in #m103000000#? If you have completed the assignment, you should have come back with the report that #p1103002# wrote up. Did you lose it by any chance? If you did, go back to #m103000000# and get another one from #b#p1103002##k.

Has your level gone up? I'm asking you this because I have a new assignment for you. This time, I want you to head over to #b#m101000000##k of Victoria Island. There, you should contact #bAgent #p1103003##k and help her gather up information on Black Mage.

This assignment came about because #p1103003# requested an emergency help. #p1103003# is #ba bit quirky, to say the least#k, but she is a capable agent who takes care of her business, so even if you find yourself puzzled by her actions, just follow her. That being said, finding #p1103003# itself will be quite a challange.
Okay, if you have something to take care of, then that's understandable. We'll see if you will become a bonafide Knight later on after your training stages are completed.

Who... who... who are you? Wait, I've seen you before. You're one of the new Knights featured on the list that #p1103001# gave me! You're the one that's going to help me here at #m101000000#! ...Wait! Don't look at me! The eyes of Black Mage might be spread out all the way up to here.
Back up a bit, then look the other way before talking to me. Do not raise your voice!
Have you not met #b#p1103003##k yet? She should be at #b#m101000000##k in Victoria Island. She's always suspicious of things, so it may not be easy to spot her...

You... are aware that there have been a number of unfortunate events related to the puppeteer, right? No one knows how these monsters are being controlled by a central power. Everything around here needs to be scrutinized and suspected. Come to think of it... don't you think #b#p1032100##k is a tad bit suspicious as well?

Arwen seems strange! Otherwise, how else can you explain the fact that she is always losing her glass shoes? A fairy who loves forest, and she's standing in #m102000000#! I think she's just doing that to disturb the great people of Maple. Maybe #rshe's being controlled by the Puppeteer#k! We need to look into this!

There's one way we can tell whether Arwen is controlled or not: #b#t4032142##k, which can only be purchased at #b#m101010103##k ... For an innocent Fairy, it works as a potent medicine, but for a devious character, it turns into a poison. Can you give that to Arwen for me?
If Arwen comes out unscathed from this.. Then great. If not... hahaha... like I said, everything that seems remotely suspicious must be investigated.
What? You don't want to do this with me? How can you say that? If Arwen winds up working for Black Mage, then will you take the full responsibility for this?

What is it? I am not fond of humans... wait, is that #t4032142#? Is that for me? I can't believe there's a human being out there that is sensitive enough to offer me something as great as this. I knew my beauty would work in the human world, as well.
Thank you. This will make my skin look 10 years younger. Yay!
#b(Arwen seems unaffected by it. Too unaffected.)#k
Haven't you gone to see Arwen yet? I thought I told you to find #t4032142# at #m101010103#, and give her the medicine.
What does a human need from me? Are you here to give me the glass shoes?
I think the plants at #m101000000# all seem suspicious! You know, the ones that grow from #b#m101010000##k.\n#b#L0#(...I can't believe she's completely neglecting to mention Arwen!)#l\n#k

Lately, the fruits from those plants seem stranger than before. It was right around that time where the fruits begin springing out from the plants. I just took a bite out of it and next thing I know, my body was burning and I eventually passed out! I am absolutely certain this is their attempt to assasinate me! We must investigate this fruit!

If you strike #bplants that grow in #m101010000##k, they'll drop some fruits every once in a while. If you can get me #b10 #t4032143#s#k, then we'll be able to find out if the Black Mage poisoned these fruits to kill us.

The plants look like this....

#i4032206#

Remember, it only works if you strike it with your regular attack!
How... how can you say that? My life is in danger here!
Did you bring #t4032143#? Hold on one second. Let me see this chart to check if any of them has any flaws.
...Eating fruits that grow around this time of the year may be subject to #rfood poisoning#k...

Were you not able to find #b10 #t4032143#s#k yet? Step out of #m101000000#, and you'll find a number of #bplants that resemble a fernbrake#k. #bStrike#k those plants with regular attacks, and #t4032143# will be dropped from those plants.

I don't know if you are aware of this, but the chief of #m101000000#, #p1032001#, used to lay his hands on a dangerous form of magic. These days, he steers clear from the past and moved on to become a wiseman, but since he does have a past, his name is always mentioned on the list.

I received a word that the Puppeteer may be connected to him. It is true that his forte used to be putting curses on the dolls, so it's not totally out of question, so I'd appreciate it if you can find out some more information on #p1032001#.

What? No, no. All the endings of this kind of story include a brave and handsome #bwarrior#k that comes to rescue the beautiful maiden in distress and defeats the monster! There still is a way!
Adventurer! It's up to you to complete this story with a happy ending! A warrior throwing himself to save the damsel is always heroic! You must take this role!

I must admit, the story unraveling is somewhat different from what I planned, but this has its own merits to it too. Adventurer... no I mean, warrior! Please defeat #rKing Clang#k, and save the damsel!
No, how could you?! How can you turn down a great role like this! You are no fun at all!
You've come back, warrior! I, #bRael#k, was worried sick over you and couldn't sleep at all! \r\n#L0# #b(Absorbed in the role already!)#l
Oh, I'm so happy to see you again. Thank you, thank you very much! How can I pay you for your deed? What? You don't need anything?\r\n#L0# #b(... I didn't say a word!!)#l
You are brave but also modest. You truly are a real warrior! I will never forget you name!
I will sing a song of a brave young warrior who never hesitated to rescue the beautiful island girl from the dreadful monster! Oh, how could you be so courageous?
You haven't defeated #rKing Clang#k yet? If it's a burden to you... you may back out, warrior. You don't need to throw yourself to save little old me... sniffle...
Did you say you have a letter to give me? I wonder where this letter's coming from...
She's back. I've heard of the rumors, but I guess she really is back.
I asked you to give this to Athena Pierce of Henesys. Have you not gone yet?
You told me you brought the letter, right? Now where is it?

Hey, you! Yes, you. What do you have in your hand there? I am 100% sure that paper in your hand is only used in the Captain's Room. What's that doing there in your hand?\r\n#b#L0# I picked it up from the trash can in the hallway.#l
From the trash can? Can you show me that? Hmmm... just as I thought. I'm sorry I suspected you of doing something else. Now that I know you're okay... can I ask you for a favor...?

This letter is written by Kyrin to Athena Pierce in Henesys. The two have a complicated history going on there, and... that's why I think Kyrin wrote it, but was never able to actually give it to her. I want you to take this letter, go to #bHenesys#k and give it to #bAthena Pierce#k.
I understand if you don't want to participate in this. It's a very personal matter, and I can understand if you don't feel comfortable partaking in it.

I can't thank you enough for giving me this. At least I know how Kyrin is doing these days. I am just proud that she came back to Victoria Island all grown up. It does seem like she's still dogged by her past, though...\r\n#b#L0# Her past?#l
It's a long story. Care to listen?
Since you served as a messenger, I should tell you what really happened. Please give me some time as I try to recollect and make sure I remember what actually happened. It's been so long...
You must be busy with something.
I'll have to go quite a while back. Kyrin's father is Testonen, a savior of Victoria who battled the Black Magician when Victoria and Ossyria broke into two separate lands.

Once Victoria found some peace, he asked me to take care of his newborn kid Kyrin before he left to track the Black Magician once more. That's how she ended up growing up here in Henesys. She was full of courage like her father, and she was also very capable of inventing things. Some of her inventions did end up causing chaos in this town, though. Hahaha...

One day, during one of the meetings between town chiefs, she overheard what happened to her father, and disappeared all of a sudden. I went to Ossyria, Victoria, Maple Island, and everywhere else looking for her, only to find my search attempts futile. After all these years, I didn't think she'd come back to Victoria Island, all grown up.
I'd really love to see her once more. I am sorry, but can you help me facilitate this meeting between her and myself?
Hmmm? You're here to give me an item from Athena Pierce?

Oh... this orgel... I can't believe she actually kept it after all those years... this orgel was my very first invention. Back when I was child, I would spend countless hours making this just for Athena Pierce...
I feel ashamed to have not summoned up the courage to meet her first. I better go pay a visit to Athena Pierce really soon.
I would really appreciate it if you can take this orgel and give it to Kyrin. She'll like it.
You lost it? No wonder... you dropped the orgel right here.
It's an item I cherish, so please don't misplace it again, and give it to Kyrin this time around.

I think Kyrin had been feeling guilty all this time about leaving Henesys without telling me. She shouldn't have felt that way, though. Can you help me give this item to Kyrin? If she sees this, maybe she'll summon up the courage to come visit Henesys after all these years.

Thank you so much. This is the orgel that she built when she was a kid. Her very first item, shall we say. She gave it to me as a present, and I've kept it after all these years. Please let #bKyrin#k know how much I miss her, and give this #borgel#k to her.
Ah... will that be too much for you? I'll have to look for other ways, then...
Uh... ummm... if you aren't too busy, then can you please help me? I really need your help... and I feel weaker by the second.

Thank you so much. I may look like a regular dolphin to you, but I am Sharyl, the prince of Whalians. It's hard for me to even stand right now because my mana has almost run out. Can you please get me one #bMana Elixir#k bottle?
Ah... please...so...weak...
Thank you! I can feel myself already getting better. Yeah!
Please get me 1 Mana Elixir bottle.
Oh... you must have felt the power of the Shining Stone. How was it? Doesn't it give you a major boost to your body?
The Shining Stone can be found in the Generator Room. Haven't found it yet?
The Shining Stone can be found in the Generator Room. Haven't found it yet?
You must be wondering why a prince would end up in a place like this. As the Prince of Whalians, my job is to stay here and control the Shining Stone.\r\n#b#L0# Shining Stone? What is that?#l

The Shining Stone is the source of power for The Nautilus. All the power that's required to move The Nautilus is generated from the Generator Room, where the Shining Stone is. Only the Whalians can control the power of the Shining Stone. We owe Kyrin a huge favor, and to repay the gratitude, we provide Shining Stone, and control its massive power. Now that you're here and all, do you want to experience the mystical power of Shining Stone?

The Shining Stone is located on the right of me, the #bGenerator Room of The Nautilus#k. Once you go there, you'll see my colleagues collectively controlling the power of the rock. Go down there, touch the #bShining Stone#k, and experience its powers. It'll be unlike anything you've ever experienced.
You're on board at The Nautilus. You might as well go experience the power of the Shining Stone...
I've already received word from Prince Sharyl. Can you give me the Magic Flask you received from him?
Collecting the Vigor of the Sea will require some time. Please wait for a bit.
You can find Muse at the Aquarium. Please get the Vigor of the Sea for me. Please....

What? You broke the Magic Flask? You'll really need to be careful with it, because it's made out of glass. I'll give you another one, so place fill up the flask with the Vigor of the Sea and bring it back to me.

Ah hello there! You must be the one that experienced the power of the Shining Stone before. Doesn't it seem like it's a bit darker here these days? It's that the ones that light up The Nautilus, the Water Fireflies, are getting weaker by the day.\r\n#L0##bWater Firefly?#k#l

Yes. Water Fireflies are these mysterious creatures that emit bright lights by consuming the Vigor of the Sea deep in the ocean. Once The Nautilus reached Victoria Island, they have never had a chance to go back under the deep sea, so their lighting has dimmed little by little. If you have some time to spare, can you get us some Vigors of the Sea for the sake of Kyrin and the fireflies?
Vigor of the Sea can actually be found through #bMuse of the Aquarium#k. Please fill up this Magic Flask with #bVigor of the Sea#k.
Are you busy? Oh no... what will we do...
The Magic Flask has been filled with Vigor of the Sea. Are you ready to return to The Nautilus?
Here it is. Please give this to Prince Sharyl ASAP.
Let me know when you are ready. The Prince seems to be in a hurry, so it'll be nice if you can get yourself ready fast.
Ahhh you brought it! The Nautilus will be dim no more!
I am sure Kyrin will be relieved of this. Hopefully she'll be happy with what's about to take place.
You haven't gone there yet? Please head back to The Nautilus immediately and hand this Vigor of the Sea to Prince Sharyl.
Still not ready?
Oh no... did you lose it?
Gathering the "Vigor of the Sea" requires a lot of work. It is that hard to obtain, so please don't misplace it again.
Ahh, you were the one that did me a huge favor the other day. I'm sorry I keep asking you this, but can you please help me out once more?
Thank you. A while back, I left a #bMother of Pearl#k inside the #bGenerator Room#k, and I am sure by now, it has a huge piece of pearl inside. I'd love to donate that pearl to Kyrin...

Please take the #bpearl#k and give it to Kyrin for me. I am way too shy to do this myself... and please let her know that Prince Sharyl picked it out because he thinks it'll look good on her. Thank you!
Before making your way to Kyrin, however, you should really watch out for #bMuirhat#k. He might stand in your way of getting this done.
I understand if you feel burdened by my constant requests. Who should I ask, then...
Wait, what's that pearl you have in your hand? \r\n#L0##b I'm here carrying out the Prince's order to give this to Kyrin.#k#l
Prince Sharyl?? Hmmm.... So you're saying Prince Sharyl ordered you to give that to Kyrin? \r\n#L0##b Is there a problem?#k#l

Hmm, the Prince should give it up right about now, yet he's still persistent. I bet even if Kyrin receives the pearl, she'll only get angry at him for that. Hand me the pearl. I better talk to Prince Sharyl about this myself.
The Prince will be saddened by this. For you to carry out a personal order like this, you must be very close to Prince Sharyl. Next time you see him, make sure to console him.
Please find the pearl and give it to Kyrin. I want nothing more than to see Kyrin smile. Just make sure not to be detected by Muirhat.
You're here on Rolonay's behalf? Oh thank you for this... please send him my gratitude.
Rolonay is really a genius. Look at this graph that depicts the relation between the wave of the alien's powers and the power of the ancient magicians. This is perfection!
Dr. Kim is at Omega Sector.
It's a very important & confidential report, and you lost it? The information inside cannot be made public...
I'll give you another copy for now. Please don't lose it again!
Ahhh, I'm so busy. Hey there, walking right past me. Are you busy right now? \r\n#L0##b Hey! Aren't you...???#k#l
...Wha...what? Ha...haven't you seen a pe...person wearing glasses and a beard? \r\n#L0##b Hmmm... you just looked suspicious...#k#l

I am busy right now, so let's talk about that some other time. Right now, I am in a major pinch, and I need your help. I need to turn in this report to Dr. Kim, yet I have so much stuff to do that I can't possibly get to Omega Sector right now. Can you please help me?
Thank you so much. I'll never forget this. Please gather up these reports and give them to #bDr. Kim#k.
You must be really busy. I see...
What? Baine noticed that, too?
I mean, I noticed something a few days back, too. Wait... there should be a document that contains the record of activities that day...the log...
You can find Bart at the observatory tower at the Nautilus Harbor. He spends his time with the seagulls.

Do you hear it? That strange noise that comes out of The Nautilus. Use this stethoscope, and you'll hear it. I've been working here for 10 years, and I've never heard anything like this. Can you find out what exactly happened?

Go to the #bharbor outside The Nautilus#k and walk towards East to find the #bobservatory tower#k. You'll find #bBart#k, there, and I have a hunch that he might have felt something. Please check and see if he's okay.
Maybe you don't hear that strange noise. Place your ear next to The Nautilus. Come on, just try it.

What? Is that true? So Bart detected something strange as well? Oh no... this is serious now. If that strange being is indeed a spy for the Black Magician, then this is going to throw the world upside down. I better read the report carefully!
Hmmm... I better start reading this report thoroughly.
I told you to take it to Baine.
For you to lose such a valuable item like that... you must be subpar at keeping things around. I'll give you another copy, but don't lose it this time.
Ah, here it is! Can you please give this to Baine for me?
This document is very important, and you must not lose it. Please give this to #bBaine#k.
It's not a hard task, but if you are too busy... there's nothing I can do.
Ah, you're back already. That was fast. Did you find the Black Magician's Token?

I knew it... I knew they were still in Victoria Island. I have a feeling they may want to collect more information on us. Good thing we noticed them before it was too late. In order for me to write up a report on this to Muirhat, I'll have to start writing up a report on the Black Magician.
You'll need to defeat 20 pigs and 20 red snails. You may be able to find some clues on the spies working for the Black Magician.
Were you not able to find the Black Magician's Token?
I have read through the report, and just as I suspected, the spies sent by the Black Magician seemed to have gathered some information about us. I believe this is only going to get worse.
I'll have to report this to Kyrin or Muirhat. I'll need some sort of concrete evidence that shows what Bart and I exactly saw... will you help us find it?
I am pretty sure they haven't left Victoria Island just yet. Based on their past actions, I think they are still around here...

There may be a token that one of the spies may have dropped around here. I am pretty sure one of the monsters around the area has it, so please defeat #r20 red snails and 20 pigs#k and bring the #btoken#k to me.
Is this too tough of a task to do? If you can help us out just a little bit, that would be... so helpful. Sigh... I guess I'll need to just report to Muirhat without them.
Did you just say the spies from the Black Magician? What? They are here, all the way to The Nautilus...?
Hmmm... if it is indeed as stated in the report, then this is a serious, serious issue...
Muirhat should be standing in front of the Captain's Room.
I can't believe you just lost that. I'll give you another copy of the report, as well as the token that someone else had picked up. Please don't lose them again.

Thanks to your help with the Black Magician's Token, I was able to complete the report much earlier than expected. I'll now have to give this report to Muirhat, but since you were the number one contributer with the Token and all, I think it's only fair that you hand in this report yourself. No?

If things end up working out because of the report, then you may become the hero of The Nautilus. Please hand it in to #bMuirhat#k. Muirhat can be found #bin front of the Navigation Room#k on the #bupper hallways of The Nautilus#k.

He can seem like a man of very few words, and you may feel like he'd be unapproachable. In fact, the opposite is true, so I suggest you summon up the courage and talk to him. I mean, you'll also take the lion's share of the praises if this all goes well. You have nothing to lose!
You don't seem to have the scroll I asked you to restore. If you want to receive another scroll to restore, forfeit and re-accept this quest.
Ah~ were you able to slay them?

That was incredibly fast. You're the kind of a prodigy that's hard to find in Victoria Island. I'll let Kyrin know of your outstanding job here. Everyone at The Nautilus will remember your job well done here.
Were you not able to eliminate the spy from the Black Magician yet? You may want to revisit the place I told you to go to.

Hmmm... this is a big problem. The spies sent by the Black Magician have been observing us for quite some time here. The problem is, this is not the first time they have been chasing our every move. I want this to be taken care of soon. Are you willing to do it?
Referring to Bart's report, the spies seem to be around this area. Hmmm... I'll send you to their hideout spot, and I want you to eliminate the #rBlack Magician's Disciple#k.

They are always in disguise, so they'll be very hard to detect. It's when they're tired that they transform back to their normal selves. I want you to really look carefully so you can spot the one and eliminate him.
I was hoping you'd be able to take care of this. Was I asking too much?

Sigh... what's with all this dust! I keep cleaning and cleaning, yet I don't see any difference whatsoever! Now my towel's about to be completely torn off... and now, it is. Oh no... what should i do...\r\n#L0##b Is there something going on there?#k#l

Sigh... look at this cleaning towel. I wiped away so much dust that it's already ragged and torn off. I don't have any spare with me... and yet, look at all this dust! How am I going to clean all this? Where can I find a spare cleaning towel?\r\n#L0##b Do you want me to find one for you?#k#l
Oh, that's very nice of you! Will you do that?

I hear that the Ribbon Pig on Victoria Island wears a ribbon with such a tightknit fabric that it's very good for soaking up dusts. I would love for you to get me #b50 Ribbons from the Ribbon Pigs#k. I know it's a lot, but I think I'll go through that quickly, too.
Look at all this dust! Don't tell me I don't need a cleaning towel right this minute... well, but if you don't clean, this doesn't matter much to you.
That was fast! Let's see, did you bring all 50?
1, 2, 3,...., 50. That's it! That's it! How can I thank you for this? I love it so much that, even if you mess this place up a bit, I will just let it slide.
I said 50 Ribbons. If you can get me more, that would be suuuuper.
Ahhh, all the squeakings from the rats. I can't stand it! Hey, aren't you the one that got me some ribbons from the Ribbon Pigs? Haha, good to see you!\r\n#L0##b Is there something going on again?#k
Kids these days catch on pretty quickly. You've helped me last time, and... can you help me once more?

The Nautilus usually was on the water, so you don't even sniff a rat around here... but ever since we came here, since the ship is in direct contact with the land, I see rats here and there, and that really bothers me. Shulynch saw one yesterday, and she almost fainted!
I hear that the Ratz from Ludibrium give out #bRat Trap#k, and if you can get me some, I will love you for it. I just need #b50#k.
Will that be too much for you? Sigh... what am I going to do with all these rats?
Hohoho! You're fast, just like the last time!
Now how am I going to set up these 50 rat traps? Anyway, I like how young people like you take care of things so quickly. Hahaha.
Ahhh, did you forget your promise already? I need 50 rat traps, and you can get them from Ratz in Ludibrium.
Hahaha... hey there, kid. Can I ask you for one. More. Favor? \r\n#L0##b Wait a minute... what's this smell???#l#k

Sigh... if you see Jack, you know how he smells. Seriously, I have never, ever seen him wash up once in my life. Jack has been on board for 10 years now, and even if I clean and clean and clean some more, Jack's disgusting footprints leave a mark everywhere. I need to wash him up... and I need your help. Can you help me one last time?

Ahhh, thank you so so much. If you go waaaay down to Sleepywood, you may be able to get some #bpure water#k... and I want you to get one bottle of it, and pour it on #bJack#k. Just so he can be a tiny bit cleaner than he was earlier today.
I know, I know, I keep asking you for favors. I understand if you are busy right now.
Hehe, who are you? What's that in your hand? Is that food?\r\n#L0##b Hi there, are you Jack? (OMG... he really smells...)#k#l

Sniff sniff... my hair itches. (Scratches his head) let me see what you have in your hand. It looks like something I can drink... \r\n#L0##b I am really sorry, but just stand still for a second! (Sprays water all over him.)#k#l
Whoa! That's cold!

Sniff sniff... what are you trying to do? Did... Mrs. Reade order you to do it? Hahaha... this will not make me do what she wants me to do? Why do I have to wash up? I mean, the nature takes care of me, and I'll be naturally clean after a while...
Man, you only got my shirt wet! Oh well, it's going to dry up in a bit, right? Hahahah... oh man, my back's itching...
(Oh my... even with that impromptu shower session, there's no change whatsoever!)
Please spray that Pure Water over Jack. If that'll help him get JUST A BIT CLEANER...
Oh no! Our food! Those darn pigs came in late at night and ate our food again! Hey you there, help me out here. I don't see a lot of people crossing path, so that's why I'm asking you for help.

Phew, you're a much nicer kid than I thought. What I want is for you to eliminate some #rpigs#k and #rRibbon Pigs#k around the area. Those hungry creatures always come in to our food storage area and eat some overnight. If this keeps happening, we'll all be starving soon. That's why I want you to eliminate some of those dastardly creatures. #b30 each#k. I can't wait!
Ah... young kids these days... sigh...
Ahhh... what should I make for dinner... hey, you're back!
You were able to eliminate it already. That's amazing! Oh, to be young again! Thanks to you, those pigs won't be sniffing around the food storage area anytime soon.
Please teach 30 pigs and 30 Ribbon Pigs a lesson, so they won't ever sniff around the food storage again.

Hmm hmm.. Hey! I saw you just walking by! Thanks to your great work, those pigs haven't been sniffing around ever since. Thank you so much! Hahahha... I cooked something for you in return... and... here, try it.\n\r#L0##b Whaaaaaaat! (Is this really... the Dragon Special that I've only heard of in storybooks??? Oh my goodness...)#k#l
Hahaha! Isn't it delicious? That's what everyone says when they try my food. Now that you've tasted the heavens, can you help me out once more?
Yes yes, I like your attitude. I need to make food for everyone on board, and I am out of milk. Please fill this bottle up with milk.

For fresh ingredients, I raise a number of milk cows at the corner of this ship. Go there, and milk some from the cows. Lately, we've seen a number of baby cows being born, and... those kids sure can eat, so please be careful. If you leave the bottle in front of them, they'll just drink it all...

Oh, and you can only fill up 1/3 of this bottle from one cow. If you try to milk more, there won't be any left for the babies, so... once you're ready to hit the stable, let me know. I'll take you there.
Were you not that impressed with my food?
Ohhh! Fresh milk! What do you think about the stable? Isn't it amazing?
Haha... thanks to your help, the crew will be feasting tonight. Thank you, and if you ever find yourself hungry, come by and I'll make you something delicious. Hahahah!
Didn't I tell you to fill up the whole bottle with milk?
Hello, traveler? Are you here at the Generator Room to see this rock? Isn't Shining Stone amazing? And the Whalians that control the rock... they're amazing too, right?
Since you've made your way all the way down here, can I ask you for a favor? Not many people pass through this area, and we're in a bit of trouble right now.

The Whalians here don't eat what the normal people eat. They eat something that can only be found in the sea. They always ate that, but... now that we've spent a considerable amount of time here on land, the ingredients have run out.

My cousin Kenta, who lives in Aquarium, can make something for them. That's why I am here to ask you for a favor. Can you send this letter that I wrote about that food to #bKenta#k? You can find him at the Aquarium Zoo.
I guess you don't have time to help me. Who should I ask, then?
You're here to give me a letter? It's from Porchay?
Oh... so it's about the special food that the Whalians eat. They only eat certain things, so... let's see if there's any left.
You can find Kenta at the Aquarium.
Kenta is at the Aquarium Zoo, watching over the animals.
Did you lose the letter? Oh no... I'll write you another one. Don't lose it again, okay?
Now, please give this letter to Kenta.
Ah, you are back! All I have to do now is to dump in the Sea Horse Tails in here, and the food will be ready.
Okay, now let's dump them in. See what happens.
I don't think you have 40 Sea Horse Tails. I can't cook this thing if I don't have all 40 of them...
Oh no... I am actually missing one of the ingredients... the Sea Horse Tails... what should I do...
Ahh, you're willing to find some for me? Thank you so much! The #bSea Horse Tails#k can be found through #bSeacle#k. You can find them all over Aquarium. Can you get me 40 of them?
You must be running out of time. I am just glad you made your way all the way here to give me this letter.
Oh you're back! I've been waiting for you!
Wow! Kenta sure cooked up a feast! I can just imagine the Whalians smiling at the thought of eating this. Thank you so so much!
Please take this feast and give it to Porchay. She seemed to need it right this minute, so please hurry your way back to her.
What you lost it?? I have some spare, but please don't lose it again.
Here's the feast. Can you please take this and go deliver it to Porchay?
Here it is! Give this to #bPorchay#k, and please let her know that if she ever runs out again, all she needs to do is let me know, and I'll make some for her.
I guess you don't need to go to Victoria Island yet. Yes, it is a long way from here.

I heard it from Black Bark already. Seriously, he asks for favors first, then thinks about it. Sigh... I am busy preparing for this festival... if he wasn't an old friend of mine, then the answer would have been no...
Yeah, that's 40 tablecloths all right. Okay, time to make a dress!
Mrs. Ming Ming is at Henesys.
I don't think you have 40 tablecloths, and without them, I can't make a dress.
Hey hey there! Are you aware that Kyrin's birthday is coming up! Seriously, to see her all grown up now, that is just astounding. Seriously!

That's why a few days ago, the crew voted and we decided the best birthday present for her would be a dress. Yes, I've seen her for a long long time, and I have honestly never seen her wear a feminine dress. That's why I asked my dear friend Mrs. Ming Ming for help, and... the problem is, we don't have the materials! Can you get some for us?

Hahaha... unlike most people, you seem nice and diligent. That's very commendable! I knew you were a capable member of the crew at The Nautilus! In order to make the dress, we'll need a thin, white cloth with good quality, and I heard that the tablecloth from Jr. Wraith is the best one available. I want you to acquire #b40 tablecloths#k and give them to #bMrs. Ming Ming#k.
Hmmm... that was cold.
Ahh, you're back! Let's see the dress!

Ohh... she still has it. This dress is just beautiful! The crew will be in awe when they see this. You should also drop by for the birthday party, you know. Don't you want to see how she looks like in that dress you hand-delivered?
Please deliver the dress to Black Bark. You didn't forget it, did you?
Good thing I have an extra dress that I made with spare materials. It took me a lot of time and effort to make this. Don't lose it again!

Okay, good thing I have started on the basic stuff already, because I am done with the dress now! Please give this to Black Bark, and tell him... that I'll be charging him for this dress shortly. Hahahaha!
Please make sure that this dress doesn't get wrinkled, and since the fabric is very thin, it may get ripped. I suggest you deliver this to #bBlack Bark#k now. He hates waiting...

Are you avoiding Black Bark because he scares you? He may look intimidating, but ... he hasn't even held a girl's hand yet. Hahaha... not even my hands back in the day... hey, what am I saying? HAha....
My glasses are horn-rimmed. Please find it for me.
My glasses... my glasses...\n\r#L0##b Is something wrong? Did you drop something on the ground?#k#l

Ahhh, please don't come near me! My glasses might have been dropped somewhere, and you don't want to step on them! Are my glasses around there? A black horn-rimmed pair of glasses...\n\r#L0##b No, I don't see any glasses around here...#k#l

Man... I told Bart so many times not to take my glasses. He likes shiny objects, so he'd take it while I am asleep... and each time that happens, the seagulls seem to take it from him. I am legally blind without them, so... can you go up to the Observatory Tower and find my glasses?

Thank you so much. My glasses are like another pair of my eyes. Without them, I can't see anything. Like I said, I am legally blind without them. I can't even recognize your face. It's just a blur to me.
Mine's a black, horn-rimmed glasses. My eyes are so bad without them that I can't see anything in front of me, so please find it!

You can find the #bObservatory Tower#k by #bheading right all the way#k. You'll see Bart and those seagulls in flocks, so it won't be hard for you to find my #bglasses#k. Please bring them back to me!
