Hmmm... I apologize for making you wait. I'm glad there's someone out there eager to listen to my story. Here's the deal.

I cannot talk to you about my life story without mentioning the Family, which has been with me through thick and thin for the past 30 years. Before that, I was a stubborn explorer who wanted to travel alone and take care of things myself. I was a good enough fighter to save my town and slay a giant monster with horns all by myself. And then... one day, that all changed.

After battling a three-headed giant of a monster for over a week, I needed some time to recuperate. That's when I saw two young, green explorers that seem to have just completed their job advancements battling the same monster. They seemed to be constantly on the ropes and on the verge of death...\nIn the end, when the monster avoided their attacks and was getting ready to finish them off, I threw two bottles of expensive potions at them to save them from certain death. That's when I had an epiphany.

Ah! There are lots of explorers out there that aren't as skilled as I was... I can't leave them like that! That's when I made up my mind to help those two out. I called those two #bJuniors#k, since it was kind of like me taking care of them as only a parent would, and they started calling me #bSenior#k in response.

I taught those two everything I learned as an explorer, and I gave them the weapons and items they needed to survive in this world. Was it worth it? Oh yes. They used my weapons and potions to achieve greatness in their own rights, so my reputation went that much higher. How can I save money by not giving them the total support they deserve?

Soon, they started raising Juniors of their own, and other explorers started calling me #bCaptain Al#k and referred to my Family as the #bAl Family#k. Let me tell you, we were that much more powerful than other exploreres! We were already well-known in the world of Maple, and with our rising fame and rep, we were able to enjoy the #rEntitlement#k as well...

This Entitlement is really something to behold. If you ever get a chance to enjoy these Entitlements yourself, you'll surely feel sorry for those that aren't. Hmm, anyway, I took my Family all over the place exploring, but I made one crucial mistake, and that was huge enough for me to lose their trust in me.

I fell for the devious spell of the Black Magician and I was unable to emerge from it for 11 years! Without my help, my Juniors started experiencing numerous problems and in the end, they decided to part ways and searched for the Senior that would be there for them. If you become the Leader yourself, you'll need to make sure not to repeat the problems I made, like leaving the Juniors out in the cold. Understood?

I appreciate you listening to my long story. I am here right now, trying to make up for the colossal mistake I made in the past, and looking for capable Juniors to support while sharing my experiences as a Senior to explorers like you. I sincerely wish your Family well. Did you enjoy my story?
I strongly suggest you start your own Family as well. If you wish to start one later, let me know. Until then, best of luck to you.
Hmmm... come back to me when you're ready.
Hello there, #b#h0##k! I am #bCaptain Al#k, who's been a Leader of the Family for 30 years. Are you here because you're curious to find out who I really am?
Hmmm, you are one explorer that is fearless. I like that. I like the fact that you are straight-forward. I'm ready to share with you my 30 years of experience as the leader of a Family.

Just know that... we're talking about 30 years worth of stories. The last thing I want to do is meander into the unknown and get lost in my train of thoughts, so please give me a little bit of time. Just a little bit. My stories will be unlike anything you have ever heard anywhere else, so I want you to be ready to soak it all in. Let me know when you are ready to listen.

Good good, I like how active you are in this front. Of course, it's not a guarantee that you will become the Leader, but... if you wish to start a Family, you'll need to learn a few things. The most important thing you'll need to understand is the relationship between the #bJunior#k and the #bSenior#k.

#bJunior#k is a character you'll be sponsoring. Yes, the character is probably going to be below you in level, but you cannot be more than 20 levels higher than your Junior. In order to add one, #rpress Add Jr. on the Family window [HotKey : F]#k or #rFamily Pedigree#k. Once the person you've entered as the Junior agrees to it, that character becomes your Junior.

This is when you become the #bSenior#k. If you do not have a Senior of your own, then you can be the Leader of the Family, but a Leader is really no different from that of a Senior. \nA Senior's responsibility is to fully support his or her Juniors, and by doing so, you'll be able to increase your Rep. If the Senior neglects to take care of the Junior, then the Junior will most definitely leave the Senior and search for a Senior that will provide proper support. Please be aware that providing support is not limited to providing money or items; rather, you should pay attention to how the Juniors are doing exploring the world of Maple.

But as time passes, the power of the seal is getting weaker and weaker. Balrog, the Prince of Darkness, is going to reemerge any day now. Oh, young adventurer, please save Maple World from evil. Please.

I know he wouldn't trust just anyone with something like this. If you were sent by my master, I assume you are one heck of an adventurer and I can really use your help. Will you help me?

20 pieces of Balrog Leather.

Brave adventurer, the aura of evil is spreading throughout the entire underground dungeon. Our job right now is to prevent Balrog from reviving until he finally gives up. This is easier said than done, but I know you'll be able to pull through if you are a true warrior. What do you say?

Your job is to stop Balrog from reviving. If you can stop him 200 times, you will be known as a true warrior of Maple World. If you can accomplish this mission, I will accept you as my successor. Believe in yourself. I am counting on you, young adventurer.
I appreciate that you're thinking things through carefully, but we don't have much time.
Why are you coming back? Keep defeating Mearkats!
Your level is still a bit low; You should be at least Lv. 30 in order to handle the truth about this place!
I am ready to leave! Thank you so much, I will never forget what you've done for me!
I have good news for everyone! Happyville is holding a grand party to celebrate Maplemas! Are you interested?
Haha, I knew you would. For more details, you should go talk to Rooney.
Oh really? It's going to be really fun! That's too bad, but... if you want to change your mind, just let me know!
You must be eager to know what the party is all about. Here are the details. Ready?
It's a dress-up party that takes place in Happyville during the whole Maplemas period.

Go to Happyville, and you'll find a house with a huge chimney. The only way you can enter the house is actually through the chimney. The way you're dressed up right now, however, you won't be allowed in at all. You must be transformed into a new state.

You can get the transformation potion from Cliff in Happyville. I hear that if you give him 50 #t4032176#s, you'll be able to trade in for that potion. It'd be a good idea for you to have it prepared before seeing him.
Now hurry before you miss out on the party...
Please go see Rooney for more details on the Maplemas party.

Ho! You must be here for the party. Yes, it's one of the bigger parties I've ever seen around here. In order to enter the party, however, you'll need something. Will you help me with one thing, so you can get that item you'll need to enter the party?

Then please gather up 50 Rascal Snowpieces from the monsters. I have a feeling someone that despises Maplemas decided to pull a prank on everyone with that. The monsters have gotten much worse these days...
I guess you are not interested in the party. I understand... the older you get, the less interested you become with the parties.
You brought everything I need. Great! Let's get this started.
Here's the potion. Drink this, and you'll be transformed into a completely different state for one hour. Of course, you can also switch back to your original state midway through. Enjoy the party!
You may want to hurry up and get me those snowpieces... if you don't want to miss the party.

Hey there, #b#h0##k. My name is Snow Spirit. It's that time of the year again here in Happyville. Maplemas is coming, and the whole town is eager to enjoy the festivities. One person, however, seems intent on ruining all that for us. Have you heard about Scrooge and his plans? He is trying to take away our Maplemas, and he is currently holed up somewhere hatching a plan to do just that. I don't understand why he'd want to do such a terrible thing... but since I am the protector of Happyville, I am here to ask you for help in our mission to defeat Scrooge and save Maplemas. Would you like to join me?

Great! I knew you'd volunteer to help out. Now allow me to explain to you what we do for Maplemas here in Happyville. Every year, the residents of Happyville get together and hold a festival in preparation for Maplemas by creating one giant snowman. On the eve of Maplemas, the residents will gather up in front of the snowman, say their prayers, and make new year's resolutions as well. (Shhh... this is just between you and me, but while the residents say their prayers, I cast a spell on them for good luck.) Anyway, the good people here have been very busy making the giant snowman in hopes of successfully celebrating the biggest holiday of the year, but... there's this man named Scrooge... he lives a world away here, and he's trying to hatch a plan to ruin our Maplemas. He had already been banned from Maple World for various offenses, he once tried to cook the Easter Bunny, and even got in a fight with Cody. The problem is... he somehow found his way into Happyville, without anyone knowing. His plan is to remove the giant snowman and ruin the holidays for everyone here. This is why we must alert this to Alcaster in El Nath! He's very wise, and he will figure out the best way to handle this crisis. Unfortunately, I can't leave this place, but El Nath isn't too far from here, so I am sure you can make your way there and let him know in place of me. Good luck.
Ahhh... #b#h0##k, without your help, Maplemas this year will be ruined for everyone here in Happyville. Please reconsider!

Hmm... how can I help you...? ... What do you have in your hand? That must be from Snow Spirit. Something did not seem right the past few days, and... unfortunately, I may have been right. Okay, please hand me the note immediately.
Thank you. Now let's see what's written here.
Oh no! Please hand the note to Alcaster immediately! He's in El Nath, and we don't have much time! Thanks!

Oh, this is not good. Scrooge is back?! We cannot let him steal the hopes and dreams of the good residents of Happyville... That just cannot happen... now hold on for minute... here's the letter I want you to give to Snow Spirit. Please help us one more time by seeing her immediately and hand her this letter. Will you?
Thank you. I'll be counting on you. The fate of Happyville and Maplemas lies in your hands. Good luck.
Hmmm... I did not expect you to say no, but... since you're already here to help us, wouldn't it only make sense to help us once more? Please reconsider.
I have been waiting for you, #b#h0##k! How was Alcaster doing? Oh... okay... yes... I knew he would write back! Let me see what he wrote.

Thank you so much for your help. We will be able to protect Happyville with this. Let me see what it says. (After finishing the letter, she starts thinking for a bit...) #b#h0##k... I want you to listen carefully to what I am about to say. First, take this Force of the Spirit. This is the key to defeating Scrooge.
Did you not go see her yet? Happyville is rather easy to find. Just find Rooney and ask her to take you to Happyville.

...Woe is me... I promised to make my wife this flower called the Red Dahlia, but I can't gather the materials-the creatures are too strong. I need someone to head out and gather them for me. It's very special flower, and I'm sure you could do it.
Excellent. Bring me back #b30 Stiff feathers#k and #b3 Diamond Ore#k and I can give you something I found that may help you...
That's unfortunate... if you run into anyone who's brave and wants to help someone in love, send them my way.
Wow! You got them all! I can't wait to see the look on my wife's face when she sees the flower. Thank you so much! As promised, I have something for you, I hope you like it!
Thanks again for all your help, the Red Dahlia turned out great!
Hard at work, I see! I'll need #b30 Stiff Feathers#k and #b3 Diamond Ore#k. You're almost there, keep going and return to me when done!
Hi there! If you have a moment to spare, could I ask you for a favor?

Thank you...my husband, Richard, is a sailor on Tae Gong's ship over in Aqua Road. He works all the time and I do love him, but I barely get to see him. I would like to send a few things to him, but I don't know how to fight. I'll need you to gather #b25 Soft Feathers#k and bring them to him on the boat along with the letter I wrote for him. If you do so, I'll have something nice for you when you get back.
Darn... oh well. I guess I'll have to find another brave fighter to help me then...
Howdy, I'm working, so I only have a second to talk. Oh... are you from Angelique? My buttercup always loves to send me things. Let me see what you've got there.

Awesome! Angelique always sends me the goods. And what is this ... a letter? Ah ... such a romanticist even after all these years. It's things like this that brings joy to my otherwise mundane life at work. Thanks!
Thank you so much!
That's funny, it looks like you haven't got everything yet. Could you hurry? I want Richard to get it soon.
My wife would want me to have more than what you have in your bag... come back when you've got everything!

You're back! And he got everything ok? Fantastic. And ... what is this ... oh a letter? Awww ... whenever I write him a letter, he always follows up with a sweet letter of his own. Great~ As promised, here's your reward. It should come in handy during your adventures.
Again, I thoroughly appreciate your help. I hope you have a safe journey. Here's wishing you good luck!
Haven't you met my wife yet? Go ahead... Hurry up!
You must be miss something, right?
I've been working on this love letter for Angelique, could you do me a favor and deliver it to her?
Thanks again! Don't get hurt!
Oh, really? Well, okay then. I need to get back to work now, but if you need me, I'll be right here.
OUTSTANDING! I knew you were special the second I looked at you. \n\n#L0##bI have a question. So... you were a Thief?#k#l

The very best. I trained under the Dark Lord's watchful eye for many years. Once you train past a certain point, fighting becomes second nature. \n\n#L0##bHow did the Dark Lord let you leave? I've never heard of that before...#k#l

It's a long story, but The Dark Lord allowed me to leave if I touched him once with my weapon. It's much different from fighting his clone, his speed and multiple techniques are incredible. The fight was a true test of my skill...it was a stroke of luck that let me touch him. I promised to help others train as he helped me. \n\n#L0##bDid Icebyrd have anything to do with that?#k#l

In a way, yes. He showed me that my destiny is here, in New Leaf City, and to a greater extent, Masteria. It's a brave new world out there...and I want to know where my fate lies. Ok. End of the story. It's time to get paid for your work!
Here's your class reward, as promised. I'm proud of you! You can come and see me anytime you wish perform your duty as a citizen of New Leaf City!
Come on, you're not done yet, but I have faith. You can do it!

Hiya Sport! I'm the new sheriff in town. You ready for some law and order? 

#L0##bOnly if I get to help enforce it!#k
#L1##bLaw? Order? Please. You couldn't tame a fly. I'm leaving!#k#l
That's the attitude that got me where I am today! Ok, I'm Lita Lawless, and with your help, I'm going to corral this town into a crime-free zone.
Grumpy little thing, aren't you?

I know how the devious monster mind works, having trained as a pirate for many years. So, you're going to have to wipe out #b200#k of two types-I believe #bElectrophants and Gryphons#k should prove a suitable test of your skills! Take your time and report back when you're done! I've got something just for your class!
Grumpy little thing, aren't you?

Grumpy little thing, aren't you?
Congrats! I knew you wouldn't let me down. I will give you a reward.
Here's your reward. Let's move on to the next stage!
You don't have what I've asked you for. Please get me a #bMap to MV's Lair#k. I think you will be able to find it in a pile of stones. Good Luck!

Hello, Maplers! I am part of a band of heros, sworn to protect the Maple World from outside threats. There are only a few of us, but we've stopped countless plots in the shadows...until now. I arrived to tell you about a madman known as "Mal Volance", or for short,"MV". He used to be a part of our group, and was a fine hero, but he has betrayed us, and seeks to cause anarchy rather than order. We're not sure how it happened, he seems to be under the influence of some strange, even demonic force. He conspires to attack the Maple World, only to cause anarchy and chaos. I'm positive that he's plotting something nefarious, and I need your help to stop him.

The thing is... I first need to test if you are ready to encounter him. He's no pushover, after all. As a simple test, you must search for the secret letters that contain information about "MV". After completing the search of secret letters, you will obtain a #bMap to MV's Lair.
Can you get those items for me please? You will be rewarded, of course.
Excellent! Then, please find and bring me a #bMap to MV's Lair.#k You will need to find the #rsecret letters#k from the piles of stones. I will move you to the first stage. Good Luck!
Are you sure? I mean... If I were you, I wouldn't have missed this chance, but I get what you mean. Feel free to come talk to me anytime if you change your mind.
Oh my! You guys really eliminated #o9400589#! I mean.. I knew you wouldn't let me down. I will give you a reward as I promised.
Outstanding! Here's your reward. You have earned my trust!
Did you eliminate #b#o9400589##k? I understand that he's a very powerful monster.. but.. I know you guys can do this!
Hello, Maplers! Good to see you again. For this quest, you need to eliminate the madman called "#rMV#k". You'll need at least 3 friends to tackle this formidable foe. Do you want to do it?
Great! I will move you guys down to the place for the quest soon. Get ready and good luck!
Are you sure? I mean... If I were you, I wouldn't have missed this chance, but... anyway, I get what you mean. Feel free to come talk to me anytime if you change your mind.
Sparkle-twinkle, Bling-bling, the glitter of treasure always fascinates me! Hello there, I'm the famous treasure hunter, Lara. What am I up to? I came here in search of the treasure, #rMV's Sabre#k.
Well, now I'm currently looking for a person who can find it. It is in the #bMV's Treasure Dungeon#k. Are you the brave traveler who will help me?

I knew you would! Now listen carefully, I will tell you about the treasure dungeon. The place is well known to house notorious monsters that guard the treasure. I suggest you prepare enough potions and healing items before you go inside.
You will be able to see the treasure boxes from the vault on the top floor. I just need you to bring me one Sabre. Take care of yourself and good luck!
Don't be ridiculous! I promise I will give you something in return, so talk to me when you reconsider my offer.
Oh yes! That looks like #rhis sabre#k! Thank you so much. Just a second! I will give you one item from my personal collection.
There you go. Do you like my gift? I have many more gifts, so be sure to come back before you enter the treasure dungeon!
Eh.. I don't see any sparkle-twinkle, bling-bling on your hands. Are you sure you brought me what I asked for?
You've done a great job for me! Thank you! Thank you! Don't be shy, take your rewards. You've earned them!
Many treasure hunters shall be thankful to you, but come back soon, you never know when the monsters will return.
Not enough, I want you defeat more monsters! I hope you understood me correctly this time.

Hello there, I have a severe headache these days and you know what's troubling me? The guard dogs of the treasure dungeon! Huskies and Brown Puppies might be a Mapler's best friend, but the guard dogs down there are everyone's enemy! So, are you going to help me? Please?

Alright, soon you will understand why I'm making such a fuss about those fleabags. I still have the bitemarks on my butt! It hurts! Nothing like kneeling down to pick up a nice shiny object and catch a pair for fangs for your trouble! Now I've had enough! I've used all kinds of bait--meat, fish, and even doggie treats but none of them worked! This is a job for someone strong...you!

Heh, I'd heal faster if you defeat #r50#b Skel Guard Dogs#k, #r30#b Mummy Guard Dogs#k, and #r10 #bAngry Guard Dogs#k. They are guarding MV's treasure in the Treasure Dungeon. Get yourself prepared and jump into the portal above. Good luck!
You will be sorry if you hear the reason why I'm only standing here. Talk to me again if you want to help!
#b\r\n#L0#Hey Icebyrd. Got a second?#k
For you? Always. I can't thank you enough? Masteria wouldn't exist without you!#b\r\n#L0#Thanks Icebyrd, but I want to know something.#k
Fire away.#b\r\n#L0#What does all this mean? You mentioned so many things the last time we spoke...I have a feeling there's something you're still not telling me.#k

Perception can always sense an unseen target. Sometimes I wonder about the paths we take, the decisions we make. Is our fate something we can truly change? Or are we merely doomed to repeat the actions of history? This question is what originally led me here...and I received an answer that led to my sacrifice in establishing New Leaf City. I was sworn to secrecy until the truth could be revealed. As you have proved yourself time and time again, you have earned my trust as well as someone else's. I will tell you why I established New Leaf City.

I remember waking up in a different place...and a being of light spoke to me. It called itself #b‘Subani'#k and offered me a chance to help stop the coming reign of terror. #bSubani#k told me that a mystic anchor was needed to bring a fabled lost continent back from the realm of #bVersal#k, a world which could not be helped, as the being was too powerful. The one condition was that I could never leave the continent. Ever. I agreed without hesitation.

I remember way back, when I still lived in Kerning City; I had a dream...or perhaps a nightmare. I saw everything working in a twisted sense of order, everyone in the Maple World had a vacant look upon their face, and the sky itself had turned black. I saw a terrifying beast, large, powerful, with endless arms. I saw pure misery - nothing could match its strength. It had taken over the Maple World. I remember seeing my friends as slaves to this horrible beast, and I remember the voice which told me I could stop it.

The next thing I knew, I stood in this very spot. Subani helped me construct the city, the spirit's light growing dimmer with each task of strength. Finally, when the city was finished, Subani told me that I could not tell a soul of what I knew, until the time was right. I had to let things happen as if I knew nothing. Then, Subani was gone...vowing to return when most needed. To see you standing here before me proves that you have the strength, courage and honor to be a new hero of Masteria. The storm is still coming, but I like our chances with you around.
So relax for the time being, you've certainly earned it. I have a feeling our adventures here are just getting started!

I want to thank you. You've been pushed to your limits in helping us, and shown you're a true Urban Warrior. As my way of saying thanks, I want you to have this chair. Check it out, and be sure to come back anytime you want. New Leaf City wouldn't be here without you! \n\n#L0##bSo, about that favor you mentioned...#k#l
We're tight, but not that tight yet. I'll tell you in time though... \n\n#L0##bI've noticed the city has quite a bit of diversity!#k#l
Yes. I felt it'd be best to be a little different. Masteria is a big place, and while we're only just starting, I have a feeling we're in for one wild ride! \n\n#L0##bWhat's up with you and Lita?#k#l
We're very good friends, but nothing more. She's a tough one, though! \n\n#L0##bJohn and Elpam both mentioned another world, Versal. What do you know about this?#k#l
Well, there's a rumor that a portal can be opened somehow from within the city, but I'm not sure how that's possible. \n\n#L0##bWhat do you mean? You built this city.#k#l

Correction-I rebuilt this city. The foundations are still there, as is some of the technology; you've probably seen some of it when you were outside the city. There's some stuff that just works, and I don't mean the Foxwit Doors themselves-I mean the energy that powers them. Foxwit is a genius and some of that is way beyond even his understanding. I'm a bit wary of using it all, just because of the old tales of Masteria-the immortal warriors, a mad scientist, a threat from the stars, some of their legends are pretty heavy stuff. In addition to that, this is where Subani and Naricain are originally from. Not the city, another region of Masteria. John probably mentioned that. \n\n#L0##bJust level with me, Icebyrd. Tell me what you know.#k#l

Ok, but keep this a secret, don't want people panicking. The Masteria of old was a sprawling utopia, one far advanced in technology. However, their ambition far outstripped their control of the technology, and there was an accident. Masteria, the great land, finally fell into the sea, its secrets lost forever. Until now. I made a deal with someone to raise the continent, and establish the city in the ruins of Olde Sapp Village. He brought my dream to life, and it cost me next to nothing. And that's where we are now. However, the city has many, many secrets that even I don't know about. Tread carefully; you never know what can open up... \n\n#L0##bOk, I know what how it was raised, but who raised it? What did you have to do?#k#l

That's a bit personal, but I will say this-if there's ever a time when you need to know more, I'll tell you. Until then, don't worry about it. That burden is mine alone to bear. For now, just let me give you a gift for the appreciation of helping our city.
Where did I put it... Just give me a second and talk to me, ok?
I want you to have this chair. Check it out, and be sure to come back anytime you want. New Leaf City wouldn't be here without you!
Looks good! Just give it a try and sit on it sometimes!

I'll tell you why I'm angry.\n\nWhen I visited Perion awhile back, I received a traditional Statue of Perion as a gift of friendship. That was pretty common back then, since the two towns had built a very co-dependent and caring relationship. But the problem followed immediately after that.

And my story ends here.
I have another favor to ask of you, so come back and talk to me when you're ready.
Anyway, I want to find out who it was that attacked me. Will you help?

Why hello there! It's nice to see that you're still alive. Yes, I decided to clean up the dust around this place. Joe is still paying me after all. This is the only untidy room left, so you've found me at the right place. Fair enough. I have good news and bad news. What would you care to hear first?

Very well. Let's start with the bad news. There is a monster, a ghost that is lurking around in some corner of this house. But upon her return, she found Master Jonas and his family had long been dead, so she directed her wrath instead to all of Maplekind. From my understanding, she had composed all sorts of traps. But thanks to you, we no longer have to fear.

Anyway, here is your reward, as promised. It is #bOlivia's Chair#k. Sit on it, give it away, or use it for firewood. Whatever the case, I'm just glad you didn't become a victim of this cruel twist of fate. What a tragic story. It really is.
I will give you Olivia's Chair if you give me #r20 Cursed Dolls#k.

I just went outside to play, trying to catch some pretty butterflies, when suddenly some horrible-looking zombies and ghosts snuck into our house. Now my daddy's trapped inside and I can't go back because these monsters are guarding the gate! Please help me return to my family!

Oh, that's great! Now, let's see which one has just the right cut...

Okay, so I have the key to the Piano Room. All it needs is just a brave person—you—to take it right to the door. Would you please unlock the door and bring my daddy here safely? I beg of you!

Hmm, this isn't good. Her rage is turning the sky blood red. Curious to know who she is? Her name is #bEliza#k. She's an ancient creature that is Luinel, but at the same time not Luinel. She was the Goddess's favorite pet.

However, you shouldn't underestimate #bEliza#k because she is a pet. Being a goddess' pet means that you would exceed the intelligence, rationality, and wisdom of humans. #bEliza#k was very gentle, quiet, and loved music according to the goddess's records. However...

The #bEliza#k now isn't even near the descriptions of the records. Records on #bEliza#k's strength are the same, but her nature is completely different now. She is ferocious and destroys anything in her way. Her rage is spreading all over Orbis. This has to do with what the #rPixies#k have done.

While #bEliza#k was sleeping, Papa Pixie kidnapped the Goddess, and other Pixies came to take her place. This is why #bEliza#k was enraged. Someone mighty like #bEliza#k can be dangerous when angered. Will you help to calm her rage?

Seems as though #bEliza#k's rage as calmed down; a good time to go #btalk#k to her. Without a rational mind, #bEliza#k can be frightening, but in her original state, she is gentle and calm. Go talk to her, and persuade her not to destroy Cloud Park anymore.

She's an ancient creature loved by the Goddess. Her nature exceeds the intelligence and nobility of human beings, so watch your manners in front of her.

I couldn't control my rage when I heard that my Goddess had been kidnapped right after I awoke from my sleep. That rage has brought about this tragedy. Now I know how foolish I was. I do not wish to hurt anyone else. However...

My angry impulse has created #rclones#k of myself that feel nothing but hatred inside. They look and have powers just like me, but their hearts are filled with hate. Since these are creations of my own rage, I cannot eliminate them. instead only confine them in #bStairway to the Sky II#k.

I don't think you have met my father yet. He is the manager of the Toy Factory which is inside the Ludibrium Clocktower. Please get this lunchbox to him as soon as possible. He must be starving by now. Thanks~

How's the Toy Factory operating these days? It concerns me a great deal that the majority of the workforce is here fixing up the tower as opposed to working at the factory. I really wish I could take care of both the work at the factory and the work here.

That's why... I'd like to ask you for a favor. Not far from where we are, at the 60th floor, you'll run into a whole bunch of #b#o3230400#s#k. They used to be just cute and cuddly, but lately, they are mad and ready to fight these days.

I don't know what makes them want to stop us from fixing up this tower, but it has reached the point where I can't just sit back and look at them destroy the place. That's why... I'd like to ask you to "take care of" some of the #b#o3230400#s#k. Can you do that for me?

It pains me to kill these previously-adorable creatures, but it has to be done. Please take care of them and bring back #b100 #t4000127#s#k as evidence. If you do this well, I may ask you for more help down the road.
Oh, and ... #b#p2050008##k of the Omega Sector may know a thing or two about #b#o3230400##k causing commotion here. I suggest you pay a visit to the General before killing them. Good luck~!

I see... I thought I could count on you to take care of them. Maybe it's too overwhelming for you to kill those cute little monsters. Maybe it's just too much to ask. In any case, if you decide to change your mind, please come talk to me.

Thanks to your help defeating the #o3230400#s, the fixing of the tower has gotten much easier now. You're much stronger than I thought. Anyway, with great work comes great reward. This may not be much, but please take it. I know it'll help you in some way shape or form.

Did you receive #b12,000 mesos#k? Anyway, I seriously hope that those guys return to their original, adorable state. I feel like I can ask for your help once more after the great job you did on this. Please come see me again down the road, and in the mean time, watch out for those monsters ~

The previously-adorable #b#o3230400#s#k have turned into a bunch of enraged monsters interfering with out fixing of the tower. Collect #b100 #t4000127#s#k for me, and I may ask you for more help down the road. Oh, and I suggest you go see #b#p2050008##k of the Omega Sector.

Hi there. You're back again. Thanks to your help, the fixing of the tower has been going smoothly. Hmm... I'm sure you may have heard it from #b#p2050008##k, but in order to set the raging #b#o3230400##k back to their normal state, then we need to take away their power.

Sigh... they used to be the most adorable thing in Ludibrium, but now... they are in rage, and going absolutely wild with it. I don't know how they god a hold of the force of darkness, but it's imperative that we turn them back to their original state...
Please eliminate #b#o3230400##k, and bring back #b1000 #t4000127#s#k as evidence. This time, it's for the sake of #o3230400#, so I hope you put your heart into this. I'll be here waiting...

Hey, aren't you the one that took our picture as a favor from #b#p2040015##k? How's the manager doing? Hmm... well, I have a bit of a problem here. Care to hear me out...?

Just below where I am right now, you may see a monster looking like an octopus called #b#o3230302##k, and one of those guys probably have it. Please take them down and find my screwdriver for me. Don't worry, I'll reward you well for your hard work.

Did you get it? It's a glove I bring out everyday, thinking I may need it for work, but I think you'll need it more than I do. I'll have to get back to work now. Take care!

Hmm ... this area has been fixed only days ago, and here's another hole ... what is going on here?? Oh, hi! We've met before. What brings you here this time? If you aren't that busy, then can you hear me out?

Cool. Just like the other roly-poly workers here, my job is to fix whatever is wrong with the tower, but because of the monsters around this area, all that fixing goes for naught. They keep drilling holes and destroy things in this tower, and I can't do a thing about it.

I hope you can kill off some of the monsters around this area. #b#o3230103##k is the one I have the most trouble with, Please defeat 25 of them, while collecting #b20 #t4000100#s#k that they drop. Thanks.

How can I help you here? Eos Tower is always full of monsters, so you better be careful, because you never know who's going to attack you. Me? I work here, so I have no choice. Haha ... well, if you have any free time, then do you want to hear my story?

Thanks~! Lately the monsters have gotten much angrier than usual, so that makes my job that much harder, as I have to constantly fix the damages they inflict. Hello, there. I don't think we've ever met ... what can I do for you here? Well, the thing is, lately I've been experiencing some very strange things, and therefore very apprehensive towards strangers. Because of that ... well, um ... will it be okay for you to help me out here?

Thank you so much. Now, here's the story. I've actually been declared missing for 10 months now, but I have no recollection of what happened during the 10 months that I've been deemed missing. It's like, I woke up one day, and 10 months have passed, just like that. Isn't that strange?

I couldn't sleep for a while because I was in shock. Luckily, there were people around me to bring me back to my senses, and I slowly started living a normal life again when two men dressed in dark suits came to me. They proceeded to ask me questions regarding the lost 10 months, then left.

I'm very much sure that those men know what happened to me, and I need to find out what happened. Please find those men in black suits for me and ask them whatever they know about me, so I can recover 10 months' worth of memories. I don't think they're at either Ludibrium or Eos Tower, though. Good luck!

Hmmm ... you must be busy with other things. I understand. You travel around different places, and it's only natural that you're busy. If you ever find some free time, however, then please find me. I really need help from someone like you.

I don't think you have located the men in black suits yet. The only ones that know what happened to me over the past 10 months are them, and I need to find out what happened. Please find those men in black suits for me and ask them whatever they know about me, so I can recover 10 months' worth of memories.

Shhhh... I suggest you don't talk to me around here for your safety. Omega Sector is constantly under watch, and it's best for you to be as careful as possible around here. Hmmm... and...? So you're saying you came here at #b#p2041015##k 's request? I see ...

I wish I could say I have no knowledge of that person, but looking at you, I don't think that's going to work. Alright, then, I'll tell you everything I know about her. Do you want to become an elite pet trainer like me? Once you reach my level, it's easy to handle multiple pets at once. What do you think? Are you interested in walking around with multiple pets at once?

Good, but I can't just teach you like that. Pets are important, you know, and I am only willing to extend the offer to those who care. Tell you what, if you can find a note I hid somewhere around the Pet Park, I'll train you. Go thorugh the obstacle course with your pet and find the note. Good luck!
Hah, no easy as it seems, is it? It's very difficult to control multiple pets at once.
How are you doing in terms of proving your worth?
Not bad! Fine, I'll teach you my secret method...but...I think I need to be compensated here, too. It's a special item not found in regular stores, and you'll really need it to train the pets.
You still haven't found the hidden note? Keep looking for it! If you can get near #p1012007# with your pet, then you can certainly find it...
If you want to learn how to control a group of pets, then get me some Pet Snacks. I have my own secret method of handling them, and it is foolproof. Are you interested?
You won't find Pet Snacks at a regular store... but you can find it at a big store, where you can buy a huge variety of items. Find it and return to me!
There's no such thing as a free lesson here. I'll give you some time to think over.

This... is one interesting organism. A magical life blended with a power of science... the evolution of life has become that much more advanced now. Okay, so what brought you here...? Do you want to grow this Robot.. I mean, this living pet?
Okay... but I can't just sit back and watch it grow. Unlike other pets that were created purely with magic, this pet is a bit different. I'll need the #t5380000# and 50 Cheap Batteries for that.
Take your time gathering up those materials. I'll be here studying more alchemy-related formulas.
Do you want it stay in that form? Then there's nothing I can do...
Did you bring all the materials?

Hoh... you seem to have yourself quite an intelligent pet. Did you bring it here for my training? Well, with a little of the training, I can teach the pet to move right next to you in an instant, wherever it may be at the moment. Are you interested?

Okay, good decision. You should also know that there's nothing's that's free. If you train others as much as I do, you tend to get a bit thirsty. Can you get me a drink? I have this drink that I really love, so much so that the merchants know exactly what i want. I'll be waiting.
Fine, if you don't want to. I don't think you fully understand the importance of education. Don't you want your pet to reach its full potential? Anyway... if you ever change your mind, let me know.
Did you bring the drink? Ahhh...just thinking about drinking this already puts me in a much better mood. Okay, now shall we start the session?

Hey what do you think? That was fast, wasn't it? Marvel at my awesome training skills... and now, your pet will be that much more obedient to your commands. All you need to do is say /petcome, and your pet will slide up next to you.
What? You didn't bring the drinks yet? I am thirsty...and I can't teach without the drink.

Hoh...you seem to have yourself quite an intelligent pet. Did you bring it here for my training? Pets need to be trained and educated...and of course, once I do that, the pet will become that much more special. It'll even learn to talk by itself. What do you think? Do you want me to help you out?

Okay, good decision. You should also know that there's nothing's that's free. If you train others as much as I do, you tend to get a bit thirsty. Can you get me a drink? I have this drink that I really love, so much so that the merchants know exactly what i want. I'll be waiting.
Fine. Let me know if you ever change your mind.
Did you bring the drink? Ahhh...just thinking about drinking this already puts me in a much better mood. Okay, now shall we start the session?
Hey what do you think? That was fast, wasn't it? Marvel at my awesome training skills... and now, your pet will be that much more intelligent than before.
What? You didn't bring the drinks yet? I am thirsty... and I can't teach without the drink.
Hey there! Isn't it beautiful outside?
I am #p9105002#, a special event planner/event guide. I spend most of the time cooking up new events for the public, and this is when I get to see other people enjoy my hours of hard work!
So what do you think? If you have some free time on hand, you should definitely join this event. Interested?
Awesome! Well, I need to print you a new ticket for entrance. Talk to me in a bit.
Oh, really. That's too bad. Like I said, if you have some time to burn, you should really try this.
Hey, you didn't wait too long, did you? Here is your ticket!
（and that's how I received #b#t4032055##k. Where am I supposed to go to use this?)
That ticket is to enter the area where the Secret Event is being held.

Joining this event is easy! Do you remember the #bMini Dungeons#k that are located all over the world of Maple? Use the ticket I just gave you and enter one of the dungeon maps. Once you use the portal inside, you'll be able to move to a special Mini Dungeon that is slightly different from the ones you've been used to.
Ah, the dungeon will look the same on the outside. The big change is the item the monsters drop. One of the items they'll drop will actually be #bThe Secret Something#k.

The #bSecret Something#k......that something is actually a crystal called #b#t4032056##k. I want you to gather up as many of those as you can, and then come back to me. Depending on how much you bring, I'll give you a special, special reward that you'll surely love!

Oh, and while setting up this event, I have changed the Mini Dungeon settings a bit. Please take note of the following: 
1, Once you enter the dungeon, you can only be inside for 5 minutes. After that, you'll be automatically removed from the dungeon.
2,You may enter the Mini Dungeon up to 6 times per day.
3, You can't enter the dungeon if you are affiliated with a party at the time of entrance.
4, You cannot use special skills once inside the dungeon.

"What? You want to know what you can receive by trading in #b#t4032056##k? Hmmm... this information is supposed to be a top secret... but I'll give you the list JUST FOR YOU! I'm only going to say this once, so remember it, write it down, do something! Here are the prizes. 

100 : Change to Mouse(10) 

200 : Power Elixir(20) 

500 : Energy Drink(10) 

700 : Necomimi(1) 

1000 : Summoning Superslime(1) 

1500 : Moon Star Chair(1) 

2000 : Under the Maple Tree(1) 

2500 : Sword Earrings or Shield Earrings(1)
For Skill Books and Mastery Books, please check the event page of the website for details!

These prizes are based on the number of #t4032056#s you own, so please check your inventory first before coming to me. You can have as many #t4032056#s as you want, so gather them up as many as you can until you reach the target number you need to earn that special prize.
Now, what are you doing just standing here? Go get some crystals!! I'll be here waiting!
You're back! How many did you wind up gathering? Are you interested in trading them in for a prize right now?
Alright, now based on how many #b#t4032056#s#k you have, you'll be receiving this. I'll give out 1 free event ticket per day, so I'll be expecting to see you here tomorrow!

What? You want to join this event again today? Well... if you really insist, we sell the special tickets that'll allow you to participate in this event more than once in one day! You can find them at the Cash Shop, so... good luck!
Oh I see. Please let me know when you are ready to make the exchange!
Oh no, you don't have enough #t4032056# yet? Take the Event Ticket and enter the dungeon to gather them up by defeating the monsters. Good luck!!

Hello there. Do you have a moment to spare?

Wonderful. Name's Jack. Jack Masque. I'm from Amoria, but that neither here nor there...it's a long story why I left...but since you're still here, I'll give you the short version. I'm in love! I am lost in the throes of passion with the most beautiful creature I have laid eyes upon...a Princess. Princess Restless to be exact. I'm competing for her with some snob-nosed prince. We were out on our first date, and the time was perfect. The sun was shining, birds were tweeting, and just as I was about to receive a kiss from her sweet lips, this strange spider attacked us! I fought the beast off, but that was a one in a million chance with her! I swore to wear this mask in shame until I could return to Amoria with honor. But I must hurry, that accursed Prince Vince is sure to attempt to steal her away...So, I want you to go and eliminate 100 Wolf Spiders, which should ensure that this never happens again. If you're successful, I have a particularly rare crystal that may suit you...get going!
Unfortunate. Be on your way then!

Fantastic! I'll be able to face her again without worrying if one of those pesky Wolf Spiders will spoil the moment. As promised, here is your reward. Enjoy! And in three days time, you may return to me for another hunt! \n\n#L0##bActually, can you tell me more about yourself?#k#l
Anything else you wish to know? \n\n#L0##bWhy is that mask really on your face?#k#l

I'm a prideful man, and the thought that I lost my chance due to spider is...rather embarrassing to be honest. Icebyrd offered me a chance to redeem myself, and I took it. I won't take off this mask until I can return to Amoria with honor! You've helped me and I never forget a favor. I may have a few tasks for you in the future. With your help, I'm sure that I'd get a leg up on that walking waste of space known as Prince Vince... Does this answer your question?
As promised, here is your reward. Enjoy! And in three days time, you may return to me for another hunt!
Tsk, tsk. So sad. I said #b100 Wolf Spiders#k. Not 74, not 32, not 99. 100. Come back when you have something to show for your effort-besides a tired face.
Hey. Got a sec?

Then you've come to the right place! Name's John Barricade, one half of the world-famous Barricade Bros. Treasure Hunting Co. I've been trying to explore the Temple Hive, but I haven't got that far in. But with your help, I think we can make a push to discover some treasure...First, I'll need you to clear the area. Wipe out #b50 Killa Bees, 30 Mighty Maple Eaters#k and #b40 Fire Tusks#k. After that, head back to me and we'll get some real work done. Hop to it, kid!
It's called "distinct fashion sense". And I wouldn't talk if I were you...
Great work, kid! Ready to hear about the treasure? \n\n#L0##bOk, what else have you discovered?#k#l

Well, it's a pretty long list. I always liked history, even when I was a kid. All my other subjects were ok, but I always got straight A's in History-probably because my dad would kick my butt if I didn't. That what happens when you grow up with an archaeologist for a father. \n\n#L0##bWhat about your family?#k#l

You must mean my brother, Jack Barricade. We've agreed to something that I'll tell you about a bit later, but essentially, he's looking for something in Aqua Road, and I'm searching here. \n\n#L0##bOk, you still haven't told me what was the first thing you discovered?#k#l

Oh, sorry. It happens sometimes. After college, my brother and I concluded that the only way to live forever was to find the Fountain of Youth. It took 3 years, but we finally found it! \n\n#L0##bNO WAY!#k#l
WAY! \n\n#L0##bThat's awesome!#k#l
We thought so too, but man we made a lot of businesses mad with that one...
Ok, let's get going. Clear a path, come on back and let's figure out this mystery.
Not even close to done, shorty. Get back out there and knock out #b50 Killa Bees, 30 Mighty Maple Eaters#k and #b40 Fire Tusks#k. After that, we can talk.
Nice work! Now, I'll need some time to study these markings.\n\n#L0##bTell me some more about your discoveries.#k#l

Heh, ok. You asked for a list, well, my bro and I have discovered King Solomon's Mines, solved the mystery of Stonehenge, found Captain Kidd's gold horde, unearthed the trove of the Knights Templar, the Lost Dutchman's Gold Mine, the Sphinx Chamber, and countless Spanish galleons. Not bad for a few years! \n\n#L0##bHoly crap! What do you think we'll find here?#k#l

I have a hunch that Subani left something here. I remember when I explored the Sphinx Chamber, I discovered an old legend that was eerily similar to that of Subani and Naricain. It also foretells that the act that created the Dark Scrolls was not their final battle. I'm not sure what we'll find, but I'm sure it pertains to that. It also mentioned another world... \n\n#L0##bAnother world? Elpam's outside, have you spoken with him?#k#l
Not yet, he smells a bit too much like old cheese... but if he really is from where he said, I might have to...
Ok, kid, get going! Return to me soon, and I should have more information!
Looking good, kid-but I'll need #b50 Hyper Glyphs#k to read the markings. I'll be waiting!
Back already, huh? Well, you proved your worth, so I'll tell you a little story...

Well, if you've heard of Dark Scrolls, you've heard about Subani. He was the powerful magician who sacrificed himself to seal away the evil demon, Naricain. The scrolls are all over the place, but that's not what we're here for. I got a tip from this funny looking guy over in Purplewood Forest, went by the name of Glimmer Man. He mentioned that Subani had a horde of items stashed away, and that the MesoGears would be a good place to look. I did some digging, thanks to the path you cleared, and found some strange markings. I don't know what they say, but I do know that there only one thing that deciphers marking like these-a #bHyper Glyph#k. It can decipher other languages, but the problem is, you can only use it once, and there are 50 markings. I'll need you to hunt down #b50 Hyper Glyphs#k so we can keep going-I know we're close to something...Try those weird-looking elephants that shoot electricity. I'm willing to bet they're hiding something in that mechanism on top of their heads!
Well, ok. You never turn down a good legend though, they always turn out to be true...
Right on time! We've got a problem...

Ok, I "borrowed" a few robots from Foxwit's hidden lab to help me decipher the markings, but the second they finished, those frigging robots went nuts! It was like they were being controlled...Anyways, they have the #bMesoGears Map Pieces#k. All of #b50#k of them. I'll need you to hunt them down and bring them back so I can start assembling the map. I'll poke around a bit in the MesoGears and see what I can find...
ust when you were getting good... I guess it was too good to be true.
A+ plus, kid. Truly outstanding! I'll start putting those pieces together right now! \n\n#L0##bI'm just wondering... Have you heard from your brother yet?#k#l
No...we haven't spoken for a while now. I hope something hasn't happened to him... \n\n#L0##bYou mentioned another world in the prophecy; do you think we could travel there?#k#l

You know, that's probably a better question for Elpam or The Glimmer Man. But I will say this, trouble's gonna find you anyway, so you might as well have fun looking for it! Ok. Time for me to get back on the map. Before that, I've got something for you.
Might not be the treasure we wanted off the bat, but when I'm done putting this map together, you and I are going hunting, Barricade Bros. style!
I like the effort you're showing kiddo, but #b50 MesoGears Map Pieces#k is what we need to put the MesoGears Map together. I'm headed back into the MesoGears to see what I can dig up...
Yes! This will do it. I can now adjust my enchanted compass! Thank you so much!
If you should have the time, please see me again, for I require a final task.
If I am to re-calibrate this compass, I'll need more #bElpam Magnets, 30 to be exact#k. I await your return.
Hello, my name is Elpam Gorlab. I am in need of assistance, do you think you can spare a moment? \n\n#L0##bYes. At the very least, you can tell me why you look so different.#k#l

Ah. Therein lay the tale of my current predicament. I am from Versal. It is best described as a parallel dimension to the Maple World, as many things are different, yet familiar. I travel here for certain occasions to observe the people that inhabit this land. However, this time when I traveled here, I noticed that I was in a strange place. In speaking with the one called Icebyrd Slimm, I discovered my calculations were off due to the appearance of the new land, Amoria. I need to get home, but I have to adjust my enchanted compass first. I will need 30 Elpam Magnets to do this properly?I believe the Barnard Grays are the only creatures in this world that may have them. I have translated this to your Quest Journal from my native language. I wish you luck, and shall await your return! 

#L0##bTell me more about your world, Versal.#k
#L1##bNo way. You smell like old cheese!#k#l

It can be thought of as the mirror dimension for the Maple World. There are similarities, but many differences as well. For instance, you may have noticed my last name is a monster here. In our world, they are benevolent creatures, and it is a mark of honor to be associated with them. It seems strange to me that they are so fearsome here... Would you help me?
If I am to re-calibrate this compass, I'll need more #bElpam Magnets, 30 to be exact#k. I await your return.
Please see me again if you change your mind.
Er...well, cheese is a popular form of cologne in our world...please see me again should you change your mind.

Fantabulstanding work! My apologies if that phrase did not turn out the way I planned. I can now make the journey home. \n\n#L0##bHold on, Hold on! I have questions... like... tell me something crazy about Versal!#k#l
Very well, you have aided me, the least I can do is tell you a few tidbits about my home. The creature known as Mushmom is the most dangerous creature there...and she's not alone. \n\n#L0##bWHAT?#k#l
Your surprise is expected, but nevertheless, it remains the truth. It puzzles me as to why she is regarded as cute and lovable here... \n\n#L0##bWhy are you so pale?#k#l

Hmm. I do not believe my skin to be pale, it is a natural pigment. The sun only shines in Versal for a period of...3 munf? No, 3 months...out of one...what do you call them...year? I believe that is the correct measurement. At any rate, it is nice to see the sun glow so brightly here for an extended period. \n\n#L0##bHow do you get there?#k#l

I am still working on my way back, but when I do figure out how to bring others there, I will most assuredly notify you. In the mean time, in return for your effort, here is something I found between worlds.
May it serve you well and see you around!
It seems as if you have, quite literally, "lost time". I will need #b60 Temporal Fragments#k if I am to make the journey home. Please acquire them, and return to me.

So glad to see you, friend. I've got the compass adjusted, but could still use a hand if you're willing to lend it. 

#L0##bSure, as long as you give it back.#k
#L1##bYou're sick! No way am I giving you my hands! They're mine!#k#l

Ha. Ha. Ha. That was a joke, as you call it? Fascinating. I'll need to travel back to the exact moment that everything went haywire. Doing so will allow me to go to my intended place and get home as normal. However, I'll need #b60 Temporal Fragments#k to give me enough time to do it. I believe the creatures you refer to as Tick-Tocks will have them, although it is a rather rare item. I will remain here until your return.
I will need #b60 Temporal Fragments#k if I am to make the journey home. Please acquire them, and return to me.
Ok... Please return when you can help me.
You misunderstand...or maybe I do. Any rate, please return when you can help me.
So glad to see you! I need your help!

Perfect! We're building the new areas, but we've come under attack from Gryphons, who are destroying my cranes, and Boomers, who are damaging my machinery! It's madness! I'll need you to kick some booty-#b100 Gryphons#k and enough #bBoomers#k to gather #b150 #t4000391##k. You do that for me, and I won't forget it!
Guess we'll have to get it done without you then...
Nice, nice. You got skills, I recognize that.
Here's a little something for your trouble. Even though you beat them back, they'll be back. See me when you're ready for action!
You got jokes, I see. That's funny, cause I know I said #b150 #t4000391##k and #b100 Gryphons#k. Not "way less than that". Do you understand the words that are coming out of my mouth? Get to it!
OUTSTANDING! I knew you were special the second I looked at you. \n\n#L0##bI have a question. So... you were a Thief?#k#l

The very best. I trained under the Dark Lord's watchful eye for many years. Once you train past a certain point, fighting becomes second nature. \n\n#L0##bHow did the Dark Lord let you leave? I've never heard of that before...#k#l

It's a long story, but The Dark Lord allowed me to leave if I touched him once with my weapon. It's much different from fighting his clone, his speed and multiple techniques are incredible. The fight was a true test of my skill...it was a stroke of luck that let me touch him. I promised to help others train as he helped me. \n\n#L0##bDid Icebyrd have anything to do with that?#k#l

In a way, yes. He showed me that my destiny is here, in New Leaf City, and to a greater extent, Masteria. It's a brave new world out there...and I want to know where my fate lies. Ok. End of the story. It's time to get paid for your work!
Here's your class reward, as promised. I'm proud of you! You can come and see me anytime you wish perform your duty as a citizen of New Leaf City!
Come on, you're not done yet, but I have faith. You can do it!

Hiya Sport! I'm the new sheriff in town. You ready for some law and order? 

#L0##bOnly if I get to help enforce it!#k
#L1##bLaw? Order? Please. You couldn't tame a fly. I'm leaving!#k#l
That's the attitude that got me where I am today! Ok, I'm Lita Lawless, and with your help, I'm going to corral this town into a crime-free zone.

I know how the devious monster mind works, having trained as a thief for many years. So, you're going to have to wipe out #b200#k of two types-I believe #bElectrophants and Gryphons#k should prove a suitable test of your skills! Take your time and report back when you're done! I've got something just for your class!
Grumpy little thing, aren't you?
Grumpy little thing, aren't you?

I want to thank you. You've been pushed to your limits in helping us, and shown you're a true Urban Warrior. As my way of saying thanks, I want you to have this chair. Check it out, and be sure to come back anytime you want. New Leaf City wouldn't be here without you! \n\n#L0##bSo, about that favor you mentioned...#k#l
We're tight, but not that tight yet. I'll tell you in time though... \n\n#L0##bI've noticed the city has quite a bit of diversity!#k#l
Yes. I felt it'd be best to be a little different. Masteria is a big place, and while we're only just starting, I have a feeling we're in for one wild ride! \n\n#L0##bWhat's up with you and Lita?#k#l
We're very good friends, but nothing more. She's a tough one, though! \n\n#L0##bJohn and Elpam both mentioned another world, Versal. What do you know about this?#k#l
Well, there's a rumor that a portal can be opened somehow from within the city, but I'm not sure how that's possible. \n\n#L0##bWhat do you mean? You built this city.#k#l

Correction-I rebuilt this city. The foundations are still there, as is some of the technology; you've probably seen some of it when you were outside the city. There's some stuff that just works, and I don't mean the Foxwit Doors themselves-I mean the energy that powers them. Foxwit is a genius and some of that is way beyond even his understanding. I'm a bit wary of using it all, just because of the old tales of Masteria-the immortal warriors, a mad scientist, a threat from the stars, some of their legends are pretty heavy stuff. In addition to that, this is where Subani and Naricain are originally from. Not the city, another region of Masteria. John probably mentioned that. \n\n#L0##bJust level with me, Icebyrd. Tell me what you know.#k#l

Ok, but keep this a secret, don't want people panicking. The Masteria of old was a sprawling utopia, one far advanced in technology. However, their ambition far outstripped their control of the technology, and there was an accident. Masteria, the great land, finally fell into the sea, its secrets lost forever. Until now. I made a deal with someone to raise the continent, and establish the city in the ruins of Olde Sapp Village. He brought my dream to life, and it cost me next to nothing. And that's where we are now. However, the city has many, many secrets that even I don't know about. Tread carefully; you never know what can open up... \n\n#L0##bOk, I know what how it was raised, but who raised it? What did you have to do?#k#l

That's a bit personal, but I will say this-if there's ever a time when you need to know more, I'll tell you. Until then, don't worry about it. That burden is mine alone to bear. For now, just let me give you a gift for the appreciation of helping our city.
Where did I put it... Just give me a second and talk to me, ok?
I want you to have this chair. Check it out, and be sure to come back anytime you want. New Leaf City wouldn't be here without you!
Looks good! Just give it a try and sit on it sometimes!

Fantastic! I'll be able to face her again without worrying if one of those pesky Wolf Spiders will spoil the moment. As promised, here is your reward. Enjoy! And in three days time, you may return to me for another hunt!
As promised, here is your reward. Enjoy! And in three days time, you may return to me for another hunt!
Tsk, tsk. So sad. I said #b100 Wolf Spiders#k. Not 74, not 32, not 99. 100. Come back when you have something to show for your effort-besides a tired face.
Welcome back! Are you ready for another hunt?

So, you spoke to both of them? And what did they say? Really? Uh-huh. And? Maple Claws said that? Wow... I love her! And what about Versalmas? O-Pongo said that? Really?! Wow. I'm really glad you told me that. I feel like I know much more about both holidays now!
Oh...\r\nThis doesn't make my decision any easier at all!\r\nWhat am I going to do?

I know! You're older than I am... you know what to do! Please, take the #bwishlist#k I've made! You decide for me! Please give it to either Maple Claws or O-Pongo! But please think about this very carefully! It's an important decision... for both me and you.
Thank you very much! Please let me know who you gave my list to... so I'll know who's bringing me presents this year!
So, who's going to be bringing me my presents this year? You don't know yet?! Please, I can't stand not knowing! Please talk to both Maple Claws and O-Pongo and come back!

Ok! My question is: what's better... Maplemas or Versalmas?

#b#L0#Versalmas?! What are you talking about, little girl? There's no such thing as Versalmas!#l#k
#b#L1#Listen, little girl, I've got more important things to do than answer stupid kid questions.#l
I'm not little! I'm 10 years old! And there is too such a thing as Versalmas! O-Pongo told me all about it!\r\n\r\n#b#L0#O-Pongo? Um, right... I suppose this "O-Pongo" is your invisible "friend."#l

No, silly! O-Pongo is real! In fact, he's right in Happyville this year...go look if you don't believe me! He's just like Maple Claws except he's big and green and a mouse and wears purple instead of red!\r\n\r\n#b#L0#Ok...#l

Well, maybe he's not exactly alike, but he's the Maple Claws from his world -- the world of Versal! O-Pongo told me all about it! He told me about how it's usually dark but that the sun shines day after day after Versalmas comes and how all the kids dance and sing together and get special treats and candies! It sounds very exciting--more exciting than Maplemas! Well, maybe not more-- I do like all the presents I get from my parents on Maplemas. But you get presents for Versalmas too! I was already going to ask Maple Claws for a new pair of skis and other stuff, but I don't know what kind of presents since I've never had Versalmas before... so maybe Versalmas presents are even better! But Maplemas Trees are so pretty and I love decorating them! So-- Oh, I don't know! Both holidays sound so good but I don't know if I'm allowed to celebrate both...\r\n<looks sad>\r\nPlease... can you... can you help me decide? You're older than I am... you should know! Pleaaaaase!

Yayyyyyyy! Please, go talk to O-Pongo! He can tell you all about Versalmas! And please speak to Maple Claws too... she's in Happyville as usual, of course! I'm sure you know this already but you can get to Happyville by speaking to #bRooney#k, and she'll take you there. Then come back and tell me which holiday I should celebrate! I've been working on my wishlist all year long and I know I'm going to get everything on it because I've been a really good girl! Please, hurry! I need to know who's bringing me presents this year!\r\nI can't wait to hear back from you! Both holidays sound so great! I can't wait to celebrate, uh--the right holiday!
I thought being older means you know more but I guess not. Hmmph!
This is not a stupid question! This is very important! You're a meanie... a stupid meanie with no holiday spirit!

Merry Maplemas to you, Mapler! Are you ready to celebrate Maplemas this year? I hope you've been good...

#b#L0#I've been an excellent kid!#l#k
#b#L1#I've actually been burning ants and stuff!#l

Have you? We'll see once I check my list... <purrs>
<sigh> But as it turns out, I have a situation that needs everyone's help this year! Even if you've been bad, here's a chance to do some good for others and still receive presents from me this year.

#b#L0#Sure, Maple Claws. What happened? What do you need?#l

Every year as you know, I begin collecting presents for all the kids in the Maple World that have been good. It's a lot of presents so it takes quite awhile... all year in fact! My helpers and I had finally finished gathering them all when my present storehouse was broken into... and a bunch of the presents were stolen! These were presents that were already wrapped and simply waiting for delivery! Without these presents and with Maplemas Day so near, thousands of children in the Maple World will go without presents this year!\r\n\r\n#b#L0#That's terrible! I'd be glad to help you with that, of course!#l

Thank you, I knew you had the Maplemas spirit in you. I know who's taken my presents: monsters. Monsters simply have no manners, taking what's not theirs, but they love presents as much as any kid. In a way, my heart goes out to them. <sigh> If you happen to find any presents from any bad monsters who've taken them from me, please return them to me as soon as you can. Hmmm. But I sense that there's another reason why you've come to see me.\r\n\r\n#b#L0#Yes, Maple Claws, a little girl named Suzy asked me to speak with you.#l

So, Suzy is having a hard time finding her Maplemas spirit this year? I see. Sometimes, with the hustle and bustle of everyday life, it's easy for us to forget to treat each other with simple kindnesses. This is why the holidays are important... it's a time to let us remember the best in us and our fellow Maplers. But something tells me there's something more to Suzy's dilemma.\r\n\r\n#b#L0#Yes, she spoke to a mouse named O-Pongo who told her about something called Versalmas. Some sort of alternate Maplemas.#l

Ah. I've heard of this O-Pongo. You say he's a mouse who talks of an alternate version of Maplemas? Curious. But it does not surprise me that alternate worlds would celebrate holidays in different ways.\r\nI see that Suzy is excited at the prospect of a different holiday, and likely, different presents. <purrs in thought> Very well, will you take her a message from me?

Thank you. It's important that little boys and girls don't forget what it is about the spirit of Maplemas that is important. Please give me a moment to think about what I should exactly say to her, and then come back to me.
Part of the Maplemas spirit is spreading the spirit to those who have need of it. I hope you come back when you've found it within you.
I had a feeling I'd seen a lump of coal with your name on it lying around somewhere in my present storehouse. Tsk, tsk.

I've thought of what I need you to tell Suzy.\r\nPlease tell her this: As long as she holds the spirit of kindness and goodwill in her heart all year round, it doesn't matter whether she chooses to celebrate the holidays with a Maplemas Tree, or with Versalmas customs and gifts. Tell her that as long as she doesn't forget that, Maple Claws will remember her and bring her presents every year.\r\nWill you tell her that? You will? Thank you, and a Merry Maplemas to you, too!

Here is my message for the little one called Suzy.\r\nPlease tell her this: As great as Caramel Onions and Sugar-coated Olives may be -- and certainly are! -- Versalmas is about celebrating and sharing the things that we have, and not wanting more than we need. If Maplemas is like Versalmas, then we both believe in the gift of sharing. I do believe that even in your world, used to the traditions of Maplemas, there is room for Versalmas as well.\r\nThank you for giving her my message. I certainly hope Suzy -- and you! -- choose to celebrate Versalmas with me this year! Happy Versalmas to you, and may your days be bright!

Hoy there, young friend! My, my, what a beautiful world you live in! Who am I? Why, I am O-Pongo! Nice to meet you!\r\n\r\n#b#L0#Nice to meet you too, er, O-Pongo. So what are you doing here in NLC?#l#k
I'm here because it's that time of year! It's Versalmas time again! I'm the Versalmas Mouse so I'm here to spread Versalmas cheer!\r\n\r\n#b#L0#Versalmas? What's that?#l#k

Why, Versalmas is the most wonderful holiday in all of Versal! How wonderful? Why, so wonderful that everyone loves Versalmas! Versalmas is even better than birthdays! Why, just imagine the best birthday you've ever had... and Versalmas is a hundred times better than that! It's the most celebrated holiday in Versal! Well... it's actually the only holiday celebrated in Versal. But it's still wonderful, nonetheless!\r\n\r\n#b#L0#Um, so why are you here? Shouldn't you be in Versal for that?#l#k

As for why I'm here, it's a strange story. As the Versalmas Mouse, I'm bound by Versalmas law to deliver a present to every Versalian, no matter how far and wide they are located in Versal. Whew, it's no easy task I tell you! I had crossed off everyone on my list except for one last name -- Elpam Gorlab!
I had Elpam's gift all ready to go, but I couldn't find him anywhere! So, I asked my trusty steed, Pwnzer, to "sniff" out where he was, and take me to him, crackity-splat!

#b#L0#Er, I'm guessing Pwnzer is a reindeer?#l#k

Reindeer? What's that? No, Pwnzer is an ostrich, of course! He would be offended if you thought of him as anything but! Anyway, I yelled "To Elpam Gorlab, Pwnzer, and away!" and lo and behold --POOF!-- I arrived beside Elpam, here by this strange tower, in a completely different world!
In my shock at arriving here -- and to see one our most esteemed Versalians here in a strange new world on Versalmas! -- I almost forgot to give him his present! Hoy, that would have been a first -- an undelivered gift! Elpam was just as surprised to see me here -- why, he almost fell down from his perch on that metal tower! <chuckles> It was a pleasant surprise though, I assume!

#b#L0#I'm sure...#l#k

After giving Elpam his gift, which he was happy to receive, I asked him for more information about where "here" was. He told me that this place is called the "Maple World," a place I had only heard about in Versalian legend! In these tales, it's said that the sun shines in this world everyday! When Elpam told me that this was actually true, I almost fell over! And you can imagine how hard that would be to do given my size! <chuckles> I never thought the legends to be true!
Even now, I can hardly believe it! The welcome sight of an eternal sun swells my chest with happiness! At first, I was at a lost to be in a different world, but I've realized that this also makes the Maple World a perfect place for Versalmas!

#b#L0#A perfect place for Versalmas? Um... why is that?#l#k

Because Versalmas is a celebration of the Sun! You see, in Versal, it is perpetually dark... I believe that you have "night" here as well. Well, it is night all the time in Versal. But once a year, our sun comes back... for 30 glorious days straight, which we call the "30 Days of Delight"! Versalmas Day is the first of these days, and each day after, while the sun shines, we celebrate Versalmas. Each day of Versalmas, everyone, not just the young, receive gifts from their loved ones. So you see, because the sun shines here in the Maple World every day, why then... it's Versalmas here every day! Hooray!\r\n\r\n#b#L0#Well the gift-giving part sounds a bit like our Maplemas. Er, have you heard about Maplemas?#l#k

That is what everyone I've met has been telling me! It does seem that your Maplemas is very similar to our Versalmas. This is quite exciting to me! Perhaps we can exchange customs and gifts!

#b#L0#What are the differences? Do you have different foods and traditions for Versalmas?#l#k
#b#L1#That seems to be the problem. Do you remember a girl named Suzy? She asked me to speak with you.#l#k

Ah, I remember speaking with that lovely little child earlier in my walk through this wonderful city--just after I delivered Elpam's gift. She told me about how she loved candy canes, and I told her in turn about our #bSugar-coated Olives#k, which are simply delicious! She seemed very excited about new types of presents and told me all about her #bWishlist#k. My, my, that girl certainly wants quite a few specific things!\r\nSo you say that she needs help to determine whether she should celebrate Versalmas this year? Hoy, then... would you be kind enough to convey a message to her from me?

Thank you. I understand that she - and you, for that matter - may be used to your own traditions for the holidays. But I think there's a place for Versalmas here in the Maple World as well. Please, come back in a little bit and let me think of something appropriately eloquent to say to her.
I understand that you may think our customs to be strange at first. But I hope that in time, you will reconsider, and give new customs a chance. Happy Versalmas!

Food, indeed! Of course! What is a holiday without food? Food is one of the hallmarks of Versalmas tradition, and personally my favorite part!
 Whereas you people here enjoy what you call your "#bMaplemas Ham#k," we have #bSmoked Salmon#k for our traditional dinner, which sounds much more delicious to me! I hope you get the chance to try some! And perhaps I will try your ham as well! There are also a host of other traditional holiday dishes, such as those tasty #bCaramel Onions#k and my favorite, #bSugar-coated Olives#k! I am happy to say that I have a bag full of these with me which I would be happy to share! The most popular Versalmas gifts are gifts of food!
I have also heard that you decorate a tree with lights and ornamentation. We do the same! Only we decorate a #bCactus#k instead. We Versalians sing many of our songs of praise to the sun as we dance around our #bVersalmas Cactus#k! And... er, you may have noticed that Versalians are somewhat pale. Because we're no longer used to the bright sunlight, #bSunblock#k is a popular and useful gift for this holiday as well!
It is so strange how we are from different worlds yet we have similar customs!

I see that you've spoken to Suzy. How did her decision go?

#b#L0#She wants me to make the choice for her... and I think I like the old traditions the best. It's Maplemas for me!#l#k
#b#L1#She wants me to make the choice for her, but I think that Versalmas sounds like the more interesting holiday.#l

Well, if you are making a decision for both you and her, then you should be doubly sure. If you choose Maplemas, I will be counting on you to recover my stolen presents for me. If the training ends well, then I'll even give you a small reward. I'll teach you a skill that you can use through Super Transformation. What do you think? Now, go ahead and defeat #r150 Blue Dragon Turtles#k. I also need evidence that you really did slay the Blue Dragon Turtles, so I want you to bring back #b50 pieces of Sturdy Leather#k.

That was a great training session! What was it like facing the Blue Dragon Turtle? Weren't they powerful?
