Who are you? You look like someone who's exploring Maple World. Our kingdom is in serious danger, and we need someone dependable that can save us. If you can't help us, then I suggest you move on.

We need your help, noble hero. Our kingdom is currently facing the biggest threat we've ever faced, and we desperately need a courageous hero willing to fight for us. That's why you're here. Please understand, though, that since we need to place our faith in you, we'll have to test your skills before we can stand firmly behind you. Is that okay?

Keep moving forward, and you'll see some #bRenegade Spores#k. They're Spores that have turned their backs on the Mushking Empire. We'd appreciate it if you taught them a lesson or two and brought back #b50 Mutated Spores#k when you return.
Hmmm… You must be unsure of your combat skills. We'll be here waiting for you, so come see us when you're ready.
Did you teach those Renegade Spores a lesson?
That was amazing. I apologize for doubting your abilities for even a second. Please save our Mushking Empire from this crisis!
That's not enough. Please gather #b50 Mutated Spores#k.
I have told our #bSecretary of Domestic Affairs#k of your work. Please go pay a visit to him immediately.
Save our kingdom! We believe in you!
There's not much time. Please hurry.

Oh, you must be the hero that the Head Security Officer talked about. Our kingdom is currently in a state of emergency because we were invaded by #bKing Pepe#k from Ice Land and lost our kingdom. To make matters worse, our own Princess Violetta has been kidnapped and taken into their custody.

That dastardly King Pepe! He knew that Mushking was not doing well physically and was ready to hand the throne over to Princess Violetta, and attacked before that could happen. His plan surely must be to arrange for King Pepe's dumb son Prince Giuseppe and Princess Violetta to marry to orchestrate a takeover of the Mushking Empire. Right now, we must save Princess Violetta from their grasp. Please save the Princess for us!
There's not much time. Please hurry.
In order to rescue the princess, you must first get through Mushroom Forest. King Pepe set up a powerful barrier to block anyone from entering the castle. Please investigate this matter for us.
You'll find the barrier in Mushroom Forest by heading east of where you are standing right now. Please be careful. I hear that the area is infested with crazy, fear-inducing monsters.
Please do not give up on the Mushking Empire!
I see that you have thoroughly investigated the barrier in the Mushroom Forest. What was it like?
So I see it wasn't an ordinary barrier by any means. Great work! If it weren't for your help, we wouldn't have had a clue.
Please journey all the way to the end of the Mushroom Forest and investigate the barrier for us.

A powerful barrier of magic, huh? Then what should we do… ? If we can't find a way to break that barrier, then we won't be able to save the princess. If it's impossible to physically break through, as you mentioned, then how about requesting help from our #bSecretary of Magic#k?
Please go see him immediately. The #bSecretary of Magic#k may seem a bit on edge, but he's very knowledgeable, and I'm sure he'll know what to do.
Please do not forget our plea for help.
What? You investigated the barrier in the Mushroom Forest?
Hmmm… this is interesting. It's a barrier set up by someone with a powerful force of magic, which means there's no way we can manually break through it.
Please go see the Secretary of Magic.

I think I've heard of a potion that breaks these types of barriers. I think it's called the #bKiller Spore Potion#k? Hmmm… you'll find the Mushroom Scholar #bScarrs#k waiting outside. #bScarrs#k is an expert on mushrooms, so go talk to him.
I am confident that #bScarrs#k will do everything to help you.
Why did you even bother asking when you knew you were going to say no? What a weirdo…
Ah! So you're the hero that people have been talking about. I'm #bScarrs, the Royal Mushroom Scholar#k representing the Mushking Empire. So you need some #bKiller Spore Potion#k?
#bKiller Spore Potion#k… I think I've heard of that before…
You should pay a visit to #bScarrs#k, the mushroom scholar.

Ah! If I am not mistaken, I think I saw something about the #bKiller Spore Potion#k in a book way back when I was a little kid. Now I remember… It's made out of powerful poisons extracted from Poison Mushrooms, which means you'll need some Poison Mushroom Caps. If you can get me some of those caps, I should be able to make the potion.
Please defeat some #bPoison Mushrooms#k and bring back #b100 Poison Mushroom Caps#k.
Breaking through the barrier requires Poison Mushroom Caps. Talk to me when you change your mind.
Did you bring back 100 Poison Mushroom Caps like I asked you to?
I am amazed that you were able to collect 100 Poison Mushroom Caps, which is considered a difficult feat. I think I'll be able to make a #bKiller Spore Potion#k out of these.
Making the #bKiller Spore Potion#k will require 100 Poison Mushroom Caps.

Hmmm… I looked into making the Killer Spore Potion while you were gathering up the Poison Mushroom Caps and realized that we'll need some more ingredients. I need you to gather up one more set of items.
Okay, I want you to defeat some Renegade Spores and bring back #b50 #t4000499#s#k for me.
I understand it's not an easy task, but I won't be able to make the #bKiller Spore Potion#k without them. Please reconsider.
Did you bring back all the necessary ingredients for the potion?
Okay, this should be enough for me to make the #bKiller Spore Potion#k. Please hold on for just a moment.
Okay, here is the Killer Spore Potion. Hopefully this is enough for you to save Princess Violetta and help regain our kingdom. Good luck!
Hmmm… Doesn't look like you were able to collect #b50 #t4000499#s#k like I asked you to. I need #b50 #t4000499#s#k.
Oh, I almost forgot! What was I thinking? I need you to hand this #b#t4032389##k to #b#p1300004##k and report the results.

The #bSecretary of Magic#k asked me to bring him some of the #bKiller Spore Potion#k when it is complete. I'll give you the sample; now could you please deliver the sample to our #bSecretary of Magic#k?
It's not such a difficult task, so just come back to me when you're ready.
So is the #bKiller Spore Potion#k finally ready?
Okay, so this is the #bKiller Spore Potion#k. Thank you, thank you for bring this to me. Please send #bScarrs#k my deepest gratitude.
Please deliver this to the Secretary of Magic.
Unless you really need me from something, please don't try starting a conversation with me.
I have just one more request for you. Would you be willing to listen?

To be honest, this #bKiller Spore Potion#k is not completely my own work. Do you remember #bBruce#k from #bHenesys#k? I have been friends with him since childhood, and the formula for the #bKiller Spore Potion#k was completed only after Bruce shared the results of his studies with me. This was all thanks to him, so I'd like for you to deliver this to him for me.
I wanted you to share this great piece of news with #bBruce#k, but I understand if you're busy.
Oh! You're here on behalf of #bScarrs#k?

Ahh, so this is the #bKiller Spore Potion#k that I was studying way back when! I had a tough time gathering up all the ingredients, so I left my research in a state of mere hypotheticals. I guess Scarrs was able to complete it. And he even had you bring a sample as well. Please tell him thank you.
Please go visit Bruce.
What brought you here?

Now you'll be able to penetrate the Thorny Vine which stands as a barrier in the Mushroom Forest, but before you go and do that, the #bSecretary of Domestic Affairs#k wants to have a word with you. Please go see him immediately.
Good luck.
You don't seem to follow instructions well. Come see me when you are ready.

I have been keeping up on your fabulous work. I understand that you were able to successfully create the #bKiller Spore Potion#k, which penetrates through the unpenetrable barrier in the forest? Well, congratulations!
The problem now is to figure out how to enter the castle.
Are you deaf or something? I thought I told you that you must see the #bSecretary of Domestic Affairs#k immediately.

Like I said, just breaking the barrier is not enough cause for celebration. The Mushroom Castle is extremely secure and does not allow anyone outside the Mushking Empire to enter, so it may not be so easy to infiltrate the castle. Hmmm... To figure out a way to enter, can you investigate the outer walls of the castle first?
Walk past the Mushroom Forest and when you reach the #bSplit Road of Destiny#k, just walk towards the castle. Good luck.
Really? So do you know of another way you can penetrate the castle? Well if not, just come and see me.
Hmmm I see… So they have completely shut off the entrance and everything.
Well anyway, good job navigating through the area.
I don't think you've thoroughly investigated the castle walls yet. Please do so.
Ah! There might be a way! If you utilize the Thorny Vine that we'd planted for the protection of our castle, you just might be able to enter the castle's premises!
If you can somehow remove the thorns from the Thorny Vine, then you should be able to climb over the castle walls just by stepping over the vines. Of course, that would also require a Thorn Remover…

A #bThorn Remover#k is created out of the extracts of the mysterious herbs in the highlands of El Nath. King Pepe used these herbs to intoxicate pigs and take over the Mushroom Forest. #b#t4000501##k is where you'll find the extracts of the herb. Please gather #b100 #t4000501#s#k and bring them to #bSecretary of Magic#k.
This is your only hope of entering the castle. Please think it through and come back to see me if you change your mind.
What? You need a #bThorn Remover#k? Wow, always asking for things that are so difficult to obtain… Well, have you brought all the ingredients for making the remover?

Hmmm, so this is the tail of a pig that was intoxicated by the magic herbs found in the highlands, eh? I can't believe King Pepe controlled his monsters with this… Anyway, you should extract its concentrate, then use spells to purify the extract.
Gather #b100 #t4000501#s#k, then take them over to #b#p1300004##k.
Hmmm? You want me to make a #bThorn Remover#k for you? Simple, you'll need to bring me the ingredients. No point standing here without any ingredients to work with.
The #b#t2430015##k is ready. Here, take it.
Hopefully this will help you infiltrate the castle.
Don't you need some #b#t2430015##k? Well, just come see me when you do need some.
Were you able to successfully enter the castle?
Okay, okay, you're doing fine. Just work a little harder so we can all escape from this terrible situation.
Go ahead and use the #bThorn Remover#k to enter the Mushroom Castle.
Hey! I heard that you were finally able to enter the castle. Is that true? Well then, please… Could you please find my brother for me?

Both of our parents passed away when we were young, so I basically raised my brother growing up. Ever since I became a Security Officer, we lived together within the castle walls, but when the evacuations happened, I was too busy protecting the Mushking to realize that I had left my brother inside.
He's lived there practically since birth, so he knows every corner of the castle. He's probably hiding quietly somewhere inside, hoping to be rescued. Please rescue my brother for me.
He's my only brother… please reconsider.
I… I am scared… Please…please help me…
What? My brother sent you here? Ahhh… I am safe now. Thank you so much…
Please…please save my brother #b#p1300008##k.
There might be a way to escape this place. Can you help me with one thing?

Before I hid here, I think I saw a penguin walking around the area with a strange-looking helmet. If you can get me that helmet, then I think I'll be able to disguise myself as one of the penguins and escape this place. Please get me the #b#t4001317##k.
Please take me back to my brother… please…
Did you bring back a #b#t4001317##k for me?
Great! I can finally go home! Thank you so much.
Without a #b#t4001317##k, there's no way I can escape the castle. It's too dangerous…

You'll be entering the castle soon, and… Well, I actually have a favor to ask of you. While we hurriedly vacated the castle, we neglected to pack enough supplies for the soldiers. The Head Security Officer and his men are working hard protecting the area, but they are in dire need of some supplies. Please help them, ok?

Okay good. Acquiring brand-new supplies may be difficult to do right now, so I suggest you gather up #b200 #t4000502#s#k that can be reused and bring them to #b#p1300005##k. He'll know what to do with them.
Ahh, so that's what it is. You don't necessarily have to help us, but it is an important matter for us, so please reconsider.
Ahhh… so this is what's left of the helmet. It's a bit broken, but with a little tweaking here and there, I think this can be reused.
Thank you so much! We've been terribly short on combat supplies. I can't believe we have been backed into a corner like this... Please, please defeat #b#p1300001##k for all of us.
Thanks for your work, but this is not enough. Please gather #b200 #t4000502#s#k.
Since you came and helped us out once… I'd like to ask you for another favor. Can you gather up some more supplies for the soldiers?
The helmets you gathered up for us took care of some of our needs, but we also need some weapons. #bRoyal Guard Pepes#k use #b#t4000503#s#k. Can you get us #b200#k of those?
I understand that you are busy, but do come and see me if you happen to change your mind.
Wait, did you collect them all already?
Thank you so, so much. These supplies will be given to the soldiers that will help provide support for you while you battle to regain our kingdom.
That's not enough. We need #b200 #t4000503#s#k.

Hello, dear hero. I have been keeping up with your phenomenal work from what my men have been reporting to me. #b(Cough)#k I am but a foolish king that lost his castle... It's embarassing to have to see you like this. Since my #bPrime Minister#k is nowhere to be found, you are literally our only hope. Please slay King Pepe and rescue my #b#p1300002##k.

#bKing Pepe#k is trying to arrange a marriage with his dumb son and my #b#p1300002##k. I must prevent that wedding from taking place, so I need you to defeat King Pepe. He has three Yeti brothers guarding him at all times, so it won't be an easy task. Best of luck to you.
Are you not ready to leave yet? Please prepare yourself for this journey, because there's simply not much time....#b(Cough)#k
Did you…did you really defeat #bKing Pepe#k?
This is beyond comprehension. I can't thank you enough for saving the Empire from such danger! Thank you, thank you!
Looks like you have yet to defeat #bKing Pepe#k and his trusty Yeti guards. Please defeat them all.
I…actually have something that I'd like for you to look for on my behalf.

When King Pepe invaded our castle, we were so busy trying to evacuate from the premises that I couldn't find the Royal Seal that was supposed to be locked inside the castle's safe. The Royal Seal is the symbol of our kingdom, and I can't imagine who would have stolen it from us. Please find it for me…

If that Royal Seal turns out to be in King Pepe's possession, then it'll allow him to officially announce the wedding between his son and Princess Violetta, not to mention take over of the Empire. The only ones who have the authority to open the safe are #bMushking#k himself, #bVioletta#k, the #bPrime Minister#k and myself... Anyway, we must find that Royal Seal at once.
Please think about it and reconsider. The future of our Empire is at stake.
You found the Royal Seal! Thank you so much!

Yes… I have heard. Never in my life did I suspect that our very own #bPrime Minister#k would have been behind this. He was such a noble, loyal man, but he was blinded by his greed. Anyway, now that we have the Royal Seal back, our job is to restore the Empire to its original state.
The Royal Seal is the symbol of our Empire. We must retrieve it at once!
Ah… you're the hero that's here to save me?
Please defeat the Prime Minister at once!
Please, I want you to eliminate the rest of the Prime Minister's crew. Use the #b#t4032405##k that I gave you in #bSkyscraper 3#k to enter the #bCastle Security Room#k.

My father must be concerned about me, and I must notify him of what's going on. I don't think he's going to believe that the #bPrime Minister#k was the traitor. Take this #bEmblem#k with you. That's the only thing that'll make him believe you.

And also… Please take this #b#t4032386##k to him as well. It's a symbol of their surrender, so we should keep it within our Empire and use it to let the whole world know of King Pepe's evil plot to overthrow the Empire.
I trust you to get this done. Please let my dad know that I want nothing more than to eliminate these cronies and see him safely in the castle soon.
He won't believe you unless you take this emblem with you. Take it.
What…?! What? The #bPrime Minister#k was behind all this? No…! No way…! Wait, this is…!

Oh, it really is our #b#t4032387##k. How could this have happened? I trusted him with everything. It really is all my fault. It's all my fault for failing to take good care of my family and letting my empire down. *Sniff sniff*
Anyway, thank goodness all this is done. Now we can concentrate on removing the rest of their army and reclaiming what is rightfully our castle. Thank you.
The #b#t1082254##k that I have given you is a glove that has been passed down for generations throughout the history of our great empire. Please put it to good use.
Please go visit my dad.
What? What are you saying? Are you accusing the #bPrime Minister#k of being the culprit? Then show me some proof…!
Hi there. #b#h0##k, hero of the mighty Mushking Empire. Before you leave the Empire, I'd like to make one more request for you.
Of course, you'll be rewarded for your work. If you can take care of this, I'll give you one of the #bKing Pepe's Weapon Scrolls#k that our patrolmen found.

Okay, thanks for taking up the offer. It's about eliminating the remaining minions of #bKing Pepe's#k army. I'd like for you to eliminate some of them while our army is being gathered. We can take care of the rest after that.
If you are busy, then that's okay. You can always come back and help us down the road.
Did you manage to defeat them already? You really are something!
Please put it to good use.
I don't think you have taken care of enough of those enemies. Please eliminate more of them.
Did you happen to lose the #bKiller Spore Potion#k?
I really had a tough time making this, so please don't lose it.
Oh, are you sure you don't need it anymore? Then come see me when you do.

Congratulations on making the job advancement as a warrior. I can see you're exuding the quiet confidence of a powerful warrior, and yet...you seem to lack something. I suggest you train a bit more at the Training Center, where you can become even more formidable. I'll teach you how to get to the Training Center. Are you interested?

That's great! Go outside, and you'll see a series of arrows pointing in a certain direction. Follow them and you'll see the entrance to the Training Center, where you can train to become even more powerful!
I suggest you go there before you reach Level 20, because you won't be allowed inside afterwards.
Ah, really? Well, the Training Center can be found nearby, so maybe you can find it on your own. Best of luck to you!

Hey, are you familiar with the concept of #bParty Hunting#k? It's when you venture out to hunt as a group, with the mentality of 'all for one and one for all.' If you train in a party, it will allow you to overcome some tough obstacles.\r\n
This training session will not be easy for you to complete by yourself, but if you team up and train in a party, it should be a piece of cake. Do you want to try it?
Alright then. Defeat #b200 Stumps#k. It will not be easy, so try joining a party and hunting with others!
Teamwork is one of the most important aspects of your combat abilities, one that you need to nurture in order to become an excellent adventurer.
Great work there. Don't forget, hunting as a party may help you complete your quests much faster.

Did you hear the story? Recently, a huge sandstorm swept across Sunset Road in Nihal Desert. The path that connects Ariant to Magatia disappeared completely for a whole week. Even the residents there claim it was the biggest sandstorm they'd seen in a hundred years.

After the sandstorm passed, I checked to see how it affected the creatures and discovered something amazing. A Pyramid! A giant Pyramid standing right before my eyes!\nI think it's a Pyramid that used to be buried underground but resurfaced after the sandstorm drastically changed the landscape. The local residents claim the Pyramid is evil and don't go anywhere near it.

But I disagree with them. An evil Pyramid? That doesn't make any sense! So I decided to enter the Pyramid and study the basics of the ancient burial process. But someone stopped me in my tracks, saying that I was not qualified and that I would only enrage some god known as Nett.
Apparently, only people over Level 40 are allowed in. Unfortunately, I am only at Level 39. This is why I am suggesting that you venture inside the Pyramid. What do you say?

Awesome! I want you to investigate the inside of the Pyramid thoroughly and tell me what it's like in detail. Head to #bSahel 3#k, and you'll find a new path that leads you to the Pyramid. I'll be here waiting. The man that stopped me at the entrance of the Pyramid is called #b#eDuarte#n#k. Strange name, don't you think?
A giant Pyramid has revealed itself out of the blue! Aren't you excited to find out what's inside?
Stop immedietely, foolish one. Are you not afraid of death?\r\n#b#L0#I want to explore the Pyramid.#l\n#k

Fools. A sea of fools. Are all humans this foolish? Even one who called himself a scholar dared to venture here. But is not death something to avoid?\r\n#b#L0#I am here on behalf of that scholar, Byron.#l\n#k

I see. That fool. I was merciful enough to save him from the throngs of death, and instead he drags himself to another one of its doorsteps. So be it. Let us see if he can escape the breath of Anubis.

I will permit your entrance, but it remains to be seen if the Pyramid will accept you as well. If it does, then you will acquire the Pharaoh Yeti's Gem. If you bring that to me, I will lead you directly to a spot where you can acquire many other rare gems.

Head to #bSahel 3#k, and you'll find a new path that leads you to the Pyramid. I'll be here waiting. The man that stopped me at the entrance of the Pyramid is called #b#eDuarte#n#k. Strange name, don't you think?
Oh wow! You brought them all!! Sweet! Here's an item like I promised. I don't really need it anyway, so take it!
You don't have #b1 #t4000001##k and #b5 #t4000000##k, right? Don't worry too much about it. I'll be staying here for a while.

인형! 인형! 인형이 갖고 싶어. 내 취미는 인형뽑기 기계에서 예쁜 인형을 뽑는거야. 방향을 잘 맞추고 원하는 인형을 집어 뽑아 올릴 때의 그 기쁨이란..캬~ 그건 인형을 뽑아 본 사람 만이 알 수 있지.
그런데 요즘 인형뽑기 기계가 몬스터로 변해버려서 인형 모으는게 부쩍 힘들어졌어. 난 요리라면 모를까 무서운 몬스터들을 상대할 자신이 없거든... 시간이 되면 내가 예쁜 인형들을 모을 수 있게 도와줄래?

You must be confused in more ways than one. It's totally understandable, seeing that you just recently awoke inside the ice cave with no recollection of your past. Add to that my calling you a hero, and...I totally understand. I'll explain to you in detail exactly what happened.

A few hundred years ago, the whole world was under the reign of the evil Black Mage. Using his tremendous power, the Black Mage led Maple World closer and closer to destruction, and he almost succeeded.

Many people valiantly tried to keep the Black Mage from ruining their lives, but they were not strong enough. It reached the point where the whole world was on the verge of utter destruction, and that's when a few brave souls made a pivotal decision. They would battle the Black Mage head-on, all by themselves, to buy the rest of us time to find refuge in places far, far away.

No one knows the details of the battle, only the results: The Black Mage was sealed away while the heroes made the ultimate sacrifice and disappeared. Thanks to them, Maple World finally found peace and...that was that. Sadly, it didn't take long for people to forget the heroes.

A lot of time passed, then a Book of Prophecy appeared out of nowhere. According to that book, the Black Mage had cast one final curse on the heroes before he lost his powers. That final curse wiped the heroes of all their memories and abilities, and trapped them in ice for hundreds of years.

Everyone thought the book was a bunch of garbage, but one race thought otherwise and began conducting research on the Book of Prophecy. I am the last remaining member of the race, and that's why I've been waiting on this island, knowing that one day, the heroes would reawaken.

And here you are! One of the very heroes that the Book of Prophecy mentions. One of the heroes that saved Maple World, only to be tragically forgotten by Maplers over the years. And I am certain that you're the hero that will save us once more. Do you get it now?
Are you sure? Because you look a bit dazed. Hmmm, just to make sure you really processed everything I just said, I'm going to give you a pop quiz about it. Tell me when you're ready to start.
You must be a bit overwhelmed with everything that I threw at you just now. If you didn't catch it all, I'm more than happy to tell you the story once more. Tell me when you're ready.

아휴~ 궁금해. 궁금해요. 뭐가 그렇게 궁금하냐고요? 저는 달을 제대로 본 적이 없어요. 왜냐면 달에서 태어나 여태 그 곳에서 살고 있어서 제대로 볼 수 없었죠. 그래서 이곳으로 내려왔는데.. 도무지 보이질 않네요.
대체 달은 어떻게 생긴거죠? 여행자님께서 알려주시겠어요?
제가 드린 #b#t2430031##k는 소비창을 열어보시면 있을거에요. 마을 어딘가에서 밝은 보름달을 보게 되면 가까이 가서 #b인벤토리(단축키 I)#k를 열고 #i2430031:# #b#t2430031##k를 더블클릭하세요. 그러면 기타창에 #b달사진#k이 생길거에요. 달사진이 시간이 지나 현상이 되어 선명해 지면 그 때 저에게 가져와 주세요.
제가 불쌍하지도 않으신가요? (..훌쩍..)
꺄아~ 드디어 제가 부탁한 달사진을 가지고 오신건가요? 어서 제게 주세요!
와~ 정말 제가 제일 가지고 싶어하던 달사진이 맞네요! 달사진을 아주 많이 가지고 싶어졌어요! 내일 또 저를 찾아오셔서 달사진을 찍어주셔야해요!
달사진이 없으신거 같은데요? 아니면 아직 선명하지 않던가요. 달사진은 시간이 지나야 현상이 된답니다. #i4032433:# 이렇게 선명해지면 저에게 가져다주세요.
달사진을 찍는데 실패하셨나요?
걱정마세요. 달사진을 찍을 폴라로이드는 언제든 다시 드릴 수 있으니까요. 어라? 어디갔지? 잠시 후에 다시 말을 걸어주시면 폴라로이드를 찾아 드릴게요.
부끄러워 하실 건 없어요.
자, 폴라로이드에요. 꼭 보름달 가까이서 예쁜 사진을 찍어서 현상이 되면 저에게 가져와주세요.
짜잔~ 이거봐 내가 무지개 그림을 그렸어. 오랫만에 그림을 그리려니 힘이 좀 드네? 어때 정말 멋지지? 그런데 아무래도 색이 없는 것이 문제야. 나한테 크레파스가 없었거든. 네가 대신 완성해 주지 않겠어?
크레파스는 가가한테 있어. 요일마다 다른 색을 빌려주니까 잘 설득해봐. 만약에 도중에 그림완성을 포기하고 싶다면 나에게 가져와서 돌려주면 돼.
그래.뭐 네 도움따위 없어도 된다고.
와아! 그림을 완성했구나? 흠~ 마음에 드는걸?

Talk to Syras at the Ariant ticket box desk.

He made a scene because he wanted to get going before schedule. I didn't know what to do. I tried to calm him down, but I couldn't understand his gibberish. Anyway, he got on the earliest airship and left for Orbis.

Now that I think about it, he was rather strange and awkward. If you're looking for that man, I recommend heading over to Orbis. Oh! Talk to #bIsa#k the station guide at Orbis Station. She'd remember the man if she saw him.
The ship is about to take off. If you want to go to Orbis, I suggest you hurry.
What? That's not the right guy? Then ask someone else, huh? I'm a busy guy.
Hello, welcome to Orbis Station. My name is Isa. How can I help you? \r\n#b#L0#I'm looking for someone. Have you seen a suspicious fellow wearing a cape wrapped around his entire body?#l\n#k

A suspicious fellow? Hmm, I do remember a couple of people wearing big capes, but they weren't exactly suspicious. There was a magician who seemed to be into flashy capes and a warrior who was headed to Victoria Island. And...\r\n#b#L0#Was there someone who seemed a bit absent-minded? Who arrived from Ariant early in the morning.#l\n#k

Oh, yes! That guy? He left for Leafre as soon as he got here. As you know, Orbis Station is always so hectic. He didn't know where to go, so I helped him find his way, although he seemed a bit uncomfortable around me for some reason.
Talk to Isa at Orbis Station.
Come to think of it, he did mumble something under his breath... I think he said something about having to go to Tera Forest.\r\n#b#L0#Tera Forest? Are you sure he didn't say Minar Forest?#l\n#k

Corba in Leafre once told me about Tera Forest. Apparently, it's a small forest located near the eastern border of Minar Forest. He said not many people know about it because it's secluded. If you want to go to Leafre, you should leave now. The airship to Leafre will take off soon.
Since you're here in Orbis, why don't you take a tour before you leave? You can catch an airship every hour to any destination.
You found me! But that means nothing! You'll never be able to drag me out of here!!\r\n#b#L0#I only wanted to meet you. I'm not here to drag you anywhere...#l\n#k
I don't know who you are. I don't trust you...or anyone! I won't tell you a thing. It could create time distortion. I don't know! I can't figure it out. I don't know what went wrong where.
The strange man said he was going to Tera Forest, near the eastern border of Minar Forest.
Why have you followed me here? I don't know who you are.\r\n#b#L0#Why did you attack the Alcadno Society?#l\n#k

Alcadno? Oh, you're talking about those fools that rely on machines. They don't think about how their actions will affect the future. Those fools will spend a lifetime regretting what they've done. But I've come too far. It's too early. This isn't where I was trying to visit.\r\n#b#L0#What in the world are you talking about? Where did you come from? Tell me what's going on!#l\n#k
Can you handle it? You could get lost in time like me. It's a dangerous risk. And I may not be able to complete my mission.\r\n#b#L0#I'll help you. What is this mission you're talking about?#l\n#k
You... You seem trustworthy. I can feel it. You can't tell a soul what I'm about to tell you. Can you promise to keep this a secret? Can you handle that?
I'm from the year 2503. I came from Neo City to change the errors of the past. But this isn't Neo City. I think I may have transcended time and space. Everything is a mess. And I seem to be lost.

That door you see over there is called the #bTime Gate#k. It's a the key to traveling through time. I'm from Neo City in the year 2503. Machines have taken over our city and are attacking humans. We could not find a solution to the chaos, so I came to the past to set things right.

But I've arrived somewhere, or somewhen, totally unexpected. I was running around like a headless chicken, thinking this was the Neo City of the past, but I realized I was in the wrong place and time. I must go to the right time! But I lost the Pocket Watch that acts as the key to the Time Gate.
Help me find the key to the Time Gate! I will compensate you. I must undo the mistakes in the past, but I can't find the Pocket Watch anywhere. It must be somewhere in the forest, though. Right?
Are you telling me not to trust you?
Yes, this is the Pocket Watch! Let me see it!

Oh no... It's not working. I can no longer carry out my mission. The Pocket Watch only works when its possessor is in an appropriate time. It also checks its possessor's mental and physical state. It probably detects my exhaustion.

Wait a minute. I have an idea. Put the Pocket Watch on your palm!\r\n#b(You place the Pocket Watch on one hand and cover it with the other. The Pocket Watch begins to glow, and then the glow disappears.)#k
You! You might be the one! Please, take over my mission and change the past! I hand over the Pocket Watch to you. Please, you must do this!
The Pocket Watch has my name engraved on the back. I'm pretty sure I lost it somewhere in Minar Forest.

Before you can travel though time, you must first pass Nex's test. Nex is the Gatekeeper of Time, and he lives inside the Old Tree of Tera in Tera Forest. You must defeat him before you can time travel.
When you defeat Nex, the Time Gate that lets you teleport to year 2021 will open.
You will not be granted authorization to travel through time unless you defeat Nex the Gatekeeper of Time.
Ah, you've passed Nex's first test. This means you have earned the right to travel to year 2021 using the Time Gate. You're doing great! What a relief!
Take the Time Traveler's Pocket Watch and go through the Time Gate.
Come back after you've passed Nex's test. Nex the Gatekeeper of Time lives inside the Old Tree of Tera.
When you arrive in the year 2021, you need to retrieve a certain item. You see, the cause of all the problems in my time must've started in 2021, when the technology for A.I. machinery was invented.

From what I've heard, it all started with some scribbles. They were just meaningless doodles, at first, but A.I. robots were built based on that drawing. The scribbled note should be in a trash can somewhere. You must find it! Please, rifle through trash cans and bring me back that piece of paper!
I don't exactly where the paper is... Search in every trash can you come across!
This is important. Before things get worse, we must destroy that paper.
You found it! Let me see!
No, no, no. This isn't it. This isn't what I'm looking for. I could've sworn... I mean, I'm sure it was 2021 that A.I.'s were first designed and invented. Could it be that I'm mistaken?
Keep searching in trash cans!
Don't come any closer! Who are you? Where is everyone? And where did all these monsters come from? \r\n#L0##bDon't worry. I'll help you.#l\n#k
Then defeat all of these monsters. I think they're exponentially increasing.
It's not just here. The entire town is crowded with monsters. Please eliminate 50 of every type of monster and collect 30 of each of those monsters' dropped items to stop them from respawning.
You said you were going to help me!! You lied!
Have you eliminated all the monsters? Did you collect their dropped items too?
Even now, these monsters are not going away. What's happening? Where are my mom and dad?
Please collect 30 dropped items of each monster.
Please eliminate 50 of every type of monster in town.
*sniff sniff* These monsters ate my Sketchbook. Could you find my Sketchbook for me? *sniff sniff*
Please help me find 20 Loose-Leaf Pages of my Sketchbook. *sniff sniff*
*sob sob* My sketchbook!!! *sob sob*
Oh, my drawings... Did you bring them?
Hmph, it's all wrinkled. My drawings... *sniff sniff*
Please, please help me find 20 Loose-Leaf Pages of my Sketchbook! Those wicked Slimes ate them!

I think she's disappointed because she didn't find all of the pages from her Sketchbook. She was so proud of her new robot drawing, too. Could you just keep an eye out for pieces of paper you might see lying around?
It really was an incredible drawing. I hope she isn't too bummed out about it, though I know she is.
I wasn't asking you to go out of your way to find them. I just thought you could keep an eye out for them in case you saw any. If you're too lazy to do that... Then...fine.
What is it?\r\n#b#L0#I think you should know something.#l\n#k
What? Did you learn something?\r\n#b#L0#I'm not sure, but I met a boy while I was investigating a little town during year 2016, and he mentioned something about a robot.#l\n#k
Is that so? Hmm.\r\n#b#L0#Yes, but the kids lost the drawing. I know it's just a child's scribbles, but I couldn't just ignore it.#l\n#k
I see. It really isn't anything definite. But I can't simply ignore it. either. Thank you. Nothing is for sure, but we may have found a clue.
Thanks. I think it's time you got ready for your next time travel. Let me know when you're prepared.
Where have all the grown-ups gone?
You must pass Nex's test but you can travel to a different time. Don't get too comfortable. Nex will be much stronger this time around.
When you defeat Nex, the Time Gate to the year 2099 will open.
You won't be authorized to travel time unless you defeat Nex the Gatekeeper of Time.
Ah, you've passed Nex's second test. Now then, you should be able to access the Time Gate to the year 2099.
Take the Time Traveler's Pocket Watch and go through the Time Gate.
Come back after you've passed Nex's test. Nex the Gatekeeper of Time lives inside the Old Tree of Tera.

According to the records I found, a giant robot appeared in the year 2099. At the time, this was regarded as a silly rumor, but I have a hunch it's not something we should overlook. Please travel to year 2099 and investigate.
If you get lucky and find the robot, destroy it. Please. For the sake of the future.
This is serious business. If you've lost interest, now would be a good time for you to quit and go about your business.
So? Was there really a giant robot?\r\n#b#L0#Yes, there really was. As you requested, I destroyed it.#l\n#k
You did? Thank you. I wish this were the end to our problem.
Please travel to year 2099 and investigate the robot that appeared in the harbor. If you happen to run into the robot, please destroy it.
It's dangerous here. Please go somewhere safer. A bunch of unidentifiable monsters appeared and took over the harbor.\r\n#L0##bWould you like me to help you?#l\n#k

Would you? I'm trying to eliminate the monsters that have taken over the harbor, but they outnumber me and I don't know if I can handle all of them on my own. Would you help me eliminate these monsters?
If you can, please eliminate 50 Overlord A's and 40 Overlord B's while I evacuate the people.
It's dangerous here. Please get yourself to the nearest shelter where it's safe. Hurry!
How did it go?\r\n#b#L0#I took care of the monsters as you requested.#l\n#k
Thank you. Thank you so much for your hard work. Thanks to you, the people at the harbor were able to evacuate safely.
Please eliminate 50 Overlord A's and 40 Overlord B's while I evacuate everyone. Please help us. Hurry!

Could I ask you for one last favor? Everyone at the harbor was evacuated except one person. His name is Captain Edmond. He's stubborn and wouldn't cooperate. I think he remained behind, somewhere at the harbor. I must deliver the Shelter Key to him. Will you help me?
But there is one problem. I dropped the Shelter Key. I think one of the monsters might have picked it up. Could you find the Shelter Key and take it over to Captain Edmond?
I'm so worried about the captain. He's all alone right now.
What is it? What brings you here?\r\n#b#L0#I've come to give you the Shelter Key. It's dangerous here.#l\n#k
Nonsense! I'm fine. But I'll take the key.
Please retrieve the Shelter Key from the monsters and deliver it to Captain Edmond. He's somewhere at the harbor.
Please retrieve the Shelter Key from the monsters and deliver it to Captain Edmond. He's somewhere at the harbor.

Look here. The harbor has been entirely overtaken by monsters. The harbor represents the dream and dignity of the men of the sea, and I can't bear to just watch those monsters stomp all over that. I'm planning to drive them out. You seem young and capable. Why don't you help me, huh?

Alright! If you have been observing these monsters, you'll know that they have Radar Devices that operate as their eyes. If you eliminate those Radar Devices, they won't be able to do a thing. Bring me 20 Overlord A Radar Devices and 40 Overlord B Radar Devices. This isn't going to put a stop to the problem, but it'll earn us some time.
You're young, yet you lack determination and courage. Hmph.
Ha, sensational! Thanks to your hard work, I can sit back and watch these monsters completely lose their sense of direction. Even the thought of it makes me laugh.
Did you bring me 20 Overlord A Radar Devices and 40 Overlord B Radar Devices?
Before your third time travel, you must pass Nex's test again. Don't get too comfortable, though. Nex will be even stronger this time around.
When you defeat Nex, the Time Gate to the year 2215 will open.
You won't be authorized to travel through time unless you defeat Nex the Gatekeeper of Time.
Ah, you've passed Nex's third test. Now then, you should be able to access the Time Gate to the year 2215.
Take the Time Traveler's Pocket Watch and go through the Time Gate.
Come back after you've passed Nex's test. Nex the Gatekeeper of Time lives inside the Old Tree of Tera.

I have an assignment for you in the year 2215. That year was the worst year in history, when the evolved robots bombed the City Center. The A.I. missile that bombed the City Center was called Dunas. Please travel to year 2215 and destroy the missile.
There isn't much recorded about Dunas. I don't even know what it looks like. All I can tell you is to be extra careful out there.
What, are you getting scared? It's too late. Think about it. You've seen too much. You know too much about the future at this point.
Dunas is an android? Was that possible in 2215? Something doesn't add up.
I have a bad feeling about this. I feel like we're missing a huge piece of the puzzle.
The A.I. missile that bombed the City Center was called Dunas. Please travel to year 2215 and destroy the missile.

Hello there, #b#h0##k. This is a very dangerous place. It was bombed recently, and I must warn you that walking around like you are doing right now poses a threat to your safety.\r\n#L0##bHow did you know my name? And how did this happen?#l\n#k
How do I know your name? That's a secret. I have to wipe out these noisy robots. They keep beeping rambunctiously, and it's driving me crazy. Won't you help me?

On the day of the bombing, I woke up and the City Center was already destroyed. It's been overtaken by those noisy robots. I'm THIS close to having a nervous breakdown. Please #b#h0##k, all you have to do is eliminate 50 of those noisy Robbies.
That's alright. I'll manage. I am a bit weak... And a little too pretty to be doing this... But I'll be alright.
Thank you. Now I can breathe again. Where could have those robots have come from?
I'm THIS close to having a nervous breakdown. Please eliminate 50 of those noisy Robbies.
I'm THIS close to having a nervous breakdown. Please eliminate 50 of those noisy Robbies.
I'm THIS close to having a nervous breakdown. Please eliminate 50 of those noisy Robbies.

I was so happy that those Robbies were silenced, but then I began to think that I may be the only survivor left. That's so frightening. I mean, there must be other survivors, right? #b#h0##k, could you investigate the area and see if you can find any?
Could you search little deeper into the area, near where the missile landed? I haven't been able to search that far.
#b#h0##k, do you think there are any survivors besides me?
Who is that? There is a survivor! Here, right here!
I'm so relieved that there is another survivor.
There must be other survivors, right? #b#h0##k, could you investigate the area and see if you can find anyone?

Quiet! Keep it down. This place is filled with Iruvatas. Don't you see them? Iruvatas are androids that resemble female warriors. The are made to attack, so they're extremely dangerous. I don't know who you are, but could you please eliminate the Iruvatas?
Wow, you're a brave one, aren't you? Then please eliminate 50 Iruvatas. Woohoo! I'll be rooting for you.
I know. Anyone would be scared. They are, like I said, extremely dangerous.
I was cheering for you from here. That was incredible! But first things first. Am I the only survivor?\r\n#b#L0#There is a lady named May not too far from here.#l\n#k
Oh... Really? Then I should suck it up and go over there. Thank you so much for your help.
Please eliminate 50 Iruvatas. Please be careful. I'm telling you. They're extremely dangerous.
Please eliminate 50 Iruvatas. Please be careful. I'm telling you. They're extremely dangerous.
Please eliminate 50 Iruvatas. Please be careful. I'm telling you. They're extremely dangerous.
Right over there is where the missile landed. I have a feeling the Iruvatas and Robbies are being built there. There must be something going on. If you want to investigate, head right.
You seem like you're searching for something. I'd go right. It seems suspicious. Alright, I'll see you around then.
You seem reluctant. Of course, I understand. After all, that's where the missile landed. It couldn't be safe.

This... This is Time Sand. Time Sand stores the memories of time. This much Time Sand probably has a decent amount of memories. Good. It's definitely worth looking into. Don't you feel like we're getting somewhere?
Keep up the good work.
If you've found something, why don't you head over to the person that's looking for what you've found?
You haven't found any clues?
Before your fourth time travel, you must pass Nex's test again. Don't get too comfortable, though. Nex will be even stronger this time around!
When you defeat Nex, the Time Gate to the year 2216 will open.
You won't be authorized to travel through time unless you defeat Nex the Gatekeeper of Time.
Ah, you've passed Nex's fourth test. Now then, you should be able to access the Time Gate to year 2216.
Take the Time Traveler's Pocket Watch and go through the Time Gate.
Come back after you've passed Nex's test. Nex the Gatekeeper of Time lives inside the Old Tree of Tera.

The purpose of this next time travel is to defeat Aufheben. Aufheben is the name of the central robot that began controlling all electronic devices after the City Center was bombed. Since Dunas was an android, it is quite likely that Aufheben is also an android. Do you think you can defeat Aufheben?
Aufheben is strong beyond your imagination. It won't be easy destroying Aufheben. Best wishes.
Are you not ready? Now, that's a problem. We don't have much time left.
You're getting stronger and stronger. I can't believe you've defeated Aufheben. You are a true hero and an incredible time traveler.
Please defeat Aufheben, the central robot that controls all electronic devices in town. That might be the last step to changing the past and setting things right.

Are you from the support unit? I'm so glad you're here. Completing the mission here seems nearly impossible with the frequent attacks from the Afterlords and Prototype Lords. I'll give you the details a little later. Please just eliminate these monsters first.
Please eliminate 50 Afterlords and 40 Prototype Lords.
Isn't the support unit supposed to provide support?
Thank you. You've been extremely helpful.
Please eliminate 50 Afterlords and 40 Prototype Lords.
I'm glad you came. I received a request for help, but I can't detect the exact location. We have to dispatch a search party, and I need you to lead it.
Okay. The signal is coming from east, and we suspect the victim is a teenage female. Please investigate the eastern regions and let me know as soon as you find someone.
Somebody's life depends on this. We don't have time to sit and wait around!
Help! Help me! Are you here to rescue me?
Thank you. I've drained all my energy, but I'm hanging in there. I didn't think anyone would ever get here. I was so scared.
Please search the eastern regions and let me know as soon as you find someone.
By the way, did you see it? I saw an angel.\r\n#L0##bAn angel?#l\n#k
I saw an angel in the location where the high rise collapsed.\r\n#L0##bThat can't be. Angels don't exist. Are you feeling alright?#l\n#k
I'm serious. It's true. The angel was beaming radiantly. If you don't believe me, head east to where the high rise collapsed. You'll see.
You have to believe me.
I'm telling you. You should see for yourself.
Time Sand again. We've got a good amount of Time Sand now, but we still haven't found the pivotal clue. Ugh, this is so frustrating. What are we missing? I'll hang on to this for now.
Did you see the angel?
If you happen to find Time Sand, bring it over to me.
Before your fifth time travel, you must pass Nex's test again. I know I keep saying this, but trust me, Nex will be even stronger this time around!
When you defeat Nex, the Time Gate to the year 2230 will open.
You won't be authorized to travel time until you defeat Nex the Gatekeeper of Time.
Ah, you've passed Nex's fifth test. Now then, you should be able to access the Time Gate to the year 2230.
Take the Time Traveler's Pocket Watch and go through the Time Gate.
Come back after you've passed Nex's test. Nex the Gatekeeper of Time lives inside the Old Tree of Tera.

You'll now travel through time a fifth time.. An android known as Oberon appeared in the year 2230. He is even more advanced than Aufheben. From what we've studied, there's a good chance that Oberon has the fifth Time Sand. Defeat Oberon and get me that Time Sand.
We don't have much time!
Are you saying you want to give up? Now?! Geez...
I was right. Oberon had the Time Sand. We're finally getting somewhere. Thank you again.
Now, I suppose we one last time to travel to...
Travel to the year 2230, defeat Oberon, and bring back the Time Sand.
Travel to the year 2230, defeat Oberon, and bring back the Time Sand.

Yoohoo! Here! Over here! How did you get in here? This tower could collapse any minute, you know. Since you've come so far, you're probably here to rumble with the Mavericks. Am I right? Then would you do me a favor?

Nalo says I'm too young and can't take on any major tasks. So he asked me to watch the Mavericks' movement patterns. But I know I can handle bigger things. I have something to investigate, so could you eliminate the Mavericks for me and report it to Nalo upstairs? Just 30 Mavericks of each type. Easy, huh? Then I'll see you later!
Come on, it'll be fun!
Who are you? You want something from me?\r\n#b#L0#I did a favor for Hoya, and I'm here to report it.#l\n#k
Why, that little rascal. I can't believe he dumped his responsibilities on you! I apologize. He doesn't think things through! How could he entrust a stranger with his duties?
Thank you for your help. Hoya will get an earful from me later.
All you have to do is eliminate 30 Maverick Type A, 30 Maverick Type S, and 30 Maverick Type D and report to Nalo.
Please eliminate 30 Maverick Type A, 30 Maverick Type S, and 30 Maverick Type D.
Before your sixth time travel, you must pass Nex's test again. Don't get too comfortable, though. Nex will be much stronger this time around. Really!
When you defeat Nex, the Time Gate to the year 2503 will open.
You won't be authorized to travel though time unless you defeat Nex the Gatekeeper of Time.
Ah, you've passed Nex's sixth test. Now then, you should be able to access the Time Gate to the year 2503.
Take the Time Traveler's Pocket Watch and go through the Time Gate.
Come back after you've passed Nex's test. Nex the Gatekeeper of Time lives inside the Old Tree of Tera.

After all that time traveling, I feel like nothing got resolved. Judging from all the Time Sand we've collected, I think the key clue is in year 2503, where I'm from. Please travel to the year 2503, destroy Nibelung, and report it to Ashura.
Ashura will be somewhere in Air Battleship Hermes.
Are you going to quit? Give up? Just like that? When we're so close?

You've destroyed Nibelung. If you're here to tell me about Andy, I already know. I owe you a debt of gratitude. Of course, this doesn't solve everything. I don't think you fully understand yet, but someday you will. It just isn't time yet.
I will not forget you, time traveler...
Go talk to Ashura...
Nibelung will soon begin attacking. I'm afraid. Do you think we'll be able to destroy it?
I have something that might interest you. Would you like to hear it?\r\n#b#L0#Sure. What is it?#l\n#k

Did you know the longest waterway in Maple World is the route that connects Aquarium to Herb Town. Today, we can travel via the Dolphin Taxi, but that was once a life-threatening route. Around the border between Mu Lung Garden and El Nath Mts, there is an area that's surrounded by fog all year long. It's known as the #bSea of Fog#k.\r\n#b#L0#What's the Sea of Fog like?#l\n#k

It's a place where the current is unpredictable and a thick fog blinds you. The place is surrounded in a mystique of frequent wrecks and countless terrifying rumors.\r\n#b#L0#What sort of rumors?#l\n#k

This is the most famous one: Once, there was a time when pirates roamed the seas, threatening Maple World. One nameless but courageous navy admiral hunted them all down. His fleet was undefeated, until one day it vanished into thin air. Decades later, his fleet reappeared in the Sea of Fog as a ghost ship.\r\n#b#L0#Eek! A ghost ship?#l\n#k
Har har. It's only a rumor among sailors. I, myself, have yet to see it. But I thought you'd be interested. Say, how would you like to investigate the ghost ship of the Sea of Fog?
Great! But I don't have any clues for you. Oh, actually, maybe the Dolphin Taxi could tell you something useful. It passes by the Sea of Fog every day. Who knows, maybe the ghost ship really exists!
Har har, you're only human, I suppose. Anyone would be scared after hearing the story. Right?
Be careful out there. The admiral's rage continues to rock the ship to this day.
Have you met the Dolphin Taxi? You might need its help to get to the Sea of Fog.

#b#p1032104##k told you to come see me?
Hmm, let me see.

Ah, I was just about to have a glass of this fine wine I received as a gift, but I didn't have any appetizer to drink the wine with.\n\nCould you bring me 20 chunks of #rPork#k? The #rRibbon Pigs#k could easily be found in #b#m100030000##k.
Aren't you curious?
What took you so long?\nThe therapeutic aroma of the wine will soon fade away.

Thanks, I'll try to enjoy every bite of it. I suppose I owe you some information now.
I'm sorry, I can't tell you exactly what to do, but I can tell you that people in Perion will know how to remove the red from the map. Really, I've seen them do it before.

Why don't you head over to see #b#p1020000##k in #bPerion#k?
Didn't I tell you to collect 20 chunks of #rPork#k?
Did you come all the way here to become a Pirate?
Not everyone can become a Pirate. In order to become one, you must be at least at Level 10.
#b#p1090000##k has recently parked her ship The Nautilus in between Henesys and Ellinia, and is staying there.
Oh, so you want to become a Pirate? Are you ready for it?
Okay, being a #rPirate#k requires a delicate balance of #bStrength and Dexterity#k. If you want to become one, you may want to see #b#p1090000##k at #rThe Nautilus#k.
Passing by me and go further, you can find #bPirate Statue#k to teleport to #bNautilus#k.
You're not here to become a Pirate? Well... whatever it is, if you feel like you're ready, let me know.
Are you here to become a Warrior? Then you've come to the right place ...
If you are at least at #blevel 10#k, then I can transform you into a #bWarrior#k. Please see me when you're ready to take the next step.
You haven't met #b#p1022000##k yet? I told you to head over to #rPerion#k!
Have you chosen to become a Warrior? Is it based on the way I look as a proud Warrior that made the decision for you? In any case, once you're ready, press ACCEPT.
Alright. Being a #rWarrior#k emphasizes #bstrength(STR)#k, with some dexterity (DEX) with it. You should head over to #rPerion#k and see #b#p1022000##k.
Passing by me and go further, you can find #bWarrior Statue#k to teleport to #bPerion#k.
You weren't here to become a Qarrior? That's alright. Whatever occupation you'd like to choose, whenever you're ready, come talk to me.
Are you here to become a Bowman?
Please talk to me when you're ready to become a Bowman. To qualify as one, you'll need to be at least at #blevel 10#k. Press S to look at your character stats.
I thought I told you to meet #b#p1012100##k of #rHenesys#k. You still haven't met her?

Have you heard of a story of #b#p1012100##k, the marksman extraordinaire? Bowmen have the luxury of performing long-range attacks with great accuracy. What do you think? How about becoming a #bBowman#k?
Alright. To meet #b#p1012100##k, you'll need to head over to #rHenesys#k. If you're not sure of the way, press #rW#k to check out the #bWorld Map#k.
Passing by me and go further, you can find #bBowman Statue#k to teleport to #bHenesys#k.
Once you meet #bAthena Pierce#k of #bHenesys#k, that may be enough for you to change your mind. If not, then take a look at other Bowmen~ If you need assistance regarding the jobs, talk to me.
Did you make yourself come all the way down to this dingy hideout just to become a Thief?
Haha. See me only when you're ready to become a Thief at heart. I have one rule of thumb about becoming a Thief. Your level has be to at least at #r10#k.
#b#p1052001##k? He really likes being in the dark. He's at the basement of some cafe in Kerninig City.
That's right. #bThief#k requires a significant amount of dexterity (DEX) and luck (LUK). It's a very attractive job, indeed. Would you like to take the path of a Thief?

Thief. You'll need to head over to Kerning City in order to meet #r#p1052001##k. Meet him first. In order to become the #rThief#k, you'll have to be at least at #blevel 10#k. Make sure to take down the monsters that you may face on your way there.
Passing by me and go further, you can find #bThief Statue#k to teleport to #bKerning City#k.
It'll be quite an experience just to go to where #b#p1052001##k is ... in any case, talk to me when you're ready to choose a path.
Are you ready to become a Magician like me?

Yes. We have a growing number of people training themselves to become the best Magician they can be. In order to join them, you'll have to be at least #blevel 8#k to do so. Talk to me when you're ready.
At the very top of the biggest tree in the biggest forest of Victoria Island, #rEllnia#k, you'll meet #b#p1032001##k. Why? Haven't seen him yet?
#b#p1032001##k the Magician...I have never seen him up close myself... Someone told me he's always at the Magic Library, reading. What do you think? Do you want to become a Magician?
Okay. Once you meet #b#p1032001##k, tell him I said hi. In order to become a Magician, you'll need to head to Ellinia and go to the Magic Library, located at the very top of the town.
Passing by me and go further, you can find #bMagician Statue#k to teleport to #bElinia#k.
You don't think being a Magician fits you? I think it looks fine though ... in any case, talk to me when you're ready to choose a path.

I thought it was a case of an outsider mindlessly wanting to be a part of Sand Bandits... I apologize for grossly underestimating you. So you really want to join the Sand Bandits? Then I'll have to test you once more.

Everyone at Sand Bandits has a deep hatred towards the queen. We just don't show it in public. If you just let your anger out like that, then you may feel great that moment, but you can't achieve bigger things by doing that.

That is why, the most important aspect of being a Sand Bandits is patience. Being patient enough not to be swayed by what's unfolding right in front of your eyes, but patiently waiting for the right time. That's what's required to become a Sand Bandits.

Do you know Lidium? It's a jewel that you can find from time to time by slaying the monsters at the desert. If you bring me #b2 #t4011008#s#k, then I'll personally accept you as a member of the Sand Bandits. It's not easy refining small ores into jewels, so... I think this will be a good bar to judge your level of patience.
This must be too tough for you to handle. If you can't do it, then just forget about it.

Ho! You did bring 2 #t4011008#s. This jewel can only be found in the region of Ariant, and it's hard to make one due to its hardness, but once it's made, its figure will last for a long time. It may look brittle, but it's actually much harder than a diamond.

#t4011008# resembles a lot of the characteristics of the people in the desert. People here may not give you trust at first. You'll have to earn it, but once you earn it, they'll never turn their back on you again. You have definitely shown me your true character. I, Eleska, the desert warrior, will now anoint you as a proud new member of the Sand Bandits!

But don't be satisfied with just this. You have just earned one person's trust, that's all. You are not yet officially accepted as a true member of the Sand Bandits. If you really wish to become one, then you'll have to find other members and prove your worth to each and every one of them. Don't worry too much about it. I think you're more than capable enough to quickly earn their respect and trust.
I don't think you have gotten #b2 #t4011008#s#k yet. The ore of Lidium can be refined by Muhammad, so once you get the ores, take them to him, okay?
Who are you? You have something for me? Let me see...

Oh, it's a recommendation letter from #p2101005#. If it's from #p2101005#, then it's 100% legit. You do look like someone who's primed for an advancement. If you feel like you're ready, then let me know. I'll put you to the test.
Haven't you gone to see #b#p1032001##k yet?
This is where you can make the advancement as an intelligent magician.
You lost the recommendation letter? Okay, I'll write you another one.
Please don't lose it this time.
Hey, how's it going? I've been watching your every move, and... you look like you're ready for an advancement... and I want to recommend you to #p1032001#. What do you think?
I had known #p1032001# for a long time. Please see #b#p1032001##k at #m101000000#. You may be able to make the advancement through him, too.

Are you thinking that it's not time for you to make the jump? You're a humble person, but the window of making the advancement closes after a while. Please make sure not to miss this golden opportunity.
Hey! How have you been? I've been watching your progress, and now seems to be the time for you to advance to a new job. I'd like to recommend you to #p1090000#. What do you say?
I've known #p1090000# for a long time. Please visit #b#p1090000##k on the Nautilus. She'll be helping you to change your job.
Do you think that you're not ready to advance? Your modesty is commendable. There IS a right time for job advancement, however, and you don't want to miss it.
Do I know you? Are you here to deliver something to me?
#p2101005#'s recommendation, huh? You must be seeking job advancement. If you really want to change your job, apply to the test.
Have you spoken to #b#p1090000##k yet?
Here, you can become a great Pirate.
Did you lose the recommendation? I can write a new one for you.
Please try not to lose it this time.

The new hunting season has begun! I am planning to set-up a stand here at the El-Nath Market, selling #rleathers#k of the most fine quality. And for this, I am counting on you to bring all these leathers here, obviously for a #bvery nice reward#k. If you miss that season, you're not a serious hunter. It's that important. You know, I can give you a special tip on how to hunt effectively. Are you interested?

Oh hoho... Surely you do. As a hunter in training, you should get accostumed with the uncertainties that surround us. So, take this list of leathers I want you to bring, and bring them here, ok? If you pass this test, you will not regret it!

You will need firstly regular #b#t4000021##k in a bunch of 60. In #rLeafre#k, hunt for some #b#t4000264##k. In #rMu Lung#k, hunt for some #b#t4000281##k and #b#t4000295##k, these are widely appreciated around here, and quite rare to find. In #rVictoria Island#k, hunt some #b#t4000030##k, their tough yet flexible texture form quite the spice.

Finally, #b#t4032475##k. Normally their leather are not very consistent. However, once we are in open hunt season, they have some utility for adorning things. Said all that, good luck on your hunt and be safe.
Hey, people line up for miles to hear my secret for successful hunting. I sincerely hope you don't regret your decision, but you will.
Very well done! I've been training my barbecue skills in the meantime but, well, you took so long it froze over! Ah, well, let me reheat it for you. Take your prize.
Why did you not bring them yet? Your prize is right here, bring them to receive it! It's cooling.
Oh, you've completed it!
The results could have been better, but I'm sure you've grown stronger in the process. Well done!
Rather than calling it an order or a mission, I'll give you something fun and interesting.

This is a Treasure Map, but it's covered in different colors so that I can't see what's underneath. I'm sure it indicates where something is hidden.

It is your mission now to uncover the secrets of this #rDirty Treasure Map#k.

First, go see #b#p1032104##k in #bEllinia#k. She'll be able to offer you some help.

We're already in the middle of winter. Time flies, doesn't it? Feels like there should be an event to cheer up this dreary time of year. I know! How about Winter Bingo? Find 20 Bingo Necklaces from monsters, and I'll put a stamp on your Bingo Board.
The event will start now! You must bring me 20 Bingo Necklaces!\n\n#i4032420# 20 #t4032420#s
You know, if you fill up your Bingo Board, you'll get a treasure chest full of items. Are you sure you're not interested?
