Yoo hoo~ Hello? Let me see... You just leveled two. Then you've got #bAP#k. Have you decided where to invest your AP? You still don't know what AP is? Well, well... I kindly enough will explain it to you.
AP means #bABILITY POINT#k. Now, press #bS#k. You will see all the stats you have. AP is on the left bottom side. If you haven't invested AP yet, your AP is still 5. Where can you use AP?

AP is used to improve your stats. When you invest AP into #bSTR, your power will be enhanced; if into INT, intelligence; if into DEX, agility; if LUK, luck#k. You can increase HP or MP if you want. AP is worthy as it can be used many different ways. Every class has one primary stat and one secondary stat. For Warriors, it's STR and DEX; for Magicians, it's INT and LUK; if you're a Bowman then you'll need DEX and STR, while Thieves use LUK and DEX.

Did you get how to use AP? When you make use of AP, you can become a strong Warrior. But, as you are still a beginner, I'll will give you one more piece of advice about changing jobs and AP investment.
If you want to hear about changing your job and AP investment, please come back. Yoo hoo~
Hmm~ You're not interested in this story. Well, that's fine. Have a good adventure.
Yoo hoo~~ You came again. You are a real adventurer not to miss any information! Shall we talk about changing a job?
If you want to be a stronger adventurer, you have to advance your job. You can advance your job in Victoria Island, not in Maple Island. You can choose one among #bWarrior, Magician, Bowman, Thief#k.

But there's some condition to change your job. #bWarriors, Bowmen, and Thieves should be at least level 10#k. #bMagicians should be at least level 8#k. Other than level, you need to be ready to have a job. What does that mean? Where you placed your AP will help determine what path you take, that's why it's very important.

#bWarriors should have at least 35 STR and above, Magicians will need 20 INT and above, Bowman must have 25 DEX and above, and Thief also need 25 DEX and above#k Under this condition, you are qualified to have a job.
You can't advance your job when you're short of either level and/or stat. Although you're a beginner, you have to consider investing AP if you want to have a job. Never ever forget!
I hope the explanation on AP and changing job helps you a lot!
So you heard the rumor too. All I know is that the Black Mage attacked the Temple of Time. \n\rBut you have to have #rrebirthed twice#k to be strong enough to help. \r\nDo you want to know more?
Then go find out for yourself! The #p2140000# of the Temple of Time should know the details.
You're not curious?
What is it?
Haven't you met with the Temple Keeper yet? Why are you taking so long? Hurry up and go see him!
(Shaking his head) What is it? Ah, my mind is fuzzy...it's hard to breathe. You're also here to verify the rumor?
I see. I've been feeling very ill ever since the incident... Please, bring me #b1 All-Cure Potion#k, and I will explain everything.
Then why have you come?

Th-thank you. I feel much better now.\r\nThe Black Mage sent his underlings to attack here. They were after the altar...luckily, I was able to repel them. However... (He lowers his voice.) ...a crack has formed on the Gate to the Future. Please, keep this to yourself. I don't want the rumors to get out of hand...\r\nYou can only go through the #bGate to the Future#k if you have #r2 rebirths#k.
Be careful. Your curiosity may become your undoing.
Ah... I feel faint. I need an All Cure Potion...

There's a light coming through the crack in the Gate to the Future? I recommend against entering especially if you haven't #rrebirthed 2 times#k yet. The Gate may prevent you from entering. But what you do with your life is in your own hands.
Who goes there?
You're still wandering around? No one in this town will deal with you until you've been cleared by the chief.
You're the one Big Headward was talking about? Who are you? Did Cygnus send you here?
Who are you? Who sent you here?!

We knew each other in the past...? Hmph, okay. I'll give you a chance to prove yourself. (Could this person know that I used to be a runaway?) If you really know me, you should be able to answer some simple questions.
Just as I thought! An agent of the Black Mage! Why have you come here?!

All right, let's begin. Where did we first meet?
#L0##bKerning City#l
#L1#Henesys#l
#k

Hmm. Okay. And what was I doing there?
#L0##bYou were a police officer.#l
#L1#You were a botanist studying Kerning City's swamps.#l
#L2#You were a runaway.#l
#k

(How did they know that...?) Someone could have told you that! Okay, how about this: Who was my father?
#L0##bGrendel the Really Old#l
#L1#Huckle#l
#L2#Stan#l
#k

(Why can't I remember this person...?) So, you've done your research. But you can't know this!
What item did my father give me when he asked me to come home?
#L0##bAn old map#l
#L1#An old golden watch#l
#L2#Some old bread#l
#k
How could you...? We really do know each other? I-I'm sorry I didn't recognize you. Welcome to our town. Now that you're here... I may ask for your help time to time.\r\n
Ha, I caught you in a lie! Get out of this town!
Not a bad guess, but completely wrong. Leave here while you still can!
Unfortunately for you, I'm too stupid to be a botanist. Now GET OUT!!
Just how old do you think I am for him to be my father...? Leave town before I have you stabbed.
Looks like your run of luck's come to an end. Guards!
Leave this town!
Leave this town now! You're not welcome here!
Please speak to Athena Pierce.
What is it?
It's a relief to see that there are survivors beyond Henesys.
Chief Alex tells me you lost all of your recent memories. Do you have any questions for me?
All right. This is a long story, so make yourself comfortable.
I'm here, should you have any questions.

Ah, how did the Cygnus Knights become our enemies?
Empress Cygnus took an interest in the World Tree. It was her belief that the lost tree was the key to defeating the Black Mage. 
They searched far and wide, and the Cygnus Knights eventually found it. However, it was a trap set by the Black Mage. He corrupted Cygnus and her Knights. Without the Empress's divine power, Ereve fell to the earth, and the Cygnus Knights began their siege of Maple World. You can see what followed: Henesys was destroyed, and...and I don't know what happened to the rest of Maple World.
You seem...familiar. Regardless, I cannot share my tale with someone I don't know. If you wish to speak with me, defeat the monsters that plague the town.
Go to Henesys Park or the market area. The #rsnails#k are wreaking havoc in those areas. Eliminate #r100#k of them.
Let me rest in peace...

Thank you... Why have you come to see me? Hmm... The townspeople suffer enough at the hands of the evil Cygnus Knights. It was not my intention to frighten them. \r\nI'm usually a very gentle person. All these monsters have me on edge. \r\nIt seems things have quieted down since you arrived, though. Thank you.
You need not worry about me anymore. I will...keep a low profile.
You're taking your time, aren't you? Can't you see the pain those snails are causing?
Hello. Sorry about earlier. I'm sure you can understand, we've got to be very cautious towards strangers. But now that the chief's vouching for you, I was wondering if you could give me a hand?

Because of Cygnus, I've had to make a career change from stylist to soldier... I've even put on this ugly armor. It's so last season! Ah, anyway, do you think you could help eliminate some of the monsters that are threatening the town? Oh, there's so much to do...I haven't even done my hair in 2 days! If you could please eliminate about #r100 #o8600001#s#k, I should have time to get myself in order.
I didn't mean to offend you.
You finished?
So there ARE Maplers who can beat up those freaky mutants. Thank you!
Not done yet? We've all got to work together if we want to survive.
Ah, I'm glad to see you! Would you mind doing me another favor?
Thank you again for your help earlier. This time, I need help dealing with these slimes. If you can #reliminate#k just #r500#k or so, I think the town will be able to breathe a little easier.
No, no, I understand. We're all busy nowadays...
How's the slime hunt going?
Thank you for everything. It'll be nice not having to pick gunk out of my hair anymore...
Ah, how are we going to return peace to Henesys if we're all covered in slime?
Oh, you're the outsider! The chief told us about you. Is it true you're going around, helping people out?

We can't farm, and we can't hunt, because the Cygnus Knights control the regions outside of town. Could you help us gather some food before we starve? The snails that inhabit the market and park are pretty nutritious. Please defeat some snails and #bbring me their meat#k.
Huh. But if you're not... then who...?
You brought the Snail Meat?
Oh, thank you! We'll be able to eat for days on this...
I can provide food for all the townspeople If you can bring me about #b100#k pieces of #bSnail Meat#k.
It's good to see you again. Thank you again for before. We all enjoyed the snail. I don't suppose you could help me again?

I'm going to try cooking a mushroom dish this time. Mushrooms are supposed to lower cholesterol and fight disease, you know. We all need to be at our healthiest, or a mutant might eat us. Please get me about #b200 Mutant Mushroom Caps#k. Oh, it will be so nice to cook a meal with ingredients other than dirt and twigs!
Oh, of course. I understand...
Did you get all the Mushroom Caps?
Thank you very much. I'll get to work cooking this right away!
We'll need about #b200 Mushroom Caps#k to feed everyone here.
Please help me! My husband left town to scout out the area, and nobody's seen him since! Oh, I hope he's okay... Please, help me find him!
Oh, thank you! His name is Utah. Please, find him!
P-please, I'm desperate! Utah...!
Who's that? Step back!
Ah, sorry. I thought you were a Cygnus Knight...
You don't look like the enemy, at any rate. I can't leave here just now, but I could use some help...\r\n#L0##bThat's what they all say. What can I do for you?#l\n#k
I've been cut off from my home for the last few days. Would you let my wife know that I'm fine, and that I'll be home soon?\r\n#L0##bSure. Where does your wife live?#l\n#k
My wife's name is Camila and she lives in Henesys.\r\n#L0##b(This is Utah? He sure has changed!) Oh? Camila actually sent me here to find you. She's worried sick, you know.#l\n#k
Camila's worried about me...? Haha, of course. Just like when we were little... Please tell Camila that I'll be home soon.
Please, help.
Did you find him?
Utah's okay...? Thank you so much! Here, this is the least I can do.
Please tell Camila that I'm fine, and that I'll be home soon.
Did you give Camila my message? I don't suppose you're up for another task?

Ah, thank you. It's just...I lost a marble Camila gave me for my birthday when we were children. I think the monsters around here picked it up... Think you can find it? I'm a bit too winded to search for it myself...
Please help me.
Did you find the crystal marble?
Ah... Thank you. I was about to give up. I can head back to town now...but I don't have anything to repay you with. Why don't you visit me in town later? I'd love to reward you for your help.
Have you found a shiny crystal marble? It's very important to me. Please find it.
I hear you helped Utah. Thank you very much. That useless crystal marble... Utah is much more important to me than some marble! Would you do me a favor?
Utah's exhausted from his journey. Please gather some ingredients so I can make him something delicious. #b60#k cuts of #bMutant Pork#k should be enough. What? He's probably REALLY hungry.
Oh, of course. I understand...
Do you have the Mutant Pork?
Thank you again. Please, accept this small token of my gratitude... Ah, I'd better start cooking.
You can get #bMutant Pork#k from #rMutant Ribbon Pigs#k. Of course, they're so big nowadays, but that just means we get more pork from them.

Aah...I haven't styled my hair in days. I get depressed when I look in the mirror... I'm trying to adjust to the life of a soldier, but deep down, I'm still a stylist. \r\nI don't want to lose my styling skill, in case peace ever returns. But I'm out of supplies...\r\nFor the sake of all things stylish, please help me!!

Please bring me hair supply materials. I need #b50 Pig Oils#k and #b60 Mutant Slime Bubbles#k. I need these for my secret Big Headward's Hair Gel! And yes, of course I need this much. Have you seen the size of my head? Look...I really need this. I'm absolutely miserable with my hair like this!
What? But what's more important than looking good?!
Did you get everything I asked for?
Oh, you're my savior! Okay, now to make some hair gel... Finally, I'll be able to look my best again!
Yes, I need #b50 Pig Oils#k and #b60 Mutant Slime Bubbles#k! It's for a good cause!
Oh, good to see you! As you can see, I made it home. Of course, now I've got new challenges that I can't quite take care of on my own. Mind lending me a hand?

I owe you one! I'm thinking of starting the old pig farm back up. My farm was destroyed in the Cygnus attack, but if I can tame the Ribbon Pigs, we could have a steady source of food again. Would you please #rcatch 20 Mutant Ribbon Pigs#k for me? Take this rope and tie them up. Good luck!
I hate to press the issue, but we have to work together to survive...
You catch all the Ribbon Pigs I needed?
Thank you. After the Ribbon Pigs mutated, I couldn't catch my own anymore. Please accept this gift.
If you #rcatch 20 Mutant Ribbon Pigs#k, I can take care of taming them. Just use the rope I gave you to tie them up.
Alex mentioned you. I'm working on developing stronger magic with which to fight Cygnus... Can you help?

Let's begin. Since the Cygnus attack, the monsters around Henesys have grown bigger, stronger. I think the Black Mage's magic has done this. I'm trying to learn more about this magic myself. Bring me #b60 Mutant Snail Shells#k to study.
What could be more important than fighting back?
You have what I asked for?
Thank you. We must grow stronger if we are to protect the town...I must get stronger. I'll need more research materials soon, so please drop by often.
There's no time to waste.
Who's that?! Who goes there? Meet me in the open, where I can see you!
Okay! I'll be in Ereve Forest. Don't keep me waiting!
Coward! Begone!

You look familiar somehow. Have we met? N-no, I've never spent time moping by myself at the hill north of Henesys before...! I-I don't know what you're talking about. Look at me! Do I look like the sort of person who'd do that?\r\n
I'm glad you're here. Would you mind helping me with something?

As you know, my mission is... What? Of course I'm here on a mission! Look, just drop this whole 'Anne's so lonely, Anne spends all her time moping alone in the wilderness' talk! It's not like that! Now, I've been given the IMPORTANT task of observing the Cygnus Knights. But those pesky monsters keep getting in my way. Eliminate #r100 Tinos#k for me, would you?
That's fine. I have lots of friends to help me! Really!
That's better. I can focus on the mission now.
See me again soon. Because I'll have more work for you! Not because I'm lonely! ...Because I'm not!
I'm fine! You don't need to keep me company!
Come back and help me again. You won't say no, right?
You've quieted the Tinos down, but now the Tirus are making a ruckus. Eliminate #r100 Tirus#k, so I can focus on the mission.
I thought you could handle this simple task. I guess I overestimated you.
That's better. I can focus on the mission now.
See me again soon. Because I'll have more work for you! Not because I'm lonely! ...Because I'm not!
I'm fine! You don't need to keep me company!
Here to help me with my research, I presume?
I've learned a lot about black magic, but I'll need more materials to actually use it. Bring me the #bfeathers#k of the #rMutant Tinos#k and #rMutant Tirus#k. I need #b60 of each#k.
How many must be eliminated before you recognize the need for my research?
Do you have the materials?
Whatever the price, I will grow stronger and defeat the Black Mage. My research will bring peace to Maple World.
I need #b60 Tino#k and #b60 Tiru Feathers#k.
Give me a hand.

There's a punk in town. Big-headed guy. I was fletching my arrows, and he had this big grin...I think he was making fun of me! I'm going to make arrows powerful enough to puncture that stupid head of his. I'll need around #b60 Tiguru Feathers#k from Ereve Forest.
You have to!
Did you get the feathers?!
Thank you. Okay, I'll get to work on the arrows. You can go away.
Come on! I need #b60 Tiguru Feathers#k.
Well, what are they up to? Huh! So, they've tightened security...
Hm, I need to find out what they're doing. I still need your help...
You haven't been by the stronghold yet? We can't keep wasting time...
If they've tightened their security, we'll need to find a way through. Are you ready?

Very suspicious. They could be mustering for an invasion... If that happens, we'll be crushed like bugs. We have to infiltrate the stronghold and damage their forces before they can attack. Right, so you'll have to disguise yourself as a knight. Eliminate one of the knights guarding the entrance and return with his #b#t4032922##k.
Hey, we're all in this together!
Did you bring the #b#t4032922##k?
Okay. This should let you pass into the stronghold. Hold onto it. I'll probably need your help again soon.
You can get an emblem by defeating one of the knights at the stronghold entrance, or any knights who attack the town...
We don't have much time before they attack. What's up?

What?! You lost the #t4032922#?! How...how could you...IDIOT! Okay, fine. You hold off the monsters attacking the town while I find you a replacement. Eliminate 20 #o8600000#s, #o8600001#s, #o8600002#s, and #o8600003#s.
Don't just bother me for no reason.
Well, looks like we survived.
Well, you're clearly not a total screw-up. Here, I managed to get this #t4032922#... DON'T LOSE IT! I hope it's safe to entrust you with these things...
Don't let the monsters through!
We have an informant in the Cygnus Stronghold. Make sure he's okay, and see if he has any news to report.
Thank you. Take care you aren't seen--we can't risk his cover being blown. You do still have the #bKnight Emblem#k, right? You can't enter the stronghold without it.
It's a dangerous job, but you're the only one who can do it.
Psst. My cover's safe, but I have nothing to report. They're playing it close to the chest...
I'll contact you when I get new information. Don't contact me first.
You still haven't found the informant? Search the Cygnus Stronghold thoroughly!
Eliminated any enemies around here! I can't risk blowing my cover.
Offense is the best defense. If we lose, it's over for all of us... Please, lend us your strength.

Thank you. We don't have the strength to meet them head on, so our only hope is a surprise attack. Launching an attack on the stronghold seems the best course of action. Go to the stronghold and eliminate 500 Official Knights A and B.
If Henesys falls, who will be left...?
Did our strategy work?
Nice job. That'll put a damper on any of their plans. I'll have more work for you soon.
If we wait too long, it won't be a surprise...
You did good last time. Will you help us launch another attack?
Thank you. Now, please eliminate 500 Official Knights C. I will pray for your safe return.
If Henesys falls, who will be left...?
Have you completed your mission?
Good work. They'll think twice before attacking us... I'll have more work for you soon.
Good work. They'll think twice before attacking us... I'll have more work for you soon.
You did good last time. Will you help us launch another attack?
Thank you. Now, please eliminate 500 Official Knights D. I will pray for your safe return.

Have you completed your mission?
Good work. They'll think twice before attacking us... I'll have more work for you soon.
You haven't finished the attack yet?
You did good last time. Will you help us launch another attack?
Thank you. Now, please eliminate 500 Official Knights E. I will pray for your safe return.
If Henesys falls, who will be left...?
Have you completed your mission?
Good work. They'll think twice before attacking us... I'll have more work for you soon.
You haven't finished the attack yet?
I have a request for you. I was a strict father in life. One of my biggest regrets is not telling Alex I love him more. I would like to send a letter to my son.

What a relief. Ah, but there is one problem...I lost the letter. One of the Knights who attacked the town took it, of this I'm certain. They weren't very organized, so they probably weren't any of the more advanced knights... Please find my letter and give it to Alex.
I'd hate to have to haunt you...
What is this? A letter from my father? Where did you find it?\r\nI always thought he was too strict, but this... this was... Father... \r\n
Thank you for bringing me this. I can imagine his voice as I read it...
Find my letter and give it to Alex.

Good, you're here. I have a personal favor to ask of you... Have you met Jay? Ever since he lost his parents in the Cygnus attack, I've been worried about him. All he cares about is researching stronger and stronger magic. Would you help me bring a smile back to his face?
Thank you. One of my informants told me that Official Knights B carry Cheery Books. Those books will make you bust up laughing with a single paragraph... Please get one and give it to Jay.
I know we're fighting for survival, but we're still human.
Checking on my research? My magic grows stronger by the day.
This is from Alex, isn't it? He worries too much... Very well, I'll take it. Thank you. (The corner of Jay's mouth tugs upwards ever-so-slightly.)
Ah, I have a favor to ask of you. Anne and Big Headward have some kind of feud going lately. Everyone's miserable because of their petty squabbling. Do you think you can reconcile them?

I'd like to prepare a gift for them, but I don't have all the materials I need. Please go to the Knight Stronghold and gather the bandanas and gloves the Knights are wearing. 100 Official Knight D's Gloves would be good, and... Since Big Headward's bandana probably needs to be little bit bigger, bring 150 Official Knight C's Bandanas. Good luck!
Well...life goes on, I guess...
Have you collected everything I asked for?
Thank you! I'll make such pretty gloves and a lovely bandana for them... I'm sure the fight is nothing serious, but I want them to make up as soon as possible.
You're still working on collecting those items, right?
Hello? Ah-ouch! Sorry, I hurt my shoulder wrestling with those Ribbon Pigs... They're so strong. Huh... I hate to say it, but could you do me another favor?
I need to protect my shoulder. Official Knight E's Pauldron should do it. Those pigs are so strong, it'll take at least 200 pauldrons to do the trick. Thanks!
Yeah, yeah, gotcha. You've got other things to do.
Did you get those pauldrons?
Thank you. This'll get me back on track... If I can get the pig farm up and running, maybe we won't be so hungry all the time.
You can find the pauldrons on Official Knights E.
Good to see you. I have another mission for you.
This report says the advanced knights have started running drills. If we let them complete their training, we're doomed. Eliminate 500 Advanced Knights A.
Time is of the essence! It's not as if we can go into the past if we screw up now!
Are the targets neutralized?
Nice job. The knights mustn't be allowed to muster their strength.
If we wait too long, it won't be a surprise...
Good to see you. I have another mission for you.
This report says the advanced knights have started running drills. If we let them complete their training, we're doomed. Eliminate 500 Advanced Knights B.
Time is of the essence! It's not as if we can go into the past if we screw up now!
Are the targets neutralized?

Your appearance is timely, as usual. I need more powerful implements to handle the magic I'm researching. The weapons used by the knights should suffice.
Certain Cygnus Knights wield a special type of wand. Bring me one of these #b#t4032925#s#k.
Hm. Are you not as reliable as I thought?
Do you have a #b#t4032925##k?
Thank you. Now, let's see what kind of power this wand has...
I see you haven't found the wand I need yet.
Huh. Anne's acting weird lately. She keeps giving me dirty looks, and I think she stepped on my foot on purpose! I don't know why she's doing this. Can you help?

You heard about this? I never laughed at Anne! I was just giving her a friendly smile. Okay, I'll solve this the way I solve all my problems: with a gift. Please get a Superior Bow used by the Advanced Knights. When you have it, would you give it to Anne? Please.
Sure, sure, you have more important things to do. Why is she being like this...?
What? I don't have any tasks for you...wait, what's that bow? Is it for me? Wow!
Hm... So... Big Headward wanted me to have this? Ah, I thought he was laughing at me, but he just looks funny... That's tough. Okay, we're good now.
Please give Anne a Superior Bow to resolve our little misunderstanding.
Ah, I'm so depressed lately. Please, help me out!

I need a weapon that makes me look...stylish! Anne has that awesome bow now, and she keeps mocking me! She says my head's too big, and this weapon's too small... Isn't that rude?! How can she say such things! Anyway, I need a better weapon! One that's...cool! And sleek! Hey, maybe get one of those fancy swords the Cygnus Knights use!
Okay, I'll just be over there... By myself...
Did you get the sword? Great! I'll look great swinging that thing around!
Anne won't be able to make fun of me now!
No sword yet? I think Advanced Knights E carry them around.
It's good to see you. I have a new task for you.

You're the first person from outside Henesys we've seen since the Cygnus attack. The monsters have us cut off from the Six Path Crossway, but you--you could make it! Please, go there now and see if you can contact the other towns.
I think this task is of particular interest to you...
The Crossway was destroyed? There must be some way to contact the other towns...
I just hope we're not the only survivors. We need to gather our strength...
Sh, just listen. I have new information. Can you get it to the chief without drawing attention?
I found Neinheart. They've got him locked up in a Secret Grove. You can get there through Knight District 4. Tell the chief.
We only get one chance. Let me know when you're ready to do this right.
You have news? Report.
Hm... We suspected Neinheart was being held prisoner... I need to think about this. Come talk to me in a little bit.
You need to tell the chief, ASAP!
Okay. We need to rescue Neinheart. Please give us your help again.
Neinheart alone resisted the Black Mage's influence. If we can save him, we might have a fighting chance against Cygnus. Go save him from the Secret Grove.
Neinheart is the only Cygnus Knight who didn't turn bad. How can you just abandon him?
What happened to Neinheart?
Please rescue Neinheart.
Thank you. Now, please work with me in ending Cygnus's reign of terror...
The knights are growing in strength. It won't be long until they launch a final attack against Henesys. Help me weaken their power base... Begin by eliminating the Advanced Knights.
Must I stand alone?
Have you eliminated the Advanced Knights?
Good work. It's difficult to turn against my old allies, but there's no other way to return peace to Maple World.
What has become of the Advanced Knights?
You must defeat the 5 Chief Knights before you can defeat the Empress. As long as they're by her side, she will be protected. Understood?
You must stop them. The Black Mage has given the Chief Knights great power. Be wary.
Must I stand alone?
What happened to the Chief Knights?
Good...good. The work you've done may well save Maple World...
Have you defeated the Chief Knights?
Listen carefully! It's hard to send you messages right now. They're getting suspicious of me... Can you help?

You must pass Cygnus Garden to reach Cygnus's Chamber, where the Empress and Chief Knights keep their headquarters. I haven't determined where the garden is exactly. You need to find Cygnus Garden and tell the chief.
Idiot! If my cover's blown, everything we've done was for nothing!
You have a new information? What is it?
Cygnus Garden...
What is it?
Find Cygnus Garden, and tell the chief where it is!
Father told me about it once...\r\n#L0##bWe need a key to get into Cygnus Garden.#l\n#k
A key? Ah... I'm sure I've heard of it before, but I just can't remember. If only my father was still alive...\r\n#L0##b(Ex-chief Stan!) Don't worry. I'll find out about it.#l\n#k
Oh? Very well. I'm counting on you.\r\n
Ah, it's you again. What is it?
The key to the Cygnus Garden, huh?
Ah, you mean the Dream Key. It has a blue jewel set in it...Jay probably knows something about it from his research. I may be gone, but I'm glad I can still help... Go ask Jay about it.
Why bring it up if you don't want to know about it...?
Yes? What is it? Did Alex need something?
The Dream Key?\nYes, it's come up often in my research.\nThe Dream Key, made from the spirits of the Hallowed Ground. By combining the stones of the 5 spirits, you can create a Dream Key.
Have you spoken with Jay?
But why do you ask? I know how to make it, but I don't know what it opens. Is it a way for us to eliminate Cygnus? Let Alex know. I'll help however I can.
We're counting on you.
Did you learn about the key to Cygnus Garden?
Okay. Yes. The end is in sight. I don't know what we would have done if you hadn't come here...\nPlease, help us see this through. We need to gather our strength, and reclaim the land from Cygnus!
It's time we got started. You're with us, right?

I'll get straight to the point. We need to destroy them before they attack. Eliminate Cygnus. The Black Mage has twisted her beyond the point of no return. All we can do is end the parody of herself that she's become.
We can't do this without you.
You did it? It leaves a bitter taste in my mouth...but perhaps we've finally dealt a blow against the Black Mage...
The Black Mage still has forces out there. We must continue to fight for Maple World.
As long as Cygnus lives, we're all in danger.
...can you hear me? Wake up! Come see me if you wish to see the truth!
You heard my call...
Are you ready to face the truth?
You stand before me, and so you shall see. Talk to me again when you are ready.
Ignorance leads us down the path of destruction...

What do you think of the world on the other side of the Gate to the Future? Do you believe it? ...It is a lie. It's a waking dream, planted on Maple World by the Black Mage. The Gate to the Future has not opened. They failed in their original goal, so they tried to demoralize us by showing us a ruined future. Don't fall for this deception.
However, it is still a dream. That means the dreamer's subconscious may have soaked through. If you can uncover the dreamer's identity... Take care not to confuse truth and falsehood.
...!!\r\n(Shinsoo appeared before you, but you cannot understand it.)
What brings you here?
What is this...Dream Fragment?
May I please see it?
What is this...
A #bDream Fragment#k! Where did you...?\r\n#L0##bI stumbled upon it. What is this?#l\n#k
Well, I'm not sure... Wasn't it related to Cygnus's conspiracy to attack Maple World?\r\n#L0##bCygnus's conspiracy...? Wasn't it all the Black Mage's doing...?#l\n#k

That, um, that was just a guess. Aren't you curious, though? I doubt anyone knows what this is. I wouldn't waste my time looking into it.\r\n#L0##b(Athena Pierce is acting strangely... There are a lot more living people in the present, so someone there might know what this is. Maybe Neinheart?)#l\n#k
What's going on in your head? Just keep fighting monsters.
What brings you here?
I'm sorry, but I'm quite busy, and--did you say #bDream Fragment#k?
Ah, that sounds familiar... Where did I read about that...?

Yes, here we are. One of our informants gave me a report on this matter. It's related to a follower of the Black Mage with the power to create dream worlds. I hadn't verified it yet... Where did you find this Dream Fragment?\r\n#L0##b(You can't say you got it in the future...) I just stumbled upon it...#l\n#k

Can you bring me more? I'd love to perform some experiments on it.\r\n#L0##bNo! I don't have any more. (Dream Fragments... A Black Mage lacky who controls dream... Why is something like this in the future?)#l\n#k
That's too bad. If you learn anything new, please let me know.

Help! Is there anyone out there? If you can hear me, please help! I'm trapped in El Nath! I came here to find my younger brother, but now I'm surrounded by monsters! Are there any strong adventurers out there willing to help?

Wow, someone can hear me! Please, get here as fast as you can. Where am I? Umm...okay, I don't know, exactly...but it's definitely somewhere in El Nath! I think it's #bthe first tower of the weird castle at El Nath#k! There are bunch of super strong monsters here! Help!
Please, bring help with you! The monsters here have incredibly high HP! I doubt you can handle them yourself! Wait, no, that sounded bad...I just mean thaaaaAAAAAAAAHHHH!! NO! HELP ME!!
Ahhh, where are all the strong adventurers of Maple World when I need them?
Ohhh, thank you, thank you! You are my savio...huh? You're younger than I expected. With less muscles. And no beard. Well, forget the formalities, then. Have I got a story for you!

My name is #p2161003#. I'm a locksmith, and I was born in El Nath. I was working in Ludibrium for a while, and came back to El Nath after saving up some money. But when I returned, my brother was missing.

I asked around everywhere, but no one knew my brother's whereabouts. I thought he ran away from home, but he's too much of a pansy to do that. I decided to look for him myself...I figured he got stuck in a snowdrift or something.

But I couldn't find him anywhere! Eventually, I ended up here. No one comes here...I remember this area used to be blocked, so I thought it was strange that it was open. And guess what I found? My brother was held captive here!
I couldn't just leave him, but a weak guy like me couldn't save him, either. That's why I needed a strong adventurer. And I finally found one... sniff sniff... My hero.

I bet you're wondering how I got here if I'm so weak, huh? Well, I used the ultimate weak-guy technique: Play Dead. Yep, I'm a master at it. Sometimes I fall asleep while doing it and get frostbite. I'm that good.
My brother is on the Roof of the First Tower. I saw him myself through the keyhole. I couldn't do anything since #r#o8840002##k would destroy me, but I'm sure you can do it! Right? Please?

I know you can do it! After all, you got here without my incredible Play Dead technique. Now then, go through the gate and #brescue my brother#k! Oh, no, hold on, wait. The gate to the roof is always locked.
So, make sure you take the key I just gave you! The materials weren't great, so the key will break after one use. That gives you one chance with the key. I'm counting on you!
Wait, you can't either? Then, who can? Do I need to start training?
Oh, my brother! You rescued my brother! Thank you so much! Okay, hold on... Where is the Return Scroll I've been saving? Hm, did I hide it in my sock?
(Rummaging...) Ah! Found it. Smells funny... Nevermind! I'll send my brother back to town first!
Sigh... Since that was my only Return Scroll, I'll have to Play Dead all the way home. Hey, how are you going to return to town? Are you going to fight? Or do you need me to teach you my technique?
Whoa, I've never seen someone so bold. Marvelous! Hm, but do you have the keys to the other towers? All the gates are locked, you know. No matter how bold you are, those gates will stop you.

I guess I have no choice but to step in. After all, I am #p2161003#, master locksmith! I'll make you the keys you need. My brother shouldn't get into any more trouble...for a while. Yeah, I can spare some time.
Aw, shucks, don't look at me all googly-eyed like that! I'm just doing my part, since you helped me.
Haven't you rescued my brother yet? If you lost the key to the roof, #bforfeit the quest and restart#k. I'll...find a way to give you the key again.
Do you need the #t4032832#? I can make it for you. It's nothing, really. I examined the lock while I was looking for my brother.
I need the materials to make the key, though. I used up everything I had experimenting with the locks. You can get the stuff I need from #r#o8210000#s#k. That'll be easy for you, yeah?
Wonderful! You bring me #b50#k #b#t4000625#s#k, and I'll whip that key right up for you. I already have the key mold and everything.
Oh? Are you afraid of #o8210000#s, too? No way! How did you even get this far? Are you a master of Play Dead, too?
Looks like... Yep! Those are all the #t4000625#s I requested. You sure are something. Let's get you that key, huh?
Here's your #t4032832#. I'll make you another one if you lose it. I might make another anyway. Nothing else to do around here...
Don't have those #b50 #t4000625#s#k yet? Hey, I'm not saying anything. It's not like I could defeat #r#o8210000##k.
Do you need the #t4032833#? I hear there are #o8210006#s in the Second Tower, which are even stronger than #o8840002#. Will you be okay? Heh, sure you will.

I did get into the Second Tower while looking for my brother, so I know what kind of key you need to unlock the gate. I need different materials for that key, though. Think we can help each other again?
Ah, that's the answer I expect from a confident adventurer! Defeat #r#o8210001# and #o8210002#s#k, and bring me #b50#k #b#t4000626#s#k. Can you handle that? Of course you can!
Then...sorry, but I can't make the key. Even a legendary locksmith like myself needs the right materials.

You got the #t4000626#s? That was fast! How did you defeat those terrible #o8210001#s? I mean, they didn't just give you the #t4000626#s, right? Of course not. That's stupid. Anyway, give me the #t4000626#s, and I'll make that key.
Here's the #t4032833#. I'll make you another one if you lose it. This is kind of fun, actually. My locksmithing business is usually slow, but helping you here is way more exciting!
You haven't collected #b50 #t4000626#s#k yet? I guess those #r#o8210001#s#k are a tall order...
Hm? You want the #t4032834#? There's an extremely powerful monster in the Third Tower, #o8210007#. But, I'm sure you don't mind. You wouldn't want to go if you couldn't handle it!

I was in the Third Tower too, looking for my brother, so I know what kind of key to make. I'll need materials, of course. Whoever made these locks was big on variety, I guess. You can get the stuff I need from Bearwolves. Okay?

Wow. You are just... Wow. Not that I'm, y'know, jealous or anything. I'm pretty useful, too...like when you need keys. Like now! If you defeat #rBearwolves#k and bring me #b50 #t4000627#s#k, I'll show you what I can do. Again.
Are Bearwolves too much for you to handle? I could try to steal from them with my Play Dead technique... Actually, that sounds too dangerous.
All right, you brought the #t4000627#s! Very impressive. Give me a moment, and I'll make your key.

Here is the #t4032834# you've been waiting for. I hope you can defeat #o8210007# and help those in danger. Oh, and come back to see me if you happen to lose the key. I can always make more...with the right materials.
Still fighting those #rBearwolves#k? Still need those #b50 #t4000627#s#k? I understand. Sometimes, even you struggle. I won't judge you. Good luck!
Isn't there someone who can stop our mad king? If I were stronger, I could have done something...
Hm? I sense life... Who's there? Can you hear me? Please answer me! Please, please... #rsomebody stop the Lion King, servant of the Black Mage#k!
I can't leave the #bFourth Tower#k. If you can hear me, please come to the Fourth Tower.

Oh, you came. Thank you! I haven't seen a live human in this castle in such a long time. I am #p2161002#. I was once a knight of this kingdom... A long time ago, before the Black Mage appeared. Now, I'm nothing but a ghost.
Our kingdom, though small and poor, was a peaceful place. Our king was wise and the people were loyal. Life wasn't easy, but it was filled with happiness. But now...
Look around you. Can you believe this castle was once filled with laughter? Our wise king and graceful queen are gone, replaced by a vindictive monster and his minions...
The Black Mage is to blame for everything, for corrupting our king. I tried to convince the king so many times, but he never listened. He couldn't see anything beyond his thirst for revenge.

Nothing changed after the heroes sealed the Black Mage. Hundreds of years passed, but the king remains a loyal servant of the Black Mage. I've given up. I'm tired of waiting. There is only one thing left to do...

I lost my life long ago, but I still maintain my loyalty to this kingdom. We can't bring back the past, but we can't just sit and watch evil take this place. Please, I beg you... Please #bdefeat my king#k.

My purpose in life was to guard the king, but he is no longer my king. The Black Mage changed him so much that I no longer recognize him. I'd rather defeat him with my own hands than leave him like this. That is the last act of loyalty I can perform... But I need your help.

You can find the king in the #bAudience Room#k, located between the Fourth and the Fifth Towers. Only those who have received the Knight's Magic Scroll from the king can go there, but the power of the #o8210004# is preventing the Knight's Magic Scroll from functioning properly.

So, defeat the #r#o8210004#s#k near the Fourth and Fifth Towers. Eliminating 33 of them will diminish the power of the #o8210004#s, allowing the Knight's Magic Scroll to work again. Please, I need your help.
I would do it myself, but my body is long gone. Please reconsider.
You've defeated the #o8210004#s. That was...amazing. I should expect nothing less from you...
Have you not eliminated #r33 #o8210004#s#k yet? I know it's not easy, but if you can get this far, you can do it.
With the #t2030021# in your hands, you only have one thing left to do. Go to the #bAudience Room#k and #reliminate the monster who was once my king#k. This is for him...

The king I knew was a normal warrior who was skilled with a sword, but not much else. Under the Black Mage's influence, I don't know what he's capable of. I doubt you can defeat him on your own. I recommend you gather some people to help you.
There is no other way. It's been hundreds of years since the Black Mage disappeared, but he hasn't recovered. I'm tired of waiting.
Did you defeat him? I see... I'm sorry. It's what I wanted... But I'm still sad to hear my king has fallen. I don't know how it came to this point. I used to serve the king with utmost loyalty...

This is all because of the Black Mage. You haven't completely defeated the king, you know. With the power of the Black Mage, he is only temporarily weakened. The source of his power is tied to the Black Mage, so he will not truly fall until that power has been driven from his body.
Have you not gone to face #rhim#k yet? His skilled swordmanship was recognized by all. If the Black Mage has made him stronger, he won't be an easy opponent. Gather some people to help you fight him.

You must have the #b#t2030021##k to get to the Audience Room. This scroll has the power to transport you there, where you'll find the king. I'd give you one myself, but I used mine up, trying many times to see the king after becoming a ghost...
You'll find that some of the knights who became #o8210005#s still have their #t2030021#s. So, defeat #r#o8210005#s#k and bring me the #b#t4032835##k.
I'll be waiting. My wish was to receive a scroll from the king as a recognition of my service. Now that I'm trying to obtain the #t2030021# like this, I feel a bit...strange.
They were once the king's knights, but they've become monsters after losing their minds. You don't have to feel guilty. If there is no way to turn them back, it would be better to...put them to rest.

You brought the #t2030021#. It's decaying... As I expected, the power of the Black Mage is slowly destroying it. But don't worry, I can activate it. One of my powers as a ghost...heh, I guess it's not all bad.

You can use the #t2030021# now. #bUse it by double-clicking it, and you will be taken to the Audience Room#k. But don't use it yet. You won't be able to defeat the king on your own. You must first gather others to help you.
Where is the #t2030021#? You can get the #b#t2030021##k by defeating the #r#o8210005#s#k.
I've been watching this castle for hundreds of years, but I still can't believe my eyes. It used to be so beautiful. Seeing this place in all its glory used to warm my heart...

And the same goes for the king. Leon... He was a master swordsman, but he was still so warm-hearted and kind. He didn't speak much, but I could feel his generous heart. How could he have changed like that...
What has the #rBlack Mage#k done to him? Why has he become so...? Has he forgotten about me? Please...could you speak to Leon for me?
He's not answering my voice, but I'm certain that he's in the #bAudience Room#k. Please find out whether #bLeon#k remembers me or not, and if he does, why he isn't answering me.
I'm sorry... He'll probably attack anyone who enters the Audience Room. That's a lot to ask of you, I'm sure.

What are you doing here? Are you here to fight? No? What is it that you want then? Hm? Do I remember Queen #p2161001#? How dare you!
